abandon.collocations: abandon a plan 放弃计划, abandon hope 放弃希望, abandon a project 放弃项目

examples.en: The government had to abandon the plan due to lack of funds.
examples.zh: 由于缺乏资金，政府不得不放弃该计划。

examples.en: They abandoned the old building after the earthquake.
examples.zh: 地震后他们遗弃了那栋旧楼。

examples.en: She abandoned her career to raise her children.
examples.zh: 她放弃事业来抚养孩子。

ability.collocations: have the ability to do 有能力做某事, natural ability 天赋, leadership ability 领导能力

examples.en: She has the ability to solve complex problems quickly.
examples.zh: 她有快速解决复杂问题的能力。

examples.en: His natural ability in music was evident from a young age.
examples.zh: 他从小就在音乐方面展现出天赋。

examples.en: The course aims to improve students' writing ability.
examples.zh: 这门课程旨在提高学生的写作能力。

abolish.collocations: abolish slavery 废除奴隶制, abolish a law 废除一项法律, abolish the death penalty 废除死刑

examples.en: Many countries have abolished the death penalty.
examples.zh: 许多国家已经废除了死刑。

examples.en: The government decided to abolish the outdated regulation.
examples.zh: 政府决定废除过时的规定。

examples.en: Slavery was abolished in the 19th century.
examples.zh: 奴隶制在19世纪被废除。

absorb.collocations: absorb knowledge 吸收知识, absorb information 吸收信息, absorb moisture 吸收水分

examples.en: Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the atmosphere.
examples.zh: 植物从大气中吸收二氧化碳。

examples.en: The new material can absorb up to 90% of the impact.
examples.zh: 这种新材料能吸收高达90%的冲击力。

examples.en: She was so absorbed in her book that she didn't hear the phone.
examples.zh: 她全神贯注于书本，没听到电话铃声。

abstract.collocations: abstract concept 抽象概念, abstract art 抽象艺术, abstract noun 抽象名词

examples.en: The idea of freedom is an abstract concept.
examples.zh: 自由的概念是一个抽象概念。

examples.en: He wrote an abstract of the research paper.
examples.zh: 他写了研究论文的摘要。

examples.en: The artist's work is known for its abstract style.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家的作品以其抽象风格而闻名。

abundant.collocations: abundant resources 丰富的资源, abundant evidence 充分的证据, abundant supply 充足的供应

examples.en: The region has abundant natural resources.
examples.zh: 该地区拥有丰富的自然资源。

examples.en: There is abundant evidence to support the theory.
examples.zh: 有充分的证据支持这一理论。

examples.en: The country enjoys an abundant supply of fresh water.
examples.zh: 这个国家有充足的淡水供应。

abuse.collocations: drug abuse 药物滥用, child abuse 虐待儿童, abuse of power 滥用权力

examples.en: The government is taking measures to prevent drug abuse.
examples.zh: 政府正在采取措施防止药物滥用。

examples.en: He was accused of child abuse.
examples.zh: 他被指控虐待儿童。

examples.en: The manager was fired for abuse of power.
examples.zh: 经理因滥用权力被解雇。

academic.collocations: academic performance 学业表现, academic research 学术研究, academic year 学年

examples.en: Her academic performance has been excellent throughout the year.
examples.zh: 她整年的学业表现都很优秀。

examples.en: The university is known for its academic research.
examples.zh: 这所大学以其学术研究而闻名。

examples.en: He is a respected academic in the field of economics.
examples.zh: 他是经济学领域备受尊敬的学者。

accelerate.collocations: accelerate economic growth 加速经济增长, accelerate the process 加速进程, accelerate change 加速变化

examples.en: The new policy aims to accelerate economic growth.
examples.zh: 新政策旨在加速经济增长。

examples.en: The car accelerated quickly when the light turned green.
examples.zh: 绿灯亮时，汽车迅速加速。

examples.en: Technology has accelerated the pace of change in society.
examples.zh: 技术加速了社会变化的步伐。

access.collocations: have access to 能够使用/获得, access information 获取信息, access the internet 访问互联网

examples.en: Students have free access to the library.
examples.zh: 学生可以免费使用图书馆。

examples.en: The software allows users to access data remotely.
examples.zh: 该软件允许用户远程访问数据。

examples.en: Only authorized personnel have access to the building.
examples.zh: 只有授权人员才能进入大楼。

accommodate.collocations: accommodate guests 容纳客人, accommodate changes 适应变化, accommodate needs 满足需求

examples.en: The hotel can accommodate up to 500 guests.
examples.zh: 这家酒店最多可容纳500位客人。

examples.en: The new policy aims to accommodate the needs of disabled people.
examples.zh: 新政策旨在满足残疾人的需求。

examples.en: We need to accommodate our schedule to the new requirements.
examples.zh: 我们需要调整日程以适应新要求。

accompany.collocations: accompany someone 陪伴某人, accompany a meal 佐餐, accompany a singer 为歌手伴奏

examples.en: Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult.
examples.zh: 12岁以下儿童必须由成人陪同。

examples.en: The report was accompanied by a detailed analysis.
examples.zh: 报告附有详细的分析。

examples.en: She accompanied the singer on the piano.
examples.zh: 她用钢琴为歌手伴奏。

accomplish.collocations: accomplish a goal 实现目标, accomplish a task 完成任务, accomplish a mission 完成使命

examples.en: She accomplished her goal of running a marathon.
examples.zh: 她实现了跑马拉松的目标。

examples.en: The team accomplished the project ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 团队提前完成了项目。

examples.en: He felt a sense of pride after accomplishing the difficult task.
examples.zh: 完成这项艰巨任务后，他感到自豪。

accumulate.collocations: accumulate wealth 积累财富, accumulate experience 积累经验, accumulate data 积累数据

examples.en: Over the years, he accumulated a large fortune.
examples.zh: 多年来，他积累了大量财富。

examples.en: The company has accumulated valuable experience in the market.
examples.zh: 该公司在市场上积累了宝贵的经验。

examples.en: Dust accumulates quickly on the shelves if not cleaned regularly.
examples.zh: 如果不定期清洁，架子上很快就会积灰。

accurate.collocations: accurate information 准确信息, accurate measurement 精确测量, accurate description 准确描述

examples.en: It is important to provide accurate information in your report.
examples.zh: 在报告中提供准确信息很重要。

examples.en: The measurement needs to be accurate to within 0.1 mm.
examples.zh: 测量需要精确到0.1毫米以内。

examples.en: Her description of the event was accurate in every detail.
examples.zh: 她对事件的描述在每一个细节上都准确无误。

achieve.collocations: achieve success 取得成功, achieve a goal 实现目标, achieve results 取得成果

examples.en: She worked hard to achieve her dream of becoming a doctor.
examples.zh: 她努力实现了成为医生的梦想。

examples.en: The company achieved record profits this year.
examples.zh: 公司今年取得了创纪录的利润。

examples.en: With determination, you can achieve anything you set your mind to.
examples.zh: 只要有决心，你就能实现任何目标。

acknowledge.collocations: acknowledge a problem 承认问题, acknowledge receipt 确认收到, acknowledge contributions 感谢贡献

examples.en: The government acknowledged the need for reform.
examples.zh: 政府承认了改革的必要性。

examples.en: Please acknowledge receipt of this email.
examples.zh: 请确认收到此邮件。

examples.en: The author acknowledged the help of her colleagues in the preface.
examples.zh: 作者在序言中感谢了同事们的帮助。

acquire.collocations: acquire knowledge 获得知识, acquire a skill 掌握技能, acquire a company 收购公司

examples.en: Children acquire language naturally through exposure.
examples.zh: 儿童通过接触自然习得语言。

examples.en: The company acquired a smaller competitor last year.
examples.zh: 该公司去年收购了一家较小的竞争对手。

examples.en: She acquired a taste for classical music over time.
examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，她培养了对古典音乐的爱好。

adapt.collocations: adapt to change 适应变化, adapt a novel 改编小说, adapt to new environment 适应新环境

examples.en: Animals must adapt to their environment to survive.
examples.zh: 动物必须适应环境才能生存。

examples.en: The movie was adapted from a best-selling novel.
examples.zh: 这部电影改编自一部畅销小说。

examples.en: It took her a while to adapt to the new job.
examples.zh: 她花了一段时间才适应新工作。

adequate.collocations: adequate supply 充足供应, adequate preparation 充分准备, adequate funding 足够资金

examples.en: The city has an adequate supply of clean water.
examples.zh: 该市有充足的清洁水供应。

examples.en: Make sure you get adequate sleep before the exam.
examples.zh: 考试前确保有充足的睡眠。

examples.en: The funding is not adequate to complete the project.
examples.zh: 资金不足以完成该项目。

adhere.collocations: adhere to 遵守, adhere to principles 坚持原则, adhere to the rules 遵守规则

examples.en: The glue must adhere to the surface for the repair to be effective.
examples.zh: 胶水必须黏附在表面上，修复才能有效。

examples.en: All participants must adhere to the competition guidelines.
examples.zh: 所有参赛者必须遵守比赛规则。

examples.en: She adheres to a strict diet to maintain her health.
examples.zh: 她坚持严格的饮食以保持健康。

adjust.collocations: adjust to 适应, adjust the settings 调整设置, adjust one's attitude 调整态度

examples.en: It took him a few weeks to adjust to the new time zone.
examples.zh: 他花了几周时间适应新的时区。

examples.en: You can adjust the volume using the remote control.
examples.zh: 你可以用遥控器调节音量。

examples.en: The company adjusted its strategy to meet market demands.
examples.zh: 公司调整了策略以满足市场需求。

administer.collocations: administer a test 主持考试, administer the law 执行法律, administer medicine 给药

examples.en: The nurse will administer the vaccine to all patients.
examples.zh: 护士将给所有患者接种疫苗。

examples.en: It is the duty of the court to administer justice.
examples.zh: 法院的职责是执行司法。

examples.en: The committee administers the funds for the project.
examples.zh: 委员会管理该项目的资金。

adopt.collocations: adopt a child 收养孩子, adopt a policy 采纳政策, adopt a new approach 采用新方法

examples.en: The couple decided to adopt a child from an orphanage.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇决定从孤儿院收养一个孩子。

examples.en: The school adopted a new curriculum to improve student outcomes.
examples.zh: 学校采用了新课程以提高学生成绩。

examples.en: The committee adopted the proposal unanimously.
examples.zh: 委员会一致通过了该提案。

advance.collocations: in advance 提前, advance technology 先进技术, advance payment 预付款

examples.en: The army advanced towards the enemy lines.
examples.zh: 军队向敌军防线推进。

examples.en: You need to book tickets in advance for the concert.
examples.zh: 你需要提前预订音乐会的门票。

examples.en: Recent advances in medicine have saved many lives.
examples.zh: 医学的最新进展挽救了许多生命。

advantage.collocations: take advantage of 利用, have an advantage 有优势, competitive advantage 竞争优势

examples.en: Being bilingual is a great advantage in the job market.
examples.zh: 双语能力在就业市场上是一个很大的优势。

examples.en: He took advantage of the sale to buy a new laptop.
examples.zh: 他利用促销活动买了一台新笔记本电脑。

examples.en: The team's experience gave them an advantage over their opponents.
examples.zh: 该队的经验使他们比对手更有优势。

adverse.collocations: adverse effects 副作用, adverse conditions 不利条件, adverse reaction 不良反应

examples.en: The drug may cause adverse side effects in some patients.
examples.zh: 这种药物可能会对一些患者产生不良副作用。

examples.en: The project was delayed due to adverse weather conditions.
examples.zh: 由于不利的天气条件，项目被推迟了。

examples.en: Adverse criticism can sometimes be constructive.
examples.zh: 反对的批评有时可能具有建设性。

advocate.collocations: advocate for 提倡, strong advocate 坚定支持者, advocate change 倡导变革

examples.en: Many environmentalists advocate for renewable energy sources.
examples.zh: 许多环保主义者提倡使用可再生能源。

examples.en: She is a strong advocate of equal rights for all.
examples.zh: 她是人人平等权利的坚定支持者。

examples.en: The lawyer advocated on behalf of his client.
examples.zh: 律师代表他的当事人进行辩护。

affect.collocations: affect the outcome 影响结果, be affected by 受…影响, affect one's mood 影响情绪

examples.en: The economic crisis affected millions of people worldwide.
examples.zh: 经济危机影响了全球数百万人。

examples.en: Her speech deeply affected the audience.
examples.zh: 她的演讲深深打动了观众。

examples.en: He affected a British accent to impress his friends.
examples.zh: 他假装英国口音以给朋友留下印象。

afford.collocations: afford to do 负担得起做, can afford 买得起, afford an opportunity 提供机会

examples.en: We cannot afford to waste any more time.
examples.zh: 我们不能再浪费时间了。

examples.en: The scholarship enabled him to afford a university education.
examples.zh: 奖学金使他能够负担得起大学教育。

examples.en: The balcony affords a beautiful view of the city.
examples.zh: 阳台提供了城市的美景。

aggressive.definition: 侵略的；好斗的；有进取心的
aggressive.collocations: aggressive behavior 攻击性行为, aggressive marketing 积极营销, aggressive approach 激进方法

examples.en: The dog became aggressive when strangers approached.
examples.zh: 当陌生人靠近时，这只狗变得具有攻击性。

examples.en: The company adopted an aggressive marketing strategy to boost sales.
examples.zh: 公司采取了积极的营销策略以促进销售。

examples.en: His aggressive style of play often leads to fouls.
examples.zh: 他侵略性的打法经常导致犯规。

alleviate.collocations: alleviate pain 减轻疼痛, alleviate poverty 缓解贫困, alleviate symptoms 缓解症状

examples.en: The medicine helped alleviate her headache.
examples.zh: 这种药帮助缓解了她的头痛。

examples.en: New policies were introduced to alleviate poverty in rural areas.
examples.zh: 出台了新政策以缓解农村地区的贫困。

examples.en: Exercise can alleviate stress and improve mood.
examples.zh: 锻炼可以缓解压力并改善情绪。

allocate.collocations: allocate resources 分配资源, allocate funds 拨出资金, allocate time 分配时间

examples.en: The government allocated funds for education reform.
examples.zh: 政府拨出资金用于教育改革。

examples.en: We need to allocate our time wisely to meet the deadline.
examples.zh: 我们需要合理分配时间以赶上截止日期。

examples.en: Each team was allocated a specific area to work on.
examples.zh: 每个团队被分配了一个特定的工作区域。

alternative.definition: 替代方案；替代的；另类的
alternative.collocations: alternative energy 替代能源, alternative solution 替代方案, have no alternative 别无选择

examples.en: Solar power is a clean alternative to fossil fuels.
examples.zh: 太阳能是化石燃料的清洁替代品。

examples.en: We need to find an alternative route due to the road closure.
examples.zh: 由于道路封闭，我们需要找到一条替代路线。

examples.en: He had no alternative but to accept the job offer.
examples.zh: 他别无选择，只能接受这份工作。

ambitious.definition: 有雄心的；野心勃勃的；宏大的
ambitious.collocations: ambitious plan 雄心勃勃的计划, ambitious goal 远大目标, ambitious person 有抱负的人

examples.en: She is an ambitious young woman who aims to become a CEO.
examples.zh: 她是一个有抱负的年轻女性，目标是成为CEO。

examples.en: The company has ambitious plans for expansion overseas.
examples.zh: 公司有雄心勃勃的海外扩张计划。

examples.en: His ambitious project required a lot of funding and effort.
examples.zh: 他宏大的项目需要大量资金和努力。

analyse.collocations: analyse data 分析数据, analyse the situation 分析情况, analyse results 分析结果

examples.en: Scientists are analysing the samples to find a cure.
examples.zh: 科学家正在分析样本以寻找治疗方法。

examples.en: We need to analyse the market trends before making a decision.
examples.zh: 在做出决定之前，我们需要分析市场趋势。

examples.en: The report analyses the impact of climate change on agriculture.
examples.zh: 该报告分析了气候变化对农业的影响。

ancient.collocations: ancient civilization 古代文明, ancient history 古代史, ancient ruins 古代遗址

examples.en: The ancient ruins attract thousands of tourists every year.
examples.zh: 古代遗址每年吸引成千上万的游客。

examples.en: He studied ancient Greek philosophy at university.
examples.zh: 他在大学学习了古希腊哲学。

examples.en: The tradition dates back to ancient times.
examples.zh: 这一传统可以追溯到古代。

annual.collocations: annual report 年度报告, annual meeting 年会, annual income 年收入

examples.en: The company publishes its annual report in March.
examples.zh: 公司在三月份发布年度报告。

examples.en: We hold an annual conference to discuss industry trends.
examples.zh: 我们每年举行一次会议讨论行业趋势。

examples.en: Her annual income has increased significantly this year.
examples.zh: 她的年收入今年显著增加。

anticipate.collocations: anticipate problems 预见问题, anticipate demand 预期需求, anticipate changes 预期变化

examples.en: We anticipate a rise in sales next quarter.
examples.zh: 我们预计下个季度销售额会上升。

examples.en: The team anticipated the opponent's moves and won the game.
examples.zh: 团队预判了对手的动作并赢得了比赛。

examples.en: It is difficult to anticipate all the consequences of the new policy.
examples.zh: 很难预料新政策的所有后果。

apparent.definition: 明显的；表面上的；显然的
apparent.collocations: apparent reason 明显原因, become apparent 变得明显, apparent contradiction 明显矛盾

examples.en: It was apparent that she was upset about the decision.
examples.zh: 很明显，她对这一决定感到不安。

examples.en: The apparent cause of the accident was driver error.
examples.zh: 事故的表面原因是司机失误。

examples.en: The benefits of the new system are not yet apparent.
examples.zh: 新系统的好处尚不明显。

appeal.collocations: appeal to 吸引，appeal for 呼吁，make an appeal 提出上诉

examples.en: The new policy appeals to young voters.
examples.zh: 新政策吸引了年轻选民。

examples.en: The charity made an appeal for donations.
examples.zh: 慈善机构呼吁捐款。

examples.en: He decided to appeal the court's decision.
examples.zh: 他决定对法院的判决提出上诉。

application.collocations: job application 求职申请，application form 申请表，practical application 实际应用

examples.en: She submitted her job application online.
examples.zh: 她在网上提交了求职申请。

examples.en: The application of this technology is widespread.
examples.zh: 这项技术的应用很广泛。

examples.en: This software application is user-friendly.
examples.zh: 这个软件应用程序很用户友好。

apply.collocations: apply for 申请，apply to 适用于，apply oneself 专心致志

examples.en: He applied for a scholarship to study abroad.
examples.zh: 他申请了出国留学的奖学金。

examples.en: The rules apply to all employees.
examples.zh: 这些规则适用于所有员工。

examples.en: You need to apply yourself to your studies.
examples.zh: 你需要专心学习。

appoint.collocations: appoint as 任命为，appoint to 指派到，appoint a time 约定时间

examples.en: The board appointed her as the new CEO.
examples.zh: 董事会任命她为新CEO。

examples.en: He was appointed to the committee.
examples.zh: 他被指派到委员会。

examples.en: Let's appoint a time for the meeting.
examples.zh: 我们约定一个会议时间吧。

appreciate.collocations: appreciate the value 重视价值，appreciate your help 感谢帮助，appreciate the difference 理解差异

examples.en: I really appreciate your assistance.
examples.zh: 我非常感谢你的帮助。

examples.en: She appreciates classical music.
examples.zh: 她欣赏古典音乐。

examples.en: It's important to appreciate cultural differences.
examples.zh: 理解文化差异很重要。

approach.collocations: approach to 方法，new approach 新方法，approach a problem 处理问题

examples.en: We need a new approach to solving this issue.
examples.zh: 我们需要一种新方法来解决这个问题。

examples.en: The deadline is approaching quickly.
examples.zh: 截止日期正在迅速接近。

examples.en: She approached the problem with caution.
examples.zh: 她谨慎地处理这个问题。

appropriate.collocations: appropriate for 适合，appropriate time 合适的时间，appropriate behavior 适当的行为

examples.en: This dress is appropriate for the occasion.
examples.zh: 这件裙子适合这个场合。

examples.en: We need to find an appropriate solution.
examples.zh: 我们需要找到合适的解决方案。

examples.en: His comments were not appropriate.
examples.zh: 他的评论不恰当。

approve.collocations: approve of 赞成，approve a plan 批准计划，approve a budget 批准预算

examples.en: The committee approved the proposal.
examples.zh: 委员会批准了提案。

examples.en: I don't approve of his behavior.
examples.zh: 我不赞成他的行为。

examples.en: The budget was approved by the board.
examples.zh: 预算得到了董事会的批准。

artificial.collocations: artificial intelligence 人工智能，artificial light 人造光，artificial flavor 人工香料

examples.en: Artificial intelligence is transforming industries.
examples.zh: 人工智能正在改变各行各业。

examples.en: The flowers are artificial, not real.
examples.zh: 这些花是人造的，不是真的。

examples.en: The smile seemed artificial.
examples.zh: 那个微笑看起来很假。

assess.collocations: assess the situation 评估情况，assess risk 评估风险，assess performance 评估表现

examples.en: We need to assess the damage after the storm.
examples.zh: 我们需要评估暴风雨后的损失。

examples.en: Teachers assess students' progress regularly.
examples.zh: 老师定期评估学生的进步。

examples.en: It's difficult to assess the long-term effects.
examples.zh: 很难评估长期影响。

assign.collocations: assign to 分配给，assign a task 分配任务，assign homework 布置作业

examples.en: The teacher assigned a new project to the class.
examples.zh: 老师给班级分配了一个新项目。

examples.en: He was assigned to the marketing team.
examples.zh: 他被指派到市场团队。

examples.en: Each student was assigned a different topic.
examples.zh: 每个学生被分配了不同的主题。

assist.collocations: assist with 帮助，assist in 协助，assist someone 帮助某人

examples.en: Can you assist me with this task?
examples.zh: 你能帮我完成这个任务吗？

examples.en: The software assists in data analysis.
examples.zh: 这个软件辅助数据分析。

examples.en: She assisted the elderly woman across the street.
examples.zh: 她帮助那位老妇人过马路。

associate.collocations: associate with 与…联系，business associate 商业伙伴，associate degree 副学士学位

examples.en: I associate this smell with my childhood.
examples.zh: 我把这种气味与童年联系起来。

examples.en: He is a close associate of the CEO.
examples.zh: 他是CEO的亲密同事。

examples.en: We should not associate with dishonest people.
examples.zh: 我们不应该与不诚实的人交往。

assume.collocations: assume responsibility 承担责任，assume that 假设，assume a role 担任角色

examples.en: I assume you have read the instructions.
examples.zh: 我假设你已经阅读了说明。

examples.en: She assumed the role of team leader.
examples.zh: 她担任了团队领导的角色。

examples.en: He assumed responsibility for the mistake.
examples.zh: 他承担了错误的责任。

atmosphere.collocations: atmosphere of 氛围，friendly atmosphere 友好的氛围，atmospheric pressure 大气压力

examples.en: The restaurant has a cozy atmosphere.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅有舒适的氛围。

examples.en: The Earth's atmosphere protects us from radiation.
examples.zh: 地球的大气层保护我们免受辐射。

examples.en: A tense atmosphere filled the room.
examples.zh: 房间里充满了紧张的气氛。

attach.collocations: attach to 附属于，attach importance to 重视，attach a file 附上文件

examples.en: Please attach your resume to the email.
examples.zh: 请将简历附在邮件中。

examples.en: He is very attached to his family.
examples.zh: 他非常依恋他的家庭。

examples.en: We attach great importance to education.
examples.zh: 我们非常重视教育。

attempt.collocations: attempt to 尝试，make an attempt 尝试，attempt at 企图

examples.en: She attempted to solve the puzzle.
examples.zh: 她尝试解开这个谜题。

examples.en: His first attempt was unsuccessful.
examples.zh: 他的第一次尝试没有成功。

examples.en: They made an attempt to climb the mountain.
examples.zh: 他们尝试攀登那座山。

attitude.collocations: attitude towards 对…的态度，positive attitude 积极态度，change attitude 改变态度

examples.en: She has a positive attitude towards life.
examples.zh: 她对生活有积极的态度。

examples.en: His attitude towards work is very professional.
examples.zh: 他对工作的态度非常专业。

examples.en: We need to change our attitude about failure.
examples.zh: 我们需要改变对失败的态度。

attract.collocations: attract attention 吸引注意，attract tourists 吸引游客，attract investment 吸引投资

examples.en: The bright colors attract children.
examples.zh: 鲜艳的颜色吸引孩子。

examples.en: The city attracts many tourists every year.
examples.zh: 这个城市每年吸引许多游客。

examples.en: His speech attracted a lot of attention.
examples.zh: 他的演讲引起了很多关注。

authority.collocations: authority over 对…的权威，local authority 地方当局，have authority 有权威

examples.en: The government has the authority to enforce laws.
examples.zh: 政府有权执行法律。

examples.en: She is an authority on ancient history.
examples.zh: 她是古代史的权威。

examples.en: You need permission from the local authority.
examples.zh: 你需要得到地方当局的许可。

available.definition: 可用的；有效的；可获得的
available.collocations: available resources 可用资源, available information 可用信息, readily available 容易获得

examples.en: The report is now available online for all students.
examples.zh: 这份报告现在可供所有学生在线查阅。

examples.en: We must make the best use of the available resources.
examples.zh: 我们必须充分利用可用的资源。

examples.en: Are there any available seats on the next flight?
examples.zh: 下一班航班还有空位吗？

aware.definition: 意识到的；知道的；察觉的
aware.collocations: become aware of 意识到, fully aware 充分意识到, raise awareness 提高意识

examples.en: People are becoming more aware of environmental issues.
examples.zh: 人们越来越意识到环境问题。

examples.en: She was fully aware of the risks involved in the project.
examples.zh: 她完全意识到项目中涉及的风险。

examples.en: The campaign aims to raise awareness about mental health.
examples.zh: 该运动旨在提高人们对心理健康的意识。

barrier.collocations: language barrier 语言障碍, trade barrier 贸易壁垒, barrier to entry 进入壁垒

examples.en: Language can be a major barrier to communication.
examples.zh: 语言可能是沟通的主要障碍。

examples.en: The government removed trade barriers to boost the economy.
examples.zh: 政府取消了贸易壁垒以促进经济。

examples.en: Lack of education is a barrier to social mobility.
examples.zh: 缺乏教育是社会流动的障碍。

behaviour.collocations: consumer behaviour 消费者行为, social behaviour 社会行为, behaviour pattern 行为模式

examples.en: The study focuses on consumer behaviour in online shopping.
examples.zh: 这项研究关注在线购物中的消费者行为。

examples.en: His behaviour at the meeting was considered inappropriate.
examples.zh: 他在会议上的行为被认为不合适。

examples.en: Animal behaviour can be influenced by environmental changes.
examples.zh: 动物行为可能受到环境变化的影响。

benefit.collocations: economic benefit 经济效益, mutual benefit 互利, benefit from 从……受益

examples.en: Regular exercise has many health benefits.
examples.zh: 定期锻炼对健康有很多好处。

examples.en: Both parties can benefit from this agreement.
examples.zh: 双方都可以从这项协议中受益。

examples.en: The new policy will bring long-term benefits to the community.
examples.zh: 新政策将为社区带来长期利益。

budget.collocations: budget deficit 预算赤字, budget plan 预算计划, within budget 在预算内

examples.en: The project was completed within the allocated budget.
examples.zh: 该项目在分配的预算内完成。

examples.en: We need to budget carefully for the upcoming expenses.
examples.zh: 我们需要为即将到来的开支仔细预算。

examples.en: The government announced a new budget for education.
examples.zh: 政府宣布了一项新的教育预算。

capable.definition: 有能力的；能干的；能够的
capable.collocations: capable of 能够, highly capable 能力很强, capable person 能干的人

examples.en: She is a highly capable manager who leads the team effectively.
examples.zh: 她是一位能力很强的经理，能有效领导团队。

examples.en: This machine is capable of processing large amounts of data.
examples.zh: 这台机器能够处理大量数据。

examples.en: He is capable of solving complex problems independently.
examples.zh: 他能够独立解决复杂问题。

capacity.collocations: production capacity 生产能力, carrying capacity 承载能力, capacity building 能力建设

examples.en: The stadium has a seating capacity of 50,000.
examples.zh: 这个体育场可容纳5万人。

examples.en: The factory is operating at full capacity to meet demand.
examples.zh: 工厂正满负荷运转以满足需求。

examples.en: The course aims to improve students' analytical capacity.
examples.zh: 该课程旨在提高学生的分析能力。

category.collocations: age category 年龄类别, product category 产品类别, fall into a category 属于某一类

examples.en: The books are divided into several categories based on genre.
examples.zh: 这些书根据体裁分为几类。

examples.en: This problem falls into the category of environmental issues.
examples.zh: 这个问题属于环境问题的范畴。

examples.en: The survey includes questions about income category.
examples.zh: 调查包括关于收入类别的问题。

cause.collocations: root cause 根本原因, cause and effect 因果, cause concern 引起关注

examples.en: The cause of the accident is still under investigation.
examples.zh: 事故的原因仍在调查中。

examples.en: Pollution can cause serious health problems.
examples.zh: 污染可能导致严重的健康问题。

examples.en: She devoted her life to the cause of education.
examples.zh: 她一生致力于教育事业。

challenge.collocations: face a challenge 面临挑战, challenge the status quo 挑战现状, major challenge 重大挑战

examples.en: Climate change is one of the greatest challenges of our time.
examples.zh: 气候变化是我们时代最大的挑战之一。

examples.en: She decided to challenge herself by learning a new language.
examples.zh: 她决定通过学习一门新语言来挑战自己。

examples.en: The new policy challenges traditional approaches to education.
examples.zh: 新政策挑战了传统的教育方法。

characteristic.collocations: distinctive characteristic 显著特征, characteristic feature 典型特征, share characteristics 共有特征

examples.en: One characteristic of urban life is the fast pace.
examples.zh: 城市生活的一个特点是快节奏。

examples.en: The characteristic taste of this dish comes from local spices.
examples.zh: 这道菜的典型味道来自当地香料。

examples.en: The study identified several characteristics of successful entrepreneurs.
examples.zh: 该研究确定了成功企业家的几个特征。

circumstance.collocations: under no circumstances 决不, in certain circumstances 在某些情况下, financial circumstances 财务状况

examples.en: Under no circumstances should you reveal your password.
examples.zh: 在任何情况下你都不应该透露密码。

examples.en: The decision was made based on the unique circumstances of the case.
examples.zh: 这个决定是基于案件的独特情况做出的。

examples.en: His family's financial circumstances forced him to work part-time.
examples.zh: 他的家庭财务状况迫使他做兼职。

claim.collocations: claim responsibility 声称负责, claim compensation 索赔, make a claim 提出主张

examples.en: The company claimed that their product was environmentally friendly.
examples.zh: 该公司声称他们的产品是环保的。

examples.en: She filed a claim for damages after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故发生后她提出了损害赔偿要求。

examples.en: The scientist's claim was supported by strong evidence.
examples.zh: 这位科学家的主张得到了有力证据的支持。

climate.collocations: climate change 气候变化, economic climate 经济气候, political climate 政治气候

examples.en: Climate change is a global issue that requires immediate action.
examples.zh: 气候变化是一个需要立即采取行动的全球性问题。

examples.en: The current economic climate is challenging for small businesses.
examples.zh: 当前的经济气候对小企业来说充满挑战。

examples.en: A positive school climate can enhance student learning.
examples.zh: 积极的学校氛围可以促进学生学习。

collapse.collocations: building collapse 建筑倒塌, economic collapse 经济崩溃, mental collapse 精神崩溃

examples.en: The bridge collapsed due to structural failure.
examples.zh: 这座桥因结构故障而倒塌。

examples.en: The company's financial collapse led to massive job losses.
examples.zh: 公司的财务崩溃导致了大量失业。

examples.en: He suffered a mental collapse after years of stress.
examples.zh: 经过多年的压力，他精神崩溃了。

combine.collocations: combine with 与……结合, combine efforts 共同努力, combine theory and practice 理论与实践结合

examples.en: The two companies combined to form a larger corporation.
examples.zh: 这两家公司合并形成了一个更大的企业。

examples.en: This course combines theory with practical experience.
examples.zh: 这门课程将理论与实践相结合。

examples.en: We need to combine our efforts to solve this problem.
examples.zh: 我们需要共同努力来解决这个问题。

communicate.collocations: communicate effectively 有效沟通, communicate with 与……交流, communicate ideas 传达想法

examples.en: It is important to communicate clearly in a team.
examples.zh: 在团队中清晰沟通很重要。

examples.en: She communicated her concerns to the manager.
examples.zh: 她向经理表达了自己的担忧。

examples.en: Animals communicate through sounds and body language.
examples.zh: 动物通过声音和肢体语言交流。

community.collocations: local community 当地社区, community service 社区服务, international community 国际社会

examples.en: The local community organized a charity event.
examples.zh: 当地社区组织了一场慈善活动。

examples.en: Community service is a requirement for graduation.
examples.zh: 社区服务是毕业的要求之一。

examples.en: The international community must work together to address global issues.
examples.zh: 国际社会必须共同努力解决全球性问题。

compare.collocations: compare with 与……比较, compare to 比作, compare and contrast 比较和对比

examples.en: The study compares the education systems of different countries.
examples.zh: 这项研究比较了不同国家的教育体系。

examples.en: Life is often compared to a journey.
examples.zh: 人生常被比作一段旅程。

examples.en: When you compare the two products, the difference is clear.
examples.zh: 当你比较这两种产品时，差异很明显。

compensate.collocations: compensate for 补偿..., compensate sb for sth 因...赔偿某人, compensate with 以...补偿

examples.en: The company must compensate workers for their injuries.
examples.zh: 公司必须赔偿工人的工伤。

examples.en: Hard work can compensate for a lack of talent.
examples.zh: 勤奋可以弥补天赋的不足。

examples.en: The government compensated farmers for the loss of their crops.
examples.zh: 政府补偿了农民的作物损失。

compete.collocations: compete with 与...竞争, compete for 争夺..., compete in 参加...比赛

examples.en: Small businesses often struggle to compete with large corporations.
examples.zh: 小企业常常难以与大公司竞争。

examples.en: Many athletes compete for a gold medal in the Olympics.
examples.zh: 许多运动员在奥运会上争夺金牌。

examples.en: Students compete in various academic contests.
examples.zh: 学生们参加各种学术竞赛。

complex.collocations: complex system 复杂系统, complex problem 复杂问题, complex structure 复杂结构

examples.en: The human brain is an incredibly complex organ.
examples.zh: 人类大脑是一个极其复杂的器官。

examples.en: Solving this complex equation requires advanced math skills.
examples.zh: 解这个复杂方程需要高级数学技能。

examples.en: The company has a complex organizational structure.
examples.zh: 这家公司有复杂的组织结构。

component.collocations: key component 关键组成部分, essential component 必要成分, electronic component 电子元件

examples.en: Trust is a key component of any successful relationship.
examples.zh: 信任是任何成功关系的关键组成部分。

examples.en: The engine consists of many different components.
examples.zh: 发动机由许多不同的部件组成。

examples.en: Each component of the system must be tested individually.
examples.zh: 系统的每个组件都必须单独测试。

comprehensive.collocations: comprehensive review 全面审查, comprehensive plan 综合计划, comprehensive education 全面教育

examples.en: The report provides a comprehensive analysis of the market.
examples.zh: 该报告对市场进行了全面分析。

examples.en: A comprehensive health check-up is recommended annually.
examples.zh: 建议每年进行一次全面的健康检查。

examples.en: The university offers a comprehensive range of courses.
examples.zh: 这所大学提供广泛的课程。

concentrate.collocations: concentrate on 专注于..., concentrate effort 集中精力, concentrate attention 集中注意力

examples.en: I need to concentrate on my studies for the exam.
examples.zh: 我需要集中精力准备考试。

examples.en: The government should concentrate its efforts on reducing poverty.
examples.zh: 政府应集中精力减少贫困。

examples.en: The orange juice is concentrated to save shipping costs.
examples.zh: 橙汁被浓缩以节省运输成本。

concept.collocations: basic concept 基本概念, key concept 关键概念, marketing concept 营销理念

examples.en: The concept of democracy originated in ancient Greece.
examples.zh: 民主的概念起源于古希腊。

examples.en: Students must understand the basic concepts of physics.
examples.zh: 学生必须理解物理的基本概念。

examples.en: The new marketing concept boosted sales significantly.
examples.zh: 新的营销理念显著提升了销售额。

concern.collocations: concern about 对...的担忧, concern with 与...有关, express concern 表达关切

examples.en: There is growing concern about climate change.
examples.zh: 人们对气候变化的担忧日益增加。

examples.en: This matter concerns the safety of all employees.
examples.zh: 这件事关系到所有员工的安全。

examples.en: The government expressed concern over the rising unemployment rate.
examples.zh: 政府对失业率上升表示关切。

conclude.collocations: conclude that 得出结论..., conclude with 以...结束, conclude an agreement 缔结协议

examples.en: The study concluded that exercise improves mental health.
examples.zh: 研究得出结论，锻炼能改善心理健康。

examples.en: The meeting concluded with a vote on the proposal.
examples.zh: 会议以对该提案的投票结束。

examples.en: The two countries concluded a trade agreement.
examples.zh: 两国缔结了一项贸易协定。

conduct.collocations: conduct research 进行研究, conduct an experiment 进行实验, code of conduct 行为准则

examples.en: Scientists conduct experiments to test their hypotheses.
examples.zh: 科学家进行实验来检验假设。

examples.en: The company has a strict code of conduct for employees.
examples.zh: 公司有严格的员工行为准则。

examples.en: He conducted himself with dignity during the crisis.
examples.zh: 他在危机中表现得很有尊严。

conference.collocations: press conference 记者招待会, attend a conference 参加会议, international conference 国际会议

examples.en: The professor is attending a conference on climate change.
examples.zh: 教授正在参加一个关于气候变化的会议。

examples.en: The company held a press conference to announce the new product.
examples.zh: 公司召开记者招待会宣布新产品。

examples.en: The conference will bring together experts from around the world.
examples.zh: 这次会议将汇集来自世界各地的专家。

confident.collocations: confident in 对...有信心, confident about 对...有信心, feel confident 感到自信

examples.en: She is confident in her ability to succeed.
examples.zh: 她对自己成功的能力充满信心。

examples.en: The team is confident about winning the championship.
examples.zh: 球队对赢得冠军充满信心。

examples.en: He spoke in a confident tone during the presentation.
examples.zh: 他在演讲中语气自信。

confirm.collocations: confirm that 确认..., confirm a booking 确认预订, confirm a theory 证实理论

examples.en: Please confirm your attendance by email.
examples.zh: 请通过电子邮件确认您的出席。

examples.en: The test results confirmed the doctor's diagnosis.
examples.zh: 测试结果证实了医生的诊断。

examples.en: The committee confirmed his appointment as director.
examples.zh: 委员会批准了他担任主任的任命。

conflict.collocations: conflict of interest 利益冲突, armed conflict 武装冲突, resolve a conflict 解决冲突

examples.en: There is a conflict between work and family responsibilities.
examples.zh: 工作和家庭责任之间存在冲突。

examples.en: The two countries have been in armed conflict for years.
examples.zh: 两国多年来一直处于武装冲突中。

examples.en: Mediation can help resolve conflicts in the workplace.
examples.zh: 调解有助于解决工作场所的冲突。

consequence.collocations: as a consequence 因此, negative consequence 负面后果, face the consequences 承担后果

examples.en: As a consequence of the storm, many flights were cancelled.
examples.zh: 由于暴风雨，许多航班被取消。

examples.en: Every action has a consequence, good or bad.
examples.zh: 每个行为都有后果，无论好坏。

examples.en: He must face the consequences of his reckless behavior.
examples.zh: 他必须为自己的鲁莽行为承担后果。

conserve.collocations: conserve energy 节约能源, conserve resources 保护资源, conserve wildlife 保护野生动物

examples.en: We should conserve water during the drought.
examples.zh: 干旱期间我们应该节约用水。

examples.en: The organization works to conserve endangered species.
examples.zh: 该组织致力于保护濒危物种。

examples.en: Turning off lights helps conserve electricity.
examples.zh: 关灯有助于节约电力。

consider.collocations: consider doing 考虑做..., consider as 视为..., take into consideration 考虑到

examples.en: You should consider studying abroad for a year.
examples.zh: 你应该考虑出国留学一年。

examples.en: She is considered an expert in her field.
examples.zh: 她被认为是她所在领域的专家。

examples.en: We must consider the needs of all stakeholders.
examples.zh: 我们必须考虑所有利益相关者的需求。

consistent.definition: 一致的；始终如一的；连贯的
consistent.collocations: consistent with 与...一致, consistent performance 稳定的表现, consistent policy 一贯的政策

examples.en: His actions are not consistent with his words.
examples.zh: 他的言行不一致。

examples.en: The team has shown consistent performance throughout the season.
examples.zh: 球队在整个赛季中表现稳定。

examples.en: The government needs a consistent policy on education.
examples.zh: 政府需要一项连贯的教育政策。

constant.collocations: constant change 不断变化, constant pressure 持续压力, constant temperature 恒温

examples.en: The city is in a state of constant change.
examples.zh: 这座城市处于不断变化之中。

examples.en: He works under constant pressure to meet deadlines.
examples.zh: 他在持续的压力下工作以赶上截止日期。

examples.en: The laboratory maintains a constant temperature for experiments.
examples.zh: 实验室保持恒温以进行实验。

constitute.collocations: constitute a threat 构成威胁, constitute a part 构成一部分, constitute an offense 构成犯罪

examples.en: Women constitute a large proportion of the workforce.
examples.zh: 女性构成了劳动力的一大部分。

examples.en: This behavior constitutes a serious breach of trust.
examples.zh: 这种行为构成了严重的失信。

examples.en: The twelve months constitute a year.
examples.zh: 十二个月构成一年。

consume.collocations: consume energy 消耗能源, consume resources 消耗资源, consume food 消费食物

examples.en: Households consume a significant amount of electricity each month.
examples.zh: 家庭每月消耗大量电力。

examples.en: It is important to consume a balanced diet for good health.
examples.zh: 摄入均衡饮食对健康很重要。

examples.en: The fire quickly consumed the entire building.
examples.zh: 大火迅速吞噬了整栋建筑。

contact.collocations: make contact 取得联系, contact information 联系方式, physical contact 身体接触

examples.en: Please do not hesitate to contact me if you have any questions.
examples.zh: 如有任何问题，请随时联系我。

examples.en: The two companies established contact through a trade fair.
examples.zh: 这两家公司通过贸易博览会建立了联系。

examples.en: Avoid direct contact with the chemical to prevent injury.
examples.zh: 避免直接接触该化学品以防受伤。

contemporary.definition: 当代的，现代的；同时代的；同龄人
contemporary.collocations: contemporary art 当代艺术, contemporary society 当代社会, contemporary issues 当代问题

examples.en: Contemporary architecture often emphasizes sustainability and minimalism.
examples.zh: 当代建筑通常强调可持续性和极简主义。

examples.en: Shakespeare was a contemporary of Queen Elizabeth I.
examples.zh: 莎士比亚是伊丽莎白一世的同时代人。

examples.en: The museum displays both classical and contemporary works.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出古典和当代作品。

contribute.collocations: contribute to 有助于，促成, contribute money 捐款, contribute ideas 贡献想法

examples.en: Regular exercise contributes to better physical and mental health.
examples.zh: 定期锻炼有助于改善身心健康。

examples.en: Many volunteers contributed their time to the community project.
examples.zh: 许多志愿者为社区项目贡献了时间。

examples.en: She contributes articles to a popular science magazine.
examples.zh: 她为一家流行科学杂志撰稿。

controversy.collocations: cause controversy 引起争议, heated controversy 激烈的争论, political controversy 政治争议

examples.en: The new policy sparked a heated controversy among citizens.
examples.zh: 新政策在公民中引发了激烈的争论。

examples.en: There is ongoing controversy over the use of genetically modified crops.
examples.zh: 关于转基因作物的使用存在持续的争议。

examples.en: The artist's work often generates controversy due to its provocative nature.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家的作品因其挑衅性常常引发争议。

convenient.collocations: convenient location 便利的位置, convenient transportation 便利的交通, convenient for 对…方便

examples.en: Online shopping is convenient because you can buy things from home.
examples.zh: 网上购物很方便，因为你可以在家购物。

examples.en: The hotel is in a convenient location near the city center.
examples.zh: 酒店位于市中心附近，位置便利。

examples.en: Is it convenient for you to meet tomorrow afternoon?
examples.zh: 你明天下午见面方便吗？

convention.definition: 惯例，常规；大会，会议；公约
convention.collocations: social convention 社会习俗, international convention 国际公约, annual convention 年会

examples.en: It is a social convention to shake hands when meeting someone.
examples.zh: 见面握手是一种社会习俗。

examples.en: The United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child is widely recognized.
examples.zh: 联合国儿童权利公约得到广泛认可。

examples.en: Thousands of people attended the annual science fiction convention.
examples.zh: 数千人参加了年度科幻大会。

convince.collocations: convince sb of sth 使某人相信某事, convince sb to do sth 说服某人做某事, be convinced that 确信

examples.en: She convinced her parents to let her study abroad.
examples.zh: 她说服父母让她出国留学。

examples.en: The evidence convinced the jury of his innocence.
examples.zh: 证据使陪审团相信他是清白的。

examples.en: I am convinced that hard work leads to success.
examples.zh: 我深信努力工作会带来成功。

cooperate.collocations: cooperate with 与…合作, cooperate closely 紧密合作, cooperate on a project 合作项目

examples.en: The two countries agreed to cooperate on environmental issues.
examples.zh: 两国同意在环境问题上合作。

examples.en: Team members must cooperate to achieve the common goal.
examples.zh: 团队成员必须合作以实现共同目标。

examples.en: The police asked the public to cooperate with the investigation.
examples.zh: 警方要求公众配合调查。

coordinate.collocations: coordinate efforts 协调努力, coordinate activities 协调活动, coordinate with 与…协调

examples.en: The manager coordinates the work of different departments.
examples.zh: 经理协调不同部门的工作。

examples.en: We need to coordinate our schedules to find a suitable meeting time.
examples.zh: 我们需要协调日程以找到合适的会议时间。

examples.en: The GPS provides the exact coordinates of the location.
examples.zh: GPS提供了该地点的精确坐标。

corporate.collocations: corporate culture 企业文化, corporate strategy 企业战略, corporate governance 公司治理

examples.en: A strong corporate culture can improve employee satisfaction.
examples.zh: 强大的企业文化可以提高员工满意度。

examples.en: The company revised its corporate strategy to focus on innovation.
examples.zh: 公司修订了企业战略，专注于创新。

examples.en: Corporate social responsibility is increasingly important for businesses.
examples.zh: 企业社会责任对企业越来越重要。

correspond.collocations: correspond to 与…对应, correspond with 与…通信, correspond exactly 完全相符

examples.en: The numbers on the map correspond to the buildings in the city.
examples.zh: 地图上的数字与城市中的建筑相对应。

examples.en: His actions do not correspond with his words.
examples.zh: 他的言行不一致。

examples.en: We have corresponded by email for several years.
examples.zh: 我们通过电子邮件通信已有几年了。

crucial.collocations: crucial role 关键作用, crucial factor 关键因素, crucial moment 关键时刻

examples.en: Education plays a crucial role in personal development.
examples.zh: 教育在个人发展中起着关键作用。

examples.en: Timely decision-making is crucial for business success.
examples.zh: 及时决策对商业成功至关重要。

examples.en: This is a crucial moment in the negotiation process.
examples.zh: 这是谈判过程中的关键时刻。

cultivate.collocations: cultivate skills 培养技能, cultivate relationships 培养关系, cultivate land 耕种土地

examples.en: Students should cultivate good study habits from an early age.
examples.zh: 学生应该从小培养良好的学习习惯。

examples.en: The farmer cultivates wheat on his land.
examples.zh: 农民在他的土地上种植小麦。

examples.en: Reading books can cultivate the mind.
examples.zh: 读书可以陶冶情操。

curriculum.collocations: school curriculum 学校课程, curriculum vitae 简历, core curriculum 核心课程

examples.en: The school curriculum includes both academic and extracurricular activities.
examples.zh: 学校课程包括学术和课外活动。

examples.en: The university updated its curriculum to meet industry demands.
examples.zh: 大学更新了课程以满足行业需求。

examples.en: Please attach your curriculum vitae to the application form.
examples.zh: 请将简历附在申请表后。

database.collocations: database management 数据库管理, database system 数据库系统, online database 在线数据库

examples.en: The company stores customer information in a secure database.
examples.zh: 公司将客户信息存储在安全的数据库中。

examples.en: Researchers can access the database to find relevant studies.
examples.zh: 研究人员可以访问数据库查找相关研究。

examples.en: Database management is a key skill for IT professionals.
examples.zh: 数据库管理是IT专业人员的关键技能。

debate.collocations: heated debate 激烈的辩论, public debate 公开辩论, debate over 关于…的辩论

examples.en: There is a heated debate over the new tax policy.
examples.zh: 关于新税收政策存在激烈的辩论。

examples.en: The students debated the pros and cons of social media.
examples.zh: 学生们就社交媒体的利弊进行了辩论。

examples.en: The issue is still under debate among experts.
examples.zh: 这个问题仍在专家中争论。

decade.collocations: over the past decade 过去十年, for decades 几十年, the next decade 未来十年

examples.en: Over the past decade, technology has advanced rapidly.
examples.zh: 过去十年，技术飞速发展。

examples.en: The company has been in business for decades.
examples.zh: 这家公司已经经营了几十年。

examples.en: We need to plan for the challenges of the next decade.
examples.zh: 我们需要为未来十年的挑战做规划。

decline.collocations: decline in 在…方面下降, economic decline 经济衰退, decline an offer 拒绝提议

examples.en: The population of the village has declined significantly.
examples.zh: 这个村庄的人口显著下降。

examples.en: She declined the invitation due to prior commitments.
examples.zh: 她因已有安排而拒绝了邀请。

examples.en: The company is experiencing a decline in sales.
examples.zh: 该公司正经历销售下滑。

define.collocations: define as 定义为, clearly define 明确定义, define the scope 界定范围

examples.en: Success can be defined in many different ways.
examples.zh: 成功可以用许多不同的方式来定义。

examples.en: The contract clearly defines the responsibilities of each party.
examples.zh: 合同明确界定了各方的责任。

examples.en: We need to define the scope of the project before starting.
examples.zh: 我们需要在开始前界定项目范围。

definite.collocations: definite answer 明确的答案, definite plan 确定的计划, definite improvement 明显的改善

examples.en: There is a definite link between smoking and lung cancer.
examples.zh: 吸烟和肺癌之间有明确的联系。

examples.en: We need a definite answer by tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我们明天之前需要明确的答复。

examples.en: The weather has shown a definite improvement this week.
examples.zh: 这周天气有了明显的改善。

demonstrate.collocations: demonstrate a theory 证明理论, demonstrate a product 演示产品, demonstrate against 抗议示威

examples.en: The experiment demonstrates that the theory is correct.
examples.zh: 实验证明了该理论是正确的。

examples.en: The salesperson demonstrated how the new machine works.
examples.zh: 销售人员演示了新机器如何工作。

examples.en: Thousands of people demonstrated against the new law.
examples.zh: 数千人示威反对新法律。

depict.collocations: depict a scene 描绘场景, depict a character 刻画人物, depict accurately 准确描述

examples.en: The painting depicts a beautiful landscape.
examples.zh: 这幅画描绘了美丽的风景。

examples.en: The novel depicts the life of a young artist.
examples.zh: 这部小说描述了一位年轻艺术家的生活。

examples.en: The statistics depict a worrying trend.
examples.zh: 这些数据描述了一个令人担忧的趋势。

deposit.collocations: deposit money 存钱, deposit a check 存入支票, make a deposit 付押金, bank deposit 银行存款

examples.en: I need to deposit this check into my account.
examples.zh: 我需要把这张支票存入我的账户。

examples.en: The landlord asked for a deposit of one month's rent.
examples.zh: 房东要求一个月的租金作为押金。

examples.en: Sediment deposits at the mouth of the river.
examples.zh: 沉积物在河口沉积。

derive.collocations: derive from 来源于, derive benefit 获得利益, derive pleasure 获得乐趣

examples.en: Many English words derive from Latin.
examples.zh: 许多英语单词源于拉丁语。

examples.en: She derives great satisfaction from her work.
examples.zh: 她从工作中获得极大的满足感。

examples.en: We can derive the formula from basic principles.
examples.zh: 我们可以从基本原理推导出这个公式。

deserve.collocations: deserve attention 值得关注, deserve respect 值得尊重, deserve a chance 值得给一个机会

examples.en: He deserves a promotion for his hard work.
examples.zh: 他工作努力，值得升职。

examples.en: This issue deserves serious consideration.
examples.zh: 这个问题值得认真考虑。

examples.en: She deserves to be happy.
examples.zh: 她应该得到幸福。

determine.collocations: determine the cause 确定原因, determine a policy 决定政策, determine the outcome 决定结果

examples.en: The test will determine your level of English.
examples.zh: 这次测试将决定你的英语水平。

examples.en: We need to determine the exact cost of the project.
examples.zh: 我们需要确定项目的确切成本。

examples.en: Your attitude determines your success.
examples.zh: 你的态度决定你的成功。

develop.collocations: develop a skill 培养技能, develop a country 发展国家, develop a disease 患病, develop a product 开发产品

examples.en: The company is developing a new software.
examples.zh: 这家公司正在开发一款新软件。

examples.en: She developed an interest in art at a young age.
examples.zh: 她从小就对艺术产生了兴趣。

examples.en: He developed a cough after the trip.
examples.zh: 旅行后他咳嗽了。

device.collocations: electronic device 电子设备, medical device 医疗设备, literary device 文学手法

examples.en: This device can measure your heart rate.
examples.zh: 这个设备可以测量你的心率。

examples.en: The bomb was attached to a timing device.
examples.zh: 炸弹连接了一个定时装置。

examples.en: Metaphor is a common literary device.
examples.zh: 隐喻是一种常见的文学手法。

devote.collocations: devote time to 投入时间于, devote oneself to 致力于, devote resources to 把资源用于

examples.en: She devotes all her free time to volunteering.
examples.zh: 她把所有空闲时间都用于志愿服务。

examples.en: He devoted himself to scientific research.
examples.zh: 他致力于科学研究。

examples.en: The government should devote more funds to education.
examples.zh: 政府应该把更多资金用于教育。

dimension.collocations: three dimensions 三维, new dimension 新维度, political dimension 政治方面

examples.en: Time is often considered the fourth dimension.
examples.zh: 时间通常被认为是第四维度。

examples.en: We need to consider the economic dimension of the problem.
examples.zh: 我们需要考虑问题的经济方面。

examples.en: The dimensions of the room are 5 by 4 meters.
examples.zh: 房间的尺寸是5米乘4米。

diminish.collocations: diminish in value 贬值, diminish the risk 降低风险, diminish someone's reputation 贬低某人的声誉

examples.en: The pain will diminish over time.
examples.zh: 疼痛会随着时间减轻。

examples.en: His influence has diminished in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年来他的影响力减弱了。

examples.en: Don't diminish her achievements by comparing them to others.
examples.zh: 不要通过与他人比较来贬低她的成就。

discipline.collocations: maintain discipline 维持纪律, academic discipline 学科, discipline yourself 自律, strict discipline 严格的纪律

examples.en: The teacher struggled to maintain discipline in the classroom.
examples.zh: 老师很难维持课堂纪律。

examples.en: Psychology is a fascinating discipline.
examples.zh: 心理学是一门迷人的学科。

examples.en: You need to discipline yourself to study regularly.
examples.zh: 你需要自律，定期学习。

discover.collocations: discover a new species 发现新物种, discover the truth 发现真相, discover a talent 发现才能

examples.en: Scientists have discovered a new planet.
examples.zh: 科学家发现了一颗新行星。

examples.en: She discovered that her phone was missing.
examples.zh: 她发现手机不见了。

examples.en: He discovered his passion for music at a young age.
examples.zh: 他年轻时发现了对音乐的热爱。

discrimination.collocations: racial discrimination 种族歧视, gender discrimination 性别歧视, price discrimination 价格歧视

examples.en: Laws prohibit discrimination based on race or gender.
examples.zh: 法律禁止基于种族或性别的歧视。

examples.en: He showed great discrimination in choosing the right wine.
examples.zh: 他在选择合适葡萄酒时表现出很好的辨别力。

examples.en: Price discrimination is common in the airline industry.
examples.zh: 价格歧视在航空业很常见。

display.collocations: display an item 展示物品, display emotions 表达情感, on display 展出, display screen 显示屏

examples.en: The museum displays a collection of ancient artifacts.
examples.zh: 博物馆展示了一批古代文物。

examples.en: He displayed great courage during the crisis.
examples.zh: 他在危机中表现出极大的勇气。

examples.en: The new smartphone has a stunning display.
examples.zh: 这款新智能手机有一个惊艳的显示屏。

distinct.collocations: distinct difference 明显区别, distinct advantage 明显优势, distinct possibility 明显的可能性

examples.en: There is a distinct difference between the two proposals.
examples.zh: 这两个提议有明显的区别。

examples.en: She has a distinct accent from the north.
examples.zh: 她有明显的北方口音。

examples.en: It is a distinct possibility that it will rain tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天很可能会下雨。

distinguish.collocations: distinguish between 区分, distinguish from 区别于, distinguish oneself 使自己脱颖而出

examples.en: It is hard to distinguish between the two twins.
examples.zh: 很难区分这对双胞胎。

examples.en: He distinguished himself as a great leader.
examples.zh: 他作为一名伟大的领袖而脱颖而出。

examples.en: Can you distinguish the original from the copy?
examples.zh: 你能区分原件和复印件吗？

distribute.collocations: distribute resources 分配资源, distribute leaflets 分发传单, distribute evenly 均匀分布

examples.en: The charity distributed food to the homeless.
examples.zh: 慈善机构向无家可归者分发食物。

examples.en: The company distributes its products worldwide.
examples.zh: 这家公司向全球分销其产品。

examples.en: The population is distributed unevenly across the country.
examples.zh: 人口在全国分布不均。

diverse.collocations: diverse cultures 多元文化, diverse backgrounds 不同背景, diverse range 广泛的范围

examples.en: The city has a diverse population.
examples.zh: 这个城市有多元化的人口。

examples.en: We need diverse opinions to make a good decision.
examples.zh: 我们需要不同的意见来做出好的决定。

examples.en: The company offers a diverse range of products.
examples.zh: 这家公司提供多样化的产品。

domestic.collocations: domestic market 国内市场, domestic violence 家庭暴力, domestic flight 国内航班

examples.en: The company focuses on expanding its domestic market.
examples.zh: 该公司专注于扩大其国内市场。

examples.en: Domestic violence is a serious social issue.
examples.zh: 家庭暴力是一个严重的社会问题。

examples.en: She prefers domestic flights for short trips.
examples.zh: 短途旅行她更喜欢国内航班。

dominant.definition: 占主导地位的；主要的；支配的
dominant.collocations: dominant role 主导角色, dominant species 优势物种, dominant position 主导地位

examples.en: The dominant theme of the conference was climate change.
examples.zh: 会议的主导主题是气候变化。

examples.en: In many ecosystems, a few species are dominant.
examples.zh: 在许多生态系统中，少数物种占主导地位。

examples.en: He played a dominant role in the negotiations.
examples.zh: 他在谈判中发挥了主导作用。

dominate.definition: 支配；控制；在…中占首要地位
dominate.collocations: dominate the market 主导市场, dominate the conversation 主导对话, dominate the game 主宰比赛

examples.en: The tech giant continues to dominate the global market.
examples.zh: 这家科技巨头继续主导全球市场。

examples.en: She tends to dominate the conversation in meetings.
examples.zh: 她在会议中往往主导对话。

examples.en: The team dominated the game from start to finish.
examples.zh: 这支球队从头到尾主宰了比赛。

duration.collocations: short duration 短期, long duration 长期, duration of stay 停留时间

examples.en: The course has a duration of six months.
examples.zh: 这门课程为期六个月。

examples.en: The duration of the flight is about three hours.
examples.zh: 飞行时间大约三个小时。

examples.en: The contract is for the duration of the project.
examples.zh: 合同在项目期间有效。

dynamic.definition: 动态的；有活力的；不断变化的
dynamic.collocations: dynamic economy 动态经济, dynamic system 动态系统, dynamic personality 充满活力的个性

examples.en: The city has a dynamic and growing economy.
examples.zh: 这座城市拥有充满活力和不断增长的经济。

examples.en: The team dynamic changed after the new manager arrived.
examples.zh: 新经理到来后，团队动态发生了变化。

examples.en: She is known for her dynamic leadership style.
examples.zh: 她以充满活力的领导风格而闻名。

economy.collocations: market economy 市场经济, global economy 全球经济, fuel economy 燃油经济性

examples.en: The government is taking steps to boost the economy.
examples.zh: 政府正在采取措施刺激经济。

examples.en: The country has a strong export-oriented economy.
examples.zh: 该国拥有强大的出口导向型经济。

examples.en: Driving at a steady speed improves fuel economy.
examples.zh: 以稳定速度行驶可提高燃油经济性。

eliminate.collocations: eliminate poverty 消除贫困, eliminate waste 消除浪费, eliminate the risk 消除风险

examples.en: The new policy aims to eliminate poverty in rural areas.
examples.zh: 新政策旨在消除农村地区的贫困。

examples.en: We need to eliminate unnecessary steps in the process.
examples.zh: 我们需要消除流程中不必要的步骤。

examples.en: The team was eliminated in the first round of the competition.
examples.zh: 该队在比赛第一轮就被淘汰了。

emerge.collocations: emerge from 从…中出现, emerge as 作为…出现, new technologies emerge 新技术出现

examples.en: New challenges emerge as the company grows.
examples.zh: 随着公司的发展，新的挑战出现了。

examples.en: The sun emerged from behind the clouds.
examples.zh: 太阳从云层后面露出来了。

examples.en: He emerged as a leader during the crisis.
examples.zh: 他在危机中脱颖而出成为领导者。

emphasis.collocations: place emphasis on 强调, strong emphasis 重点强调, shift emphasis 转移重点

examples.en: The school places great emphasis on academic achievement.
examples.zh: 学校非常重视学业成绩。

examples.en: There is a growing emphasis on environmental protection.
examples.zh: 人们越来越重视环境保护。

examples.en: The emphasis of the report is on economic growth.
examples.zh: 报告的重点是经济增长。

employ.collocations: employ workers 雇用工人, employ a method 使用一种方法, employ technology 运用技术

examples.en: The company employs over 500 people.
examples.zh: 该公司雇用了500多名员工。

examples.en: We need to employ a more efficient approach.
examples.zh: 我们需要采用更有效的方法。

examples.en: The study employed a variety of research methods.
examples.zh: 这项研究使用了多种研究方法。

enable.collocations: enable sb to do 使某人能够做, enable access 使能够访问, enable growth 促进增长

examples.en: Technology enables us to communicate instantly.
examples.zh: 技术使我们能够即时沟通。

examples.en: The scholarship enabled her to attend university.
examples.zh: 奖学金使她能够上大学。

examples.en: This software enables users to edit photos easily.
examples.zh: 这个软件使用户能够轻松编辑照片。

encounter.collocations: encounter problems 遇到问题, encounter difficulties 遇到困难, encounter resistance 遇到阻力

examples.en: We encountered several problems during the project.
examples.zh: 我们在项目过程中遇到了几个问题。

examples.en: She encountered an old friend at the conference.
examples.zh: 她在会议上遇到了一位老朋友。

examples.en: The proposal encountered strong opposition.
examples.zh: 该提议遭到了强烈反对。

encourage.collocations: encourage sb to do 鼓励某人做, encourage innovation 鼓励创新, encourage participation 鼓励参与

examples.en: Teachers should encourage students to ask questions.
examples.zh: 老师应该鼓励学生提问。

examples.en: The government encourages the use of renewable energy.
examples.zh: 政府鼓励使用可再生能源。

examples.en: Positive feedback encourages further effort.
examples.zh: 积极的反馈鼓励进一步的努力。

engage.collocations: engage in 从事于, engage with 与…互动, engage attention 吸引注意力

examples.en: The speaker engaged the audience with her story.
examples.zh: 演讲者用她的故事吸引了观众。

examples.en: Students are encouraged to engage in extracurricular activities.
examples.zh: 鼓励学生参加课外活动。

examples.en: The company engages with local communities.
examples.zh: 该公司与当地社区互动。

enhance.collocations: enhance performance 提高性能, enhance quality 提高质量, enhance understanding 增进理解

examples.en: Regular exercise can enhance your overall health.
examples.zh: 定期锻炼可以增强你的整体健康。

examples.en: The new software enhances the user experience.
examples.zh: 新软件改善了用户体验。

examples.en: Reading widely enhances your vocabulary.
examples.zh: 广泛阅读可以扩大词汇量。

enormous.collocations: enormous amount 大量, enormous pressure 巨大压力, enormous potential 巨大潜力

examples.en: The project requires an enormous amount of money.
examples.zh: 该项目需要巨额资金。

examples.en: He felt enormous pressure to succeed.
examples.zh: 他感到成功的巨大压力。

examples.en: The region has enormous potential for tourism.
examples.zh: 该地区具有巨大的旅游潜力。

ensure.collocations: ensure safety 确保安全, ensure quality 保证质量, ensure success 确保成功

examples.en: Please ensure that all doors are locked before leaving.
examples.zh: 离开前请确保所有门都锁好。

examples.en: The company ensures the quality of its products.
examples.zh: 公司保证其产品的质量。

examples.en: Proper planning ensures the success of the event.
examples.zh: 适当的规划确保活动的成功。

enterprise.collocations: small enterprise 小型企业, state-owned enterprise 国有企业, business enterprise 工商企业

examples.en: Small enterprises are the backbone of the economy.
examples.zh: 小型企业是经济的支柱。

examples.en: He showed great enterprise in starting his own business.
examples.zh: 他在创业中表现出了极大的进取心。

examples.en: The enterprise has expanded into international markets.
examples.zh: 该企业已扩展到国际市场。

enthusiasm.collocations: great enthusiasm 极大的热情, show enthusiasm 表现出热情, enthusiasm for 对…的热情

examples.en: The students showed great enthusiasm for the project.
examples.zh: 学生们对这个项目表现出极大的热情。

examples.en: Her enthusiasm is contagious.
examples.zh: 她的热情很有感染力。

examples.en: He pursued his hobby with enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 他满怀热情地追求自己的爱好。

environment.definition: 环境；周围状况；自然环境
environment.collocations: natural environment 自然环境, working environment 工作环境, protect the environment 保护环境

examples.en: We must protect the environment for future generations.
examples.zh: 我们必须为子孙后代保护环境。

examples.en: A positive learning environment is essential for students.
examples.zh: 积极的学习环境对学生至关重要。

examples.en: The company is committed to reducing its impact on the environment.
examples.zh: 该公司致力于减少对环境的影响。

equipment.collocations: modern equipment 现代设备, laboratory equipment 实验室设备, sports equipment 运动器材

examples.en: The laboratory is equipped with state-of-the-art equipment for scientific research.
examples.zh: 实验室配备了用于科学研究的最先进设备。

examples.en: Proper safety equipment is essential for workers in construction sites.
examples.zh: 适当的安防设备对建筑工地的工人至关重要。

examples.en: The company invested heavily in new manufacturing equipment to increase efficiency.
examples.zh: 公司大量投资新制造设备以提高效率。

equivalent.collocations: equivalent to 等同于, equivalent value 等值, equivalent amount 等量

examples.en: A bachelor's degree is equivalent to four years of study in most countries.
examples.zh: 在大多数国家，学士学位等同于四年的学习。

examples.en: The two proposals are roughly equivalent in terms of cost.
examples.zh: 这两个提案在成本上大致相当。

examples.en: One dollar is equivalent to about seven yuan at the current exchange rate.
examples.zh: 按当前汇率，一美元大约相当于七元人民币。

essential.collocations: essential for 对…必不可少, essential to 对…至关重要, essential element 基本要素

examples.en: Water is essential for all living organisms.
examples.zh: 水对所有生物都是必不可少的。

examples.en: It is essential to have a clear plan before starting a project.
examples.zh: 在开始一个项目之前，有一个清晰的计划至关重要。

examples.en: Good communication skills are an essential part of effective leadership.
examples.zh: 良好的沟通技巧是有效领导的基本组成部分。

establish.collocations: establish a company 成立公司, establish a relationship 建立关系, establish a fact 确认事实

examples.en: The university was established in 1890.
examples.zh: 这所大学成立于1890年。

examples.en: They worked hard to establish a good reputation in the industry.
examples.zh: 他们努力在行业内建立良好的声誉。

examples.en: The research aims to establish a link between diet and health.
examples.zh: 这项研究旨在确立饮食与健康之间的联系。

evaluate.collocations: evaluate the effectiveness 评估有效性, evaluate performance 评估表现, evaluate options 评估选项

examples.en: Teachers evaluate students' progress through regular tests.
examples.zh: 老师通过定期测试评估学生的进步。

examples.en: We need to evaluate the risks before making a decision.
examples.zh: 在做决定之前，我们需要评估风险。

examples.en: The project will be evaluated based on its impact on the community.
examples.zh: 该项目将根据其对社区的影响进行评估。

evident.collocations: evident from 从…明显看出, self-evident 不言而喻的, become evident 变得明显

examples.en: It was evident that she had been crying.
examples.zh: 很明显她哭过。

examples.en: The benefits of exercise are evident in improved health.
examples.zh: 锻炼的好处体现在健康的改善上。

examples.en: His talent was evident from a very young age.
examples.zh: 他的才华从很小的时候就显而易见。

evolve.collocations: evolve over time 随时间演变, evolve into 演变成, evolve from 从…进化而来

examples.en: Species evolve over millions of years to adapt to their environment.
examples.zh: 物种经过数百万年的进化以适应环境。

examples.en: The company's business model has evolved significantly since its founding.
examples.zh: 自成立以来，公司的商业模式已经发生了显著演变。

examples.en: Language evolves constantly to reflect changes in society.
examples.zh: 语言不断演变以反映社会的变化。

exceed.collocations: exceed expectations 超出预期, exceed the limit 超过限度, exceed the budget 超出预算

examples.en: The final cost exceeded the initial estimate by 20%.
examples.zh: 最终成本比最初估计高出20%。

examples.en: His performance exceeded all expectations.
examples.zh: 他的表现超出了所有人的预期。

examples.en: Drivers should not exceed the speed limit.
examples.zh: 司机不应超过速度限制。

exception.collocations: with the exception of 除…之外, make an exception 破例, no exception 不例外

examples.en: All students must attend the meeting, with the exception of those who are ill.
examples.zh: 所有学生都必须参加会议，生病的学生除外。

examples.en: The rule applies to everyone without exception.
examples.zh: 这条规则适用于所有人，无一例外。

examples.en: I rarely eat dessert, but I'll make an exception for chocolate cake.
examples.zh: 我很少吃甜点，但我会为巧克力蛋糕破例。

excess.collocations: in excess of 超过, excess weight 超重, excess supply 供应过剩

examples.en: Eating in excess can lead to health problems.
examples.zh: 过量饮食会导致健康问题。

examples.en: The company produced an excess of goods that remained unsold.
examples.zh: 公司生产了过多的商品，未能售出。

examples.en: You will be charged for any excess baggage.
examples.zh: 超重行李将收费。

exclude.collocations: exclude from 从…排除, exclude the possibility 排除可能性, exclude someone 排斥某人

examples.en: The insurance policy excludes pre-existing conditions.
examples.zh: 保险单排除已有病症。

examples.en: We cannot exclude the possibility of further delays.
examples.zh: 我们不能排除进一步延误的可能性。

examples.en: He was excluded from the team due to his behavior.
examples.zh: 他因行为不端被排除在团队之外。

exhibit.collocations: exhibit at a museum 在博物馆展出, exhibit behavior 表现出行为, exhibit symptoms 表现出症状

examples.en: The artist will exhibit her paintings at the gallery next month.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家下个月将在画廊展出她的画作。

examples.en: The patient exhibited signs of improvement after treatment.
examples.zh: 治疗后，病人表现出好转的迹象。

examples.en: The museum exhibits a collection of ancient artifacts.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了一批古代文物。

expand.collocations: expand business 扩大业务, expand knowledge 扩展知识, expand the scope 扩大范围

examples.en: The company plans to expand its operations into Asia.
examples.zh: 公司计划将业务扩展到亚洲。

examples.en: Reading can expand your horizons and deepen your understanding.
examples.zh: 阅读可以开阔视野，加深理解。

examples.en: The metal expands when heated.
examples.zh: 金属受热时会膨胀。

expert.collocations: expert in 在…方面的专家, expert opinion 专家意见, expert advice 专家建议

examples.en: She is an expert in environmental law.
examples.zh: 她是环境法方面的专家。

examples.en: We consulted an expert before making the decision.
examples.zh: 在做决定之前，我们咨询了一位专家。

examples.en: The expert witness provided crucial testimony in court.
examples.zh: 专家证人在法庭上提供了关键证词。

explicit.collocations: explicit instructions 明确的指示, explicit content 露骨内容, explicit consent 明确同意

examples.en: The teacher gave explicit instructions for the assignment.
examples.zh: 老师对作业给出了明确的指示。

examples.en: The contract contains explicit terms regarding payment.
examples.zh: 合同包含关于付款的明确条款。

examples.en: He was explicit about his intentions.
examples.zh: 他明确表达了自己的意图。

exploit.collocations: exploit resources 开发资源, exploit opportunities 利用机会, exploit workers 剥削工人

examples.en: The company exploited natural resources without regard for the environment.
examples.zh: 该公司不顾环境开发自然资源。

examples.en: We should exploit every opportunity to learn.
examples.zh: 我们应该利用每一个学习的机会。

examples.en: Child labor laws prevent employers from exploiting young workers.
examples.zh: 童工法防止雇主剥削年轻工人。

expose.collocations: expose to 暴露于, expose the truth 揭露真相, expose a scandal 揭露丑闻

examples.en: Prolonged exposure to the sun can damage your skin.
examples.zh: 长时间暴露在阳光下会损伤皮肤。

examples.en: The journalist exposed the corruption in the government.
examples.zh: 记者揭露了政府中的腐败。

examples.en: Travel exposes you to different cultures and ways of life.
examples.zh: 旅行让你接触不同的文化和生活方式。

extend.collocations: extend the deadline 延长截止日期, extend an invitation 发出邀请, extend a hand 伸出援手

examples.en: The government decided to extend the deadline for tax payments.
examples.zh: 政府决定延长纳税截止日期。

examples.en: We would like to extend our warmest welcome to all guests.
examples.zh: 我们想向所有客人表示最热烈的欢迎。

examples.en: The garden extends to the river.
examples.zh: 花园一直延伸到河边。

extensive.collocations: extensive research 广泛的研究, extensive experience 丰富的经验, extensive damage 大面积损坏

examples.en: The scientist conducted extensive research on climate change.
examples.zh: 这位科学家对气候变化进行了广泛的研究。

examples.en: She has extensive experience in project management.
examples.zh: 她在项目管理方面拥有丰富的经验。

examples.en: The storm caused extensive damage to the coastal area.
examples.zh: 暴风雨对沿海地区造成了广泛的破坏。

external.collocations: external factors 外部因素, external environment 外部环境, external appearance 外观

examples.en: The company hired an external consultant to review its operations.
examples.zh: 公司聘请了一位外部顾问来审查其运营。

examples.en: External factors such as the economy can affect business performance.
examples.zh: 经济等外部因素会影响企业绩效。

examples.en: The medicine is for external use only.
examples.zh: 此药仅供外用。

extract.collocations: extract data 提取数据, extract oil 提取石油, extract information 提取信息

examples.en: Scientists extract DNA from ancient bones to study evolution.
examples.zh: 科学家从古代骨骼中提取DNA以研究进化。

examples.en: The article extracts key points from the lengthy report.
examples.zh: 这篇文章从冗长的报告中摘录了关键点。

examples.en: Dentists often extract wisdom teeth to prevent crowding.
examples.zh: 牙医经常拔除智齿以防止拥挤。

facilitate.collocations: facilitate communication 促进沟通, facilitate learning 促进学习, facilitate trade 促进贸易

examples.en: New technologies facilitate remote work and global collaboration.
examples.zh: 新技术促进了远程工作和全球协作。

examples.en: The government aims to facilitate small business growth through tax cuts.
examples.zh: 政府旨在通过减税促进小企业增长。

examples.en: Clear instructions facilitate the assembly process for users.
examples.zh: 清晰的说明使用户的组装过程更加便利。

factor.collocations: key factor 关键因素, contributing factor 促成因素, risk factor 风险因素

examples.en: Education is a crucial factor in reducing poverty.
examples.zh: 教育是减少贫困的关键因素。

examples.en: Weather conditions are a major factor in crop yields.
examples.zh: 天气条件是作物产量的主要因素。

examples.en: Stress can be a contributing factor to heart disease.
examples.zh: 压力可能是心脏病的促成因素。

feasible.collocations: feasible solution 可行的解决方案, economically feasible 经济上可行, technically feasible 技术上可行

examples.en: The committee concluded that the plan is financially feasible.
examples.zh: 委员会得出结论，该计划在财务上是可行的。

examples.en: It is not feasible to complete the project within a month.
examples.zh: 在一个月内完成该项目是不可行的。

examples.en: Engineers are exploring whether the design is technically feasible.
examples.zh: 工程师们正在探索该设计在技术上是否可行。

feature.collocations: distinctive feature 显著特征, key feature 关键特征, safety feature 安全功能

examples.en: The smartphone's main feature is its high-resolution camera.
examples.zh: 这款智能手机的主要特点是其高分辨率摄像头。

examples.en: A distinctive feature of the building is its glass roof.
examples.zh: 该建筑的一个显著特征是其玻璃屋顶。

examples.en: The software includes a new feature for data analysis.
examples.zh: 该软件包含一个用于数据分析的新功能。

finance.collocations: public finance 公共财政, corporate finance 公司金融, personal finance 个人理财

examples.en: She works in the finance department of a multinational company.
examples.zh: 她在一家跨国公司的财务部门工作。

examples.en: The project requires additional finance from investors.
examples.zh: 该项目需要投资者的额外资金。

examples.en: Understanding personal finance is essential for young adults.
examples.zh: 了解个人理财对年轻人至关重要。

flexible.collocations: flexible schedule 灵活的时间表, flexible approach 灵活的方法, flexible working hours 弹性工作时间

examples.en: Many companies now offer flexible working hours to employees.
examples.zh: 许多公司现在为员工提供弹性工作时间。

examples.en: We need a flexible plan that can adapt to changing conditions.
examples.zh: 我们需要一个能够适应不断变化条件的灵活计划。

examples.en: Her flexible attitude made her a great team player.
examples.zh: 她灵活的态度使她成为出色的团队成员。

fluctuate.collocations: fluctuate wildly 剧烈波动, prices fluctuate 价格波动, fluctuate over time 随时间波动

examples.en: Stock prices fluctuate daily based on market conditions.
examples.zh: 股票价格根据市场状况每天波动。

examples.en: Temperatures fluctuate greatly between seasons in this region.
examples.zh: 该地区季节间温度波动很大。

examples.en: His mood tends to fluctuate depending on his workload.
examples.zh: 他的情绪往往随工作量的变化而波动。

focus.collocations: focus on 专注于, focus attention 集中注意力, focus efforts 集中精力

examples.en: Students should focus on their studies during exam period.
examples.zh: 学生在考试期间应专注于学习。

examples.en: The report focuses on the impact of climate change.
examples.zh: 该报告聚焦于气候变化的影响。

examples.en: She focused her efforts on improving customer service.
examples.zh: 她集中精力改善客户服务。

forecast.collocations: weather forecast 天气预报, economic forecast 经济预测, sales forecast 销售预测

examples.en: The weather forecast predicts heavy rain for tomorrow.
examples.zh: 天气预报预测明天有大雨。

examples.en: Economic forecasts suggest a slowdown in growth next year.
examples.zh: 经济预测表明明年增长将放缓。

examples.en: The company revised its sales forecast upward after strong demand.
examples.zh: 公司在强劲需求后上调了销售预测。

foundation.collocations: solid foundation 坚实的基础, lay the foundation 奠定基础, foundation course 基础课程

examples.en: A good education provides a solid foundation for future success.
examples.zh: 良好的教育为未来的成功奠定了坚实的基础。

examples.en: The research laid the foundation for modern genetics.
examples.zh: 这项研究为现代遗传学奠定了基础。

examples.en: The charity foundation donates millions to healthcare projects.
examples.zh: 该慈善基金会向医疗项目捐赠了数百万。

framework.collocations: legal framework 法律框架, theoretical framework 理论框架, conceptual framework 概念框架

examples.en: The government established a legal framework for data protection.
examples.zh: 政府建立了数据保护的法律框架。

examples.en: The study uses a theoretical framework based on social psychology.
examples.zh: 该研究使用了基于社会心理学的理论框架。

examples.en: A clear framework helps organize complex projects effectively.
examples.zh: 清晰的框架有助于有效组织复杂项目。

function.collocations: main function 主要功能, perform a function 执行功能, function properly 正常运作

examples.en: The main function of the heart is to pump blood.
examples.zh: 心脏的主要功能是泵血。

examples.en: This button performs a different function in each mode.
examples.zh: 这个按钮在不同模式下执行不同的功能。

examples.en: The software's search function is very efficient.
examples.zh: 该软件的搜索功能非常高效。

fundamental.collocations: fundamental principle 基本原则, fundamental change 根本变化, fundamental rights 基本权利

examples.en: Freedom of speech is a fundamental right in democracies.
examples.zh: 言论自由是民主国家的基本权利。

examples.en: The company underwent a fundamental change in its strategy.
examples.zh: 该公司在其战略上经历了根本性的变化。

examples.en: Understanding grammar is fundamental to learning a language.
examples.zh: 理解语法是学习语言的基础。

generate.collocations: generate electricity 发电, generate income 产生收入, generate ideas 产生想法

examples.en: Solar panels generate electricity from sunlight.
examples.zh: 太阳能电池板利用阳光发电。

examples.en: The new product is expected to generate significant revenue.
examples.zh: 新产品预计将产生可观的收入。

examples.en: Brainstorming sessions help generate creative ideas.
examples.zh: 头脑风暴会议有助于产生创意。

generous.collocations: generous donation 慷慨捐赠, generous portion 丰盛的一份, generous offer 慷慨的提议

examples.en: The billionaire made a generous donation to the university.
examples.zh: 这位亿万富翁向大学慷慨捐赠。

examples.en: The restaurant serves generous portions of food.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅提供丰盛的食物份量。

examples.en: She is known for her generous spirit and kindness.
examples.zh: 她以慷慨的精神和善良而闻名。

global.collocations: global economy 全球经济, global warming 全球变暖, global perspective 全球视角

examples.en: Climate change is a global issue that requires international cooperation.
examples.zh: 气候变化是一个需要国际合作的全球性问题。

examples.en: The company expanded its operations to a global scale.
examples.zh: 该公司将其业务扩展到全球范围。

examples.en: A global perspective helps understand different cultures.
examples.zh: 全球视角有助于理解不同的文化。

gradual.collocations: gradual change 逐渐变化, gradual increase 逐渐增加, gradual process 渐进过程

examples.en: There has been a gradual increase in global temperatures.
examples.zh: 全球气温逐渐上升。

examples.en: The transition to renewable energy will be a gradual process.
examples.zh: 向可再生能源的过渡将是一个渐进的过程。

examples.en: She noticed a gradual improvement in her language skills.
examples.zh: 她注意到自己的语言技能逐渐提高。

guarantee.collocations: guarantee quality 保证质量, guarantee success 保证成功, money-back guarantee 退款保证

examples.en: The product comes with a one-year guarantee.
examples.zh: 该产品附带一年保修。

examples.en: Hard work does not guarantee success, but it increases the chances.
examples.zh: 努力工作不能保证成功，但会增加机会。

examples.en: The company guarantees customer satisfaction or a full refund.
examples.zh: 公司保证客户满意，否则全额退款。

harmony.collocations: live in harmony 和谐共处, social harmony 社会和谐, in harmony with 与...协调

examples.en: Different ethnic groups live in harmony in this city.
examples.zh: 不同民族在这个城市和谐共处。

examples.en: The government promotes social harmony through inclusive policies.
examples.zh: 政府通过包容性政策促进社会和谐。

examples.en: The building's design is in harmony with its natural surroundings.
examples.zh: 该建筑的设计与其自然环境相协调。

hierarchy.definition: 等级制度；层级结构；统治集团
hierarchy.collocations: social hierarchy 社会等级, corporate hierarchy 公司层级, hierarchy of needs 需求层次

examples.en: The company has a strict hierarchy, with clear lines of authority.
examples.zh: 公司有严格的等级制度，权力界限分明。

examples.en: In many societies, social hierarchy determines one's status and opportunities.
examples.zh: 在许多社会中，社会等级决定了一个人的地位和机会。

examples.en: Maslow's hierarchy of needs is a well-known psychological theory.
examples.zh: 马斯洛的需求层次理论是一个著名的心理学理论。

highlight.collocations: highlight the importance 强调重要性, highlight the problem 突出问题, highlight the difference 突出差异

examples.en: The report highlights the urgent need for environmental protection.
examples.zh: 报告强调了环境保护的紧迫性。

examples.en: The study highlights the differences between urban and rural education.
examples.zh: 这项研究突出了城乡教育的差异。

examples.en: The speaker highlighted the key points of the proposal.
examples.zh: 演讲者强调了提案的要点。

hypothesis.collocations: test a hypothesis 检验假设, formulate a hypothesis 提出假设, working hypothesis 工作假设

examples.en: The scientist formulated a hypothesis to explain the phenomenon.
examples.zh: 科学家提出了一个假说来解释这一现象。

examples.en: We need to test this hypothesis through further experiments.
examples.zh: 我们需要通过进一步的实验来检验这个假设。

examples.en: The research is based on the hypothesis that all people are equal.
examples.zh: 这项研究基于人人平等的假设。

identical.definition: 完全相同的；同一的；一致的
identical.collocations: identical twins 同卵双胞胎, identical results 相同的结果, identical to 与……相同

examples.en: The two samples are almost identical in composition.
examples.zh: 这两个样本的成分几乎完全相同。

examples.en: Identical twins share the same DNA.
examples.zh: 同卵双胞胎拥有相同的DNA。

examples.en: Her opinion is identical to mine.
examples.zh: 她的意见和我的完全一致。

identify.collocations: identify the problem 识别问题, identify with 认同, identify the cause 查明原因

examples.en: It is important to identify the root cause of the issue.
examples.zh: 识别问题的根本原因很重要。

examples.en: Many young people identify with the characters in the novel.
examples.zh: 许多年轻人认同小说中的角色。

examples.en: The police are trying to identify the suspect.
examples.zh: 警方正在努力确认嫌疑人的身份。

ignorance.collocations: ignorance of the law 对法律的无知, sheer ignorance 完全无知, ignorance is bliss 无知是福

examples.en: Ignorance of the law is not an excuse for breaking it.
examples.zh: 对法律的无知不能成为违法的借口。

examples.en: His ignorance of modern technology is surprising.
examples.zh: 他对现代技术的无知令人惊讶。

examples.en: The saying 'ignorance is bliss' suggests that not knowing can sometimes be better.
examples.zh: 俗话说‘无知是福’，意味着不知道有时反而更好。

illustrate.definition: 说明；阐明；举例说明；给……加插图
illustrate.collocations: illustrate a point 说明观点, illustrate with examples 举例说明, illustrate the concept 阐明概念

examples.en: The teacher used a diagram to illustrate the process.
examples.zh: 老师用图表说明了这个过程。

examples.en: This case illustrates the importance of early diagnosis.
examples.zh: 这个案例说明了早期诊断的重要性。

examples.en: The book is beautifully illustrated with photographs.
examples.zh: 这本书配有精美的照片插图。

image.collocations: public image 公众形象, brand image 品牌形象, mental image 脑海中的形象

examples.en: The company is trying to improve its public image.
examples.zh: 公司正试图改善其公众形象。

examples.en: She has a clear mental image of her ideal home.
examples.zh: 她对自己理想的家有清晰的想象。

examples.en: The satellite sent back high-resolution images of the planet.
examples.zh: 卫星发回了这颗行星的高分辨率图像。

immense.collocations: immense pressure 巨大的压力, immense value 巨大的价值, immense potential 巨大的潜力

examples.en: The project requires an immense amount of time and effort.
examples.zh: 这个项目需要大量的时间和精力。
