drawback.collocations: major drawback 主要缺点, overcome a drawback 克服缺点, have a drawback 有缺点

examples.en: The main drawback of living in the city is the high cost.
examples.zh: 住在城市的主要缺点是生活成本高。

examples.en: One drawback of the plan is its lack of flexibility.
examples.zh: 该计划的一个缺点是缺乏灵活性。

examples.en: We need to overcome this drawback to succeed.
examples.zh: 我们需要克服这个缺点才能成功。

dread.collocations: dread doing 害怕做, dread the thought 害怕想到, live in dread 生活在恐惧中

examples.en: I dread going to the dentist.
examples.zh: 我害怕去看牙医。

examples.en: She dreaded the thought of losing her job.
examples.zh: 她害怕想到失去工作。

examples.en: Many people live in dread of natural disasters.
examples.zh: 许多人生活在自然灾害的恐惧中。

dreadful.definition: 可怕的；糟糕的；令人震惊的
dreadful.collocations: dreadful experience 可怕的经历, dreadful weather 糟糕的天气, dreadful consequences 可怕的后果

examples.en: The traffic in the city center was dreadful this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上市中心的交通糟糕透了。

examples.en: She had a dreadful headache and couldn't concentrate on her studies.
examples.zh: 她头痛得厉害，无法集中精力学习。

examples.en: The film received dreadful reviews from critics.
examples.zh: 这部电影遭到了评论家的恶评。

drift.collocations: drift apart 逐渐疏远, drift into 陷入, continental drift 大陆漂移

examples.en: The boat began to drift slowly downstream.
examples.zh: 船开始慢慢向下游漂流。

examples.en: Many young people drift into cities in search of better opportunities.
examples.zh: 许多年轻人涌入城市寻找更好的机会。

examples.en: The general drift of the argument was that education needs reform.
examples.zh: 争论的主要大意是教育需要改革。

drill.collocations: drill hole 钻孔, fire drill 消防演习, drill sergeant 训练教官

examples.en: The workers used a power drill to make holes in the wall.
examples.zh: 工人们用电钻在墙上钻孔。

examples.en: The school conducts a fire drill every month.
examples.zh: 学校每个月进行一次消防演习。

examples.en: The teacher drilled the students on grammar rules.
examples.zh: 老师反复训练学生语法规则。

drought.collocations: severe drought 严重干旱, drought-resistant 抗旱的, drought relief 抗旱救济

examples.en: The prolonged drought has caused severe water shortages in the region.
examples.zh: 长期干旱导致该地区严重缺水。

examples.en: Farmers are struggling to cope with the effects of the drought.
examples.zh: 农民们正在努力应对干旱的影响。

examples.en: Drought-resistant crops are essential for agriculture in arid areas.
examples.zh: 抗旱作物对于干旱地区的农业至关重要。

drown.collocations: drown out 淹没（声音）, drown in 沉浸于, drown one's sorrows 借酒浇愁

examples.en: The loud music drowned out their conversation.
examples.zh: 嘈杂的音乐淹没了他们的谈话。

examples.en: He nearly drowned while swimming in the rough sea.
examples.zh: 他在波涛汹涌的海里游泳时差点淹死。

examples.en: She tried to drown her sorrows in work after the breakup.
examples.zh: 分手后，她试图用工作来麻痹自己。

dual.collocations: dual purpose 双重目的, dual nationality 双重国籍, dual role 双重角色

examples.en: The device has a dual function as a phone and a camera.
examples.zh: 这个设备具有手机和相机的双重功能。

examples.en: She holds dual citizenship in Canada and the UK.
examples.zh: 她拥有加拿大和英国的双重国籍。

examples.en: The professor played a dual role as teacher and researcher.
examples.zh: 这位教授扮演着教师和研究者的双重角色。

dubious.definition: 可疑的；犹豫不决的；不确定的
dubious.collocations: dubious about 对…怀疑, dubious reputation 可疑的名声, dubious distinction 可疑的荣誉

examples.en: I am dubious about the effectiveness of this new policy.
examples.zh: 我对这项新政策的有效性持怀疑态度。

examples.en: The company has a dubious reputation for unethical practices.
examples.zh: 这家公司因不道德行为而名声可疑。

examples.en: He has the dubious distinction of being the only student to fail the exam.
examples.zh: 他有着唯一一个考试不及格的学生的可疑荣誉。

due.definition: 到期的；应有的；由于；应得的东西
due.collocations: due to 由于, due date 到期日, in due course 在适当的时候

examples.en: The project was delayed due to bad weather.
examples.zh: 项目因天气恶劣而延误。

examples.en: The rent is due on the first of every month.
examples.zh: 租金每月一号到期。

examples.en: She finally received the recognition that was due to her.
examples.zh: 她终于得到了应得的认可。

dumb.definition: 哑的；愚蠢的；说不出话的
dumb.collocations: dumb luck 傻人有傻福, dumb down 降低难度, dumb question 愚蠢的问题

examples.en: He was struck dumb with astonishment.
examples.zh: 他惊讶得说不出话来。

examples.en: That was a dumb thing to do.
examples.zh: 那是一件蠢事。

examples.en: The textbook has been dumbed down for younger students.
examples.zh: 这本教科书为低年级学生降低了难度。

dump.collocations: dump waste 倾倒废物, dump site 垃圾场, dump truck 自卸卡车

examples.en: Illegal dumping of waste is harmful to the environment.
examples.zh: 非法倾倒废物对环境有害。

examples.en: He dumped all his old clothes in the charity bin.
examples.zh: 他把所有旧衣服都扔进了慈善箱。

examples.en: The company was accused of dumping cheap goods on the market.
examples.zh: 该公司被指控向市场倾销廉价商品。

duplicate.collocations: duplicate copy 副本, duplicate key 备用钥匙, duplicate effort 重复劳动

examples.en: Please make a duplicate of the document for our records.
examples.zh: 请复印一份文件作为我们的记录。

examples.en: The experiment was duplicated to verify the results.
examples.zh: 重复了实验以验证结果。

examples.en: We should avoid duplicating work that has already been done.
examples.zh: 我们应该避免重复已经完成的工作。

durable.collocations: durable goods 耐用品, durable material 耐用材料, durable relationship 持久的关系

examples.en: These shoes are made of durable leather and last for years.
examples.zh: 这些鞋子由耐用皮革制成，可以穿好几年。

examples.en: The company is known for producing durable household appliances.
examples.zh: 这家公司以生产耐用的家用电器而闻名。

examples.en: A durable peace requires mutual understanding and cooperation.
examples.zh: 持久的和平需要相互理解与合作。

duty.collocations: duty-free 免税的, on duty 值班, sense of duty 责任感

examples.en: It is our duty to protect the environment.
examples.zh: 保护环境是我们的责任。

examples.en: The customs officer asked if I had anything to declare for duty.
examples.zh: 海关官员问我是否有东西要申报纳税。

examples.en: She is on duty tonight at the hospital.
examples.zh: 她今晚在医院值班。

dwarf.definition: 矮子；侏儒；使相形见绌；矮小的
dwarf.collocations: dwarf planet 矮行星, dwarf star 矮星, dwarfed by 被…比下去

examples.en: The new skyscraper dwarfs all the surrounding buildings.
examples.zh: 新的摩天大楼使周围所有建筑相形见绌。

examples.en: Pluto is classified as a dwarf planet.
examples.zh: 冥王星被归类为矮行星。

examples.en: The dwarf trees in the garden are perfect for small spaces.
examples.zh: 花园里的矮树非常适合小空间。

dwell.collocations: dwell on 细想；详述, dwell in 居住在, dwell upon 深思

examples.en: They dwell in a small village in the mountains.
examples.zh: 他们居住在山中的一个小村庄里。

examples.en: Don't dwell on past mistakes; focus on the future.
examples.zh: 不要沉湎于过去的错误，要着眼于未来。

examples.en: The speaker dwelled upon the importance of education.
examples.zh: 演讲者详细阐述了教育的重要性。

dwindle.collocations: dwindle away 逐渐减少, dwindle to 减少到, dwindle in number 数量减少

examples.en: The population of the village has dwindled to just a few hundred.
examples.zh: 这个村庄的人口已减少到只有几百人。

examples.en: As the resources dwindled, the team had to work harder.
examples.zh: 随着资源减少，团队不得不更加努力。

examples.en: His savings dwindled away after he lost his job.
examples.zh: 他失业后积蓄逐渐耗尽。

ease.collocations: with ease 轻松地, at ease 自在, ease off 减轻

examples.en: She passed the exam with ease.
examples.zh: 她轻松地通过了考试。

examples.en: The medicine helped ease his pain.
examples.zh: 药物帮助减轻了他的疼痛。

examples.en: He felt completely at ease during the interview.
examples.zh: 面试时他感到完全自在。

eastern.definition: 东方的；东部的；来自东方的
eastern.collocations: eastern culture 东方文化, eastern Europe 东欧, eastern coast 东海岸

examples.en: Eastern philosophy emphasizes harmony with nature.
examples.zh: 东方哲学强调与自然的和谐。

examples.en: The eastern part of the country is more developed.
examples.zh: 该国东部地区更为发达。

examples.en: They traveled along the eastern coast of Australia.
examples.zh: 他们沿着澳大利亚东海岸旅行。

eccentric.definition: 古怪的；异乎寻常的；古怪的人
eccentric.collocations: eccentric behavior 古怪行为, eccentric person 古怪的人, eccentric orbit 偏心轨道

examples.en: The old man was known for his eccentric habits.
examples.zh: 这位老人以古怪的习惯闻名。

examples.en: She has an eccentric taste in clothing.
examples.zh: 她在衣着方面有古怪的品味。

examples.en: The planet follows an eccentric orbit around the star.
examples.zh: 这颗行星沿着偏心轨道绕恒星运行。

echo.collocations: echo chamber 回音室, echo back 回响, echo with 回荡着

examples.en: The sound of footsteps echoed through the empty hall.
examples.zh: 脚步声在空旷的大厅里回响。

examples.en: His speech echoed the sentiments of many people.
examples.zh: 他的演讲附和了许多人的情感。

examples.en: The canyon echoed with the sound of the waterfall.
examples.zh: 峡谷里回荡着瀑布的声音。

eclipse.collocations: solar eclipse 日食, lunar eclipse 月食, total eclipse 全食

examples.en: A solar eclipse occurs when the moon passes between the sun and the earth.
examples.zh: 当月球经过太阳和地球之间时，就会发生日食。

examples.en: The team's success was an eclipse of their previous achievements.
examples.zh: 该队的成功使他们之前的成就黯然失色。

examples.en: Ancient civilizations often interpreted eclipses as omens.
examples.zh: 古代文明常将日食解释为预兆。

ecology.collocations: ecology system 生态系统, human ecology 人类生态学, ecology balance 生态平衡

examples.en: The study of ecology helps us understand the relationships between organisms and their environment.
examples.zh: 生态学研究帮助我们理解生物与其环境之间的关系。

examples.en: Deforestation has a devastating impact on the local ecology.
examples.zh: 森林砍伐对当地生态造成了毁灭性影响。

examples.en: Ecology is a key subject in environmental science courses.
examples.zh: 生态学是环境科学课程中的关键学科。

economic.collocations: economic growth 经济增长, economic policy 经济政策, economic development 经济发展

examples.en: The government implemented new economic policies to stimulate growth.
examples.zh: 政府实施了新的经济政策以刺激增长。

examples.en: Economic inequality is a major issue in many countries.
examples.zh: 经济不平等是许多国家的一个主要问题。

examples.en: The economic downturn led to widespread unemployment.
examples.zh: 经济衰退导致了广泛的失业。

economical.collocations: economical car 经济型汽车, economical way 节约的方式, be economical with 节省

examples.en: Buying in bulk is often more economical than purchasing small quantities.
examples.zh: 批量购买通常比少量购买更经济。

examples.en: This car is very economical on fuel.
examples.zh: 这辆车非常省油。

examples.en: She is economical with her time and never wastes a moment.
examples.zh: 她很节约时间，从不浪费一刻。

economics.collocations: study economics 学习经济学, economics professor 经济学教授, macroeconomics 宏观经济学

examples.en: He decided to major in economics at university.
examples.zh: 他决定在大学主修经济学。

examples.en: The economics of the project need to be carefully evaluated.
examples.zh: 这个项目的经济因素需要仔细评估。

examples.en: Keynesian economics has influenced many government policies.
examples.zh: 凯恩斯经济学影响了许多政府政策。

edge.collocations: competitive edge 竞争优势, on the edge 在边缘, cutting edge 前沿

examples.en: The company has a competitive edge in the market due to its innovative products.
examples.zh: 这家公司因其创新产品在市场上具有竞争优势。

examples.en: He stood at the edge of the cliff, looking out at the sea.
examples.zh: 他站在悬崖边缘，眺望大海。

examples.en: The knife has a sharp edge.
examples.zh: 这把刀刀刃锋利。

edible.collocations: edible mushrooms 食用蘑菇, edible oil 食用油, edible plants 可食用植物

examples.en: Not all mushrooms are edible; some are poisonous.
examples.zh: 并非所有蘑菇都可食用，有些是有毒的。

examples.en: The label indicates that the product is edible.
examples.zh: 标签显示该产品是可食用的。

examples.en: Edible flowers are often used to garnish salads.
examples.zh: 可食用花卉常用于装饰沙拉。

edit.collocations: edit a document 编辑文档, edit a video 剪辑视频, edit out 删掉

examples.en: She spent hours editing her essay to make it perfect.
examples.zh: 她花了几个小时编辑她的文章，使其完美。

examples.en: The film was edited to remove controversial scenes.
examples.zh: 这部电影经过剪辑，删除了有争议的场景。

examples.en: He edits the school newspaper every week.
examples.zh: 他每周编辑校报。

edition.collocations: first edition 第一版, limited edition 限量版, special edition 特别版

examples.en: The first edition of the book sold out within a week.
examples.zh: 这本书的第一版在一周内售罄。

examples.en: This is a limited edition print, signed by the artist.
examples.zh: 这是一幅限量版印刷品，由艺术家签名。

examples.en: The new edition includes updated information.
examples.zh: 新版包含了更新的信息。

editor.collocations: editor in chief 主编, news editor 新闻编辑, text editor 文本编辑器

examples.en: The editor corrected several errors in the manuscript.
examples.zh: 编辑纠正了手稿中的几个错误。

examples.en: She works as a fashion editor for a magazine.
examples.zh: 她在一家杂志社担任时尚编辑。

examples.en: The editor in chief approved the final draft.
examples.zh: 主编批准了最终稿。

editorial.collocations: editorial board 编辑委员会, editorial policy 编辑政策, editorial comment 社论评论

examples.en: The newspaper's editorial policy is to remain impartial.
examples.zh: 这家报纸的编辑政策是保持公正。

examples.en: She wrote an editorial about climate change.
examples.zh: 她写了一篇关于气候变化的社论。

examples.en: The editorial team meets every morning to discuss the day's stories.
examples.zh: 编辑团队每天早上开会讨论当天的报道。

education.collocations: higher education 高等教育, compulsory education 义务教育, education system 教育体系

examples.en: Access to quality education is a fundamental right.
examples.zh: 获得优质教育是一项基本权利。

examples.en: She has a degree in education from a prestigious university.
examples.zh: 她拥有著名大学的教育学学位。

examples.en: The government is investing more in early childhood education.
examples.zh: 政府正在加大对幼儿教育的投入。

educational.collocations: educational institution 教育机构, educational program 教育项目, educational experience 教育经历

examples.en: The museum offers many educational programs for children.
examples.zh: 博物馆为儿童提供许多教育项目。

examples.en: Watching documentaries can be both entertaining and educational.
examples.zh: 观看纪录片既有趣又有教育意义。

examples.en: She works in an educational institution as a teacher.
examples.zh: 她在一所教育机构担任教师。

effect.collocations: side effect 副作用, cause and effect 因果, have an effect on 对……有影响

examples.en: The new law had a positive effect on the economy.
examples.zh: 新法律对经济产生了积极影响。

examples.en: Some medications have unpleasant side effects.
examples.zh: 有些药物有令人不快的副作用。

examples.en: The effect of the speech was immediate and powerful.
examples.zh: 演讲的效果立竿见影且强大。

effective.collocations: effective method 有效方法, effective communication 有效沟通, effective date 生效日期

examples.en: This is an effective way to reduce stress.
examples.zh: 这是一种减轻压力的有效方法。

examples.en: The new policy will become effective next month.
examples.zh: 新政策将于下个月生效。

examples.en: Effective communication is key to a successful team.
examples.zh: 有效沟通是团队成功的关键。

efficient.collocations: efficient system 高效系统, energy efficient 节能的, cost efficient 成本效益高的

examples.en: The new machine is more efficient than the old one.
examples.zh: 新机器比旧机器效率更高。

examples.en: She is an efficient worker who always meets deadlines.
examples.zh: 她是一名高效的员工，总能按时完成任务。

examples.en: Energy-efficient appliances help reduce electricity bills.
examples.zh: 节能电器有助于减少电费。

eject.collocations: eject from 从……弹出, eject a disc 弹出光盘, eject a passenger 驱逐乘客

examples.en: The pilot ejected from the plane just before it crashed.
examples.zh: 飞行员在飞机坠毁前弹射出来。

examples.en: The DVD player will eject the disc automatically.
examples.zh: DVD播放器会自动弹出光盘。

examples.en: The security guard ejected the troublemaker from the building.
examples.zh: 保安将闹事者逐出了大楼。

elaborate.definition: 精心制作的；详尽的；复杂的
elaborate.collocations: elaborate plan 精心策划, elaborate design 精心设计, elaborate explanation 详尽解释

examples.en: The architect presented an elaborate design for the new building.
examples.zh: 建筑师为新建筑展示了一个精心设计。

examples.en: She gave an elaborate explanation of the scientific process.
examples.zh: 她对科学过程做了详尽解释。

examples.en: The party decorations were elaborate and beautiful.
examples.zh: 派对装饰精致而美丽。

elastic.collocations: elastic band 橡皮筋, elastic material 弹性材料, elastic demand 弹性需求

examples.en: The waistband is made of elastic material for comfort.
examples.zh: 腰带由弹性材料制成，穿着舒适。

examples.en: The demand for luxury goods is more elastic than for necessities.
examples.zh: 奢侈品的需求比必需品更具弹性。

examples.en: She used an elastic band to hold the papers together.
examples.zh: 她用橡皮筋把文件绑在一起。

elbow.collocations: elbow joint 肘关节, elbow room 活动空间, tennis elbow 网球肘

examples.en: He rested his elbows on the table.
examples.zh: 他把肘部放在桌子上。

examples.en: The bus was so crowded that there was no elbow room.
examples.zh: 公交车太挤了，没有活动空间。

examples.en: She injured her elbow while playing tennis.
examples.zh: 她打网球时伤了肘部。

elderly.collocations: elderly people 老年人, elderly care 老年护理, elderly population 老年人口

examples.en: The government provides subsidies for elderly care.
examples.zh: 政府为老年护理提供补贴。

examples.en: An increasing number of elderly people live alone.
examples.zh: 越来越多的老年人独居。

examples.en: The elderly population is growing rapidly in many countries.
examples.zh: 许多国家的老年人口正在快速增长。

electrical.collocations: electrical equipment 电气设备, electrical engineering 电气工程, electrical system 电气系统

examples.en: All electrical equipment must be checked regularly.
examples.zh: 所有电气设备必须定期检查。

examples.en: He studied electrical engineering at university.
examples.zh: 他在大学学习电气工程。

examples.en: The electrical system in the building needs an upgrade.
examples.zh: 大楼的电气系统需要升级。

electrician.collocations: call an electrician 叫电工, qualified electrician 合格电工, work as an electrician 做电工

examples.en: We need to call an electrician to fix the wiring.
examples.zh: 我们需要叫电工来修理线路。

examples.en: A qualified electrician should handle all repairs.
examples.zh: 所有维修应由合格电工处理。

examples.en: He works as an electrician for a construction company.
examples.zh: 他在一家建筑公司做电工。

electricity.collocations: electricity supply 电力供应, generate electricity 发电, electricity bill 电费

examples.en: The electricity supply was cut off during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨期间电力供应被切断。

examples.en: Solar panels are used to generate electricity.
examples.zh: 太阳能电池板用于发电。

examples.en: The electricity bill has increased significantly this month.
examples.zh: 这个月的电费大幅上涨。

electronic.collocations: electronic device 电子设备, electronic commerce 电子商务, electronic payment 电子支付

examples.en: Electronic devices should be recycled properly.
examples.zh: 电子设备应妥善回收。

examples.en: Electronic commerce has transformed the retail industry.
examples.zh: 电子商务改变了零售业。

examples.en: Many people prefer electronic payment over cash.
examples.zh: 许多人更喜欢电子支付而非现金。

electronics.collocations: consumer electronics 消费电子产品, electronics industry 电子工业, electronics engineer 电子工程师

examples.en: The consumer electronics market is highly competitive.
examples.zh: 消费电子产品市场竞争激烈。

examples.en: She works in the electronics industry as a designer.
examples.zh: 她在电子工业担任设计师。

examples.en: He is an electronics engineer specializing in circuit design.
examples.zh: 他是一名专攻电路设计的电子工程师。

elegant.collocations: elegant design 优雅设计, elegant solution 优雅解决方案, elegant appearance 优雅外观

examples.en: The building has an elegant design that attracts many visitors.
examples.zh: 这座建筑有优雅的设计，吸引了许多游客。

examples.en: She proposed an elegant solution to the complex problem.
examples.zh: 她提出了一个优雅的解决方案来解决这个复杂问题。

examples.en: The dress has an elegant appearance suitable for formal occasions.
examples.zh: 这件连衣裙外观优雅，适合正式场合。

elementary.collocations: elementary school 小学, elementary education 初等教育, elementary level 初级水平

examples.en: Children start elementary school at age six.
examples.zh: 孩子们六岁开始上小学。

examples.en: Elementary education is compulsory in most countries.
examples.zh: 大多数国家实行初等义务教育。

examples.en: This course is designed for students at an elementary level.
examples.zh: 这门课程是为初级水平的学生设计的。

elevate.collocations: elevate the status 提升地位, elevate the level 提高水平, elevate the quality 提高质量

examples.en: The new policy aims to elevate the status of teachers.
examples.zh: 新政策旨在提升教师的地位。

examples.en: Regular training can elevate the level of employee performance.
examples.zh: 定期培训可以提高员工的表现水平。

examples.en: We need to elevate the quality of our products to compete globally.
examples.zh: 我们需要提高产品质量以在全球竞争。

elevator.collocations: take the elevator 乘电梯, elevator shaft 电梯井, elevator attendant 电梯服务员

examples.en: Please take the elevator to the 10th floor.
examples.zh: 请乘电梯到10楼。

examples.en: The elevator shaft is under maintenance.
examples.zh: 电梯井正在维修。

examples.en: In some old buildings, there is still an elevator attendant.
examples.zh: 在一些老建筑里，仍有电梯服务员。

elicit.collocations: elicit a response 引出回应, elicit information 获取信息, elicit support 获得支持

examples.en: The teacher's question elicited a thoughtful response from the student.
examples.zh: 老师的问题引出了学生深思熟虑的回答。

examples.en: The survey was designed to elicit information about consumer preferences.
examples.zh: 这项调查旨在获取关于消费者偏好的信息。

examples.en: The charity event elicited widespread support from the community.
examples.zh: 这次慈善活动获得了社区的广泛支持。

eligible.definition: 有资格的；合格的；符合条件的
eligible.collocations: eligible for 有资格获得, eligible candidate 合格候选人, eligible voter 合格选民

examples.en: Only citizens over 18 are eligible to vote.
examples.zh: 只有18岁以上的公民才有资格投票。

examples.en: She is an eligible candidate for the scholarship.
examples.zh: 她是奖学金的合格候选人。

examples.en: You are eligible for a refund if the product is defective.
examples.zh: 如果产品有缺陷，你有资格获得退款。

elite.collocations: elite group 精英群体, elite university 精英大学, political elite 政治精英

examples.en: The elite group controls most of the country's wealth.
examples.zh: 这个精英群体控制着国家的大部分财富。

examples.en: He attended an elite university in the United States.
examples.zh: 他上了一所美国的精英大学。

examples.en: The political elite often make decisions that affect the entire population.
examples.zh: 政治精英经常做出影响全体人口的决定。

eloquent.definition: 雄辩的；有口才的；表达清晰的
eloquent.collocations: eloquent speech 雄辩的演讲, eloquent speaker 有口才的演讲者, eloquent expression 清晰的表达

examples.en: The politician delivered an eloquent speech that moved the audience.
examples.zh: 这位政治家发表了雄辩的演讲，感动了观众。

examples.en: She is an eloquent speaker who can persuade anyone.
examples.zh: 她是一位有口才的演讲者，能说服任何人。

examples.en: His eloquent expression of the idea made it easy to understand.
examples.zh: 他对这个想法的清晰表达使其易于理解。

elsewhere.collocations: go elsewhere 去别处, find elsewhere 在别处找到, look elsewhere 在别处寻找

examples.en: If you can't find what you need here, try looking elsewhere.
examples.zh: 如果你在这里找不到所需的东西，试试去别处找。

examples.en: The data is stored elsewhere in the system.
examples.zh: 数据存储在系统的别处。

examples.en: Many young people move elsewhere for better job opportunities.
examples.zh: 许多年轻人搬到别处寻找更好的工作机会。

email.collocations: send an email 发送电子邮件, email address 电子邮件地址, check email 查收电子邮件

examples.en: Please send me an email with the details.
examples.zh: 请给我发一封包含详细信息的电子邮件。

examples.en: What is your email address?
examples.zh: 你的电子邮件地址是什么？

examples.en: I check my email every morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早上查收电子邮件。

embargo.collocations: trade embargo 贸易禁运, impose an embargo 实施禁运, lift an embargo 解除禁运

examples.en: The country imposed a trade embargo on its neighbor.
examples.zh: 该国对其邻国实施了贸易禁运。

examples.en: The embargo was lifted after negotiations.
examples.zh: 经过谈判，禁运被解除。

examples.en: The trade embargo affected the economy severely.
examples.zh: 贸易禁运严重影响了经济。

embark.collocations: embark on 开始, embark upon 着手, embark on a journey 开始旅程

examples.en: The company will embark on a new project next month.
examples.zh: 公司下个月将开始一个新项目。

examples.en: They embarked upon a journey across the continent.
examples.zh: 他们开始了穿越大陆的旅程。

examples.en: She decided to embark on a career in medicine.
examples.zh: 她决定开始从事医学事业。

embarrass.collocations: embarrass someone 使某人尴尬, feel embarrassed 感到尴尬, embarrassing situation 尴尬的局面

examples.en: His mistake embarrassed him in front of the whole class.
examples.zh: 他的错误使他在全班面前尴尬。

examples.en: She felt embarrassed when she forgot the speech.
examples.zh: 她忘记演讲时感到尴尬。

examples.en: It was an embarrassing situation for everyone involved.
examples.zh: 对每个参与者来说，这都是一个尴尬的局面。

embassy.collocations: embassy staff 大使馆工作人员, embassy building 大使馆建筑, contact the embassy 联系大使馆

examples.en: The embassy staff helped the citizens during the crisis.
examples.zh: 大使馆工作人员在危机期间帮助了公民。

examples.en: The embassy building is located in the city center.
examples.zh: 大使馆建筑位于市中心。

examples.en: If you lose your passport, contact the embassy immediately.
examples.zh: 如果你丢失了护照，请立即联系大使馆。

embed.definition: 嵌入；把…牢牢插入；使深留脑中
embed.collocations: embed in 嵌入在, deeply embedded 根深蒂固的, embed a chip 嵌入芯片

examples.en: The journalist embedded herself in the community to report on local issues.
examples.zh: 记者深入社区报道当地问题。

examples.en: These values are deeply embedded in our culture.
examples.zh: 这些价值观深深植根于我们的文化中。

examples.en: The software allows you to embed videos in your presentation.
examples.zh: 该软件允许你在演示文稿中嵌入视频。

embody.collocations: embody the spirit 体现精神, embody principles 体现原则, embody a vision 体现愿景

examples.en: The new law embodies the government's commitment to environmental protection.
examples.zh: 新法律体现了政府对环境保护的承诺。

examples.en: She embodies all the qualities of a great leader.
examples.zh: 她体现了伟大领袖的所有品质。

examples.en: The sculpture embodies the artist's emotions.
examples.zh: 这座雕塑体现了艺术家的情感。

embrace.collocations: embrace change 拥抱变化, embrace diversity 接受多样性, embrace an opportunity 抓住机会

examples.en: Many companies now embrace remote work as a permanent option.
examples.zh: 许多公司现在将远程工作作为永久选择。

examples.en: The community embraced the new policy with enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 社区热情地接受了新政策。

examples.en: His speech embraced a wide range of topics.
examples.zh: 他的演讲涵盖了广泛的话题。

emergency.collocations: emergency room 急诊室, emergency plan 应急预案, state of emergency 紧急状态

examples.en: In case of emergency, break the glass.
examples.zh: 紧急情况下，打碎玻璃。

examples.en: The government declared a state of emergency after the earthquake.
examples.zh: 地震后政府宣布进入紧急状态。

examples.en: She was rushed to the emergency room with severe injuries.
examples.zh: 她因重伤被紧急送往急诊室。

emigrate.collocations: emigrate to 移居到, emigrate from 从…移出, emigrate for economic reasons 因经济原因移民

examples.en: Many people emigrated to Australia in search of a better life.
examples.zh: 许多人移居澳大利亚寻求更好的生活。

examples.en: He emigrated from Ireland during the famine.
examples.zh: 他在饥荒期间从爱尔兰移居国外。

examples.en: The decision to emigrate is often difficult.
examples.zh: 移居国外的决定往往很艰难。

eminent.collocations: eminent scholar 著名学者, eminent domain 征用权, eminent scientist 杰出科学家

examples.en: The conference was attended by several eminent professors.
examples.zh: 几位著名教授出席了会议。

examples.en: She is an eminent figure in the field of medicine.
examples.zh: 她是医学界的杰出人物。

examples.en: The government used eminent domain to acquire the land.
examples.zh: 政府利用征用权获得了这块土地。

emit.collocations: emit light 发光, emit carbon dioxide 排放二氧化碳, emit a sound 发出声音

examples.en: The factory emits large amounts of smoke into the air.
examples.zh: 工厂向空气中排放大量烟雾。

examples.en: The sun emits both light and heat.
examples.zh: 太阳发出光和热。

examples.en: The device emits a low-frequency hum.
examples.zh: 该设备发出低频嗡嗡声。

emotion.collocations: strong emotion 强烈情感, express emotion 表达情感, control emotions 控制情绪

examples.en: She could not hide her emotions when she heard the news.
examples.zh: 听到这个消息时，她无法掩饰自己的情绪。

examples.en: Music can evoke a wide range of emotions.
examples.zh: 音乐能唤起各种情感。

examples.en: It is important to manage your emotions in stressful situations.
examples.zh: 在压力大的情况下管理好自己的情绪很重要。

emperor.collocations: Roman emperor 罗马皇帝, emperor penguin 帝企鹅, emperor's palace 皇宫

examples.en: The emperor ruled the vast empire for decades.
examples.zh: 这位皇帝统治了庞大的帝国数十年。

examples.en: Emperor penguins are the largest of all penguin species.
examples.zh: 帝企鹅是所有企鹅中体型最大的。

examples.en: The emperor's decree was obeyed throughout the land.
examples.zh: 皇帝的诏令在全国得到遵守。

emphasize.collocations: emphasize the importance 强调重要性, emphasize a point 强调一点, emphasize the need 强调需求

examples.en: The teacher emphasized the importance of regular practice.
examples.zh: 老师强调了定期练习的重要性。

examples.en: He emphasized that everyone must follow the rules.
examples.zh: 他强调每个人都必须遵守规则。

examples.en: The report emphasizes the need for immediate action.
examples.zh: 报告强调了立即采取行动的必要性。

empirical.definition: 经验主义的；以经验为依据的
empirical.collocations: empirical evidence 经验证据, empirical research 实证研究, empirical data 经验数据

examples.en: The theory is supported by strong empirical evidence.
examples.zh: 该理论得到了强有力的经验证据支持。

examples.en: Empirical research is essential for scientific progress.
examples.zh: 实证研究对科学进步至关重要。

examples.en: They collected empirical data from hundreds of participants.
examples.zh: 他们从数百名参与者那里收集了经验数据。

employee.collocations: full-time employee 全职员工, employee benefits 员工福利, employee satisfaction 员工满意度

examples.en: The company has over 500 employees.
examples.zh: 该公司有500多名员工。

examples.en: Employee benefits include health insurance and paid leave.
examples.zh: 员工福利包括健康保险和带薪休假。

examples.en: A happy employee is more productive.
examples.zh: 快乐的员工工作效率更高。

employer.collocations: employer brand 雇主品牌, employer liability 雇主责任, employer contribution 雇主缴款

examples.en: The employer is responsible for providing a safe workplace.
examples.zh: 雇主有责任提供安全的工作场所。

examples.en: Many employers offer flexible working hours.
examples.zh: 许多雇主提供弹性工作时间。

examples.en: The employer-employee relationship is based on mutual trust.
examples.zh: 雇主与雇员的关系建立在相互信任的基础上。

employment.collocations: full employment 充分就业, employment rate 就业率, employment contract 雇佣合同

examples.en: The government aims to achieve full employment.
examples.zh: 政府的目标是实现充分就业。

examples.en: She found employment as a software engineer.
examples.zh: 她找到了一份软件工程师的工作。

examples.en: The employment rate has risen steadily over the past year.
examples.zh: 过去一年就业率稳步上升。

empty.collocations: empty space 空空间, empty promise 空头承诺, empty stomach 空腹

examples.en: The room was completely empty.
examples.zh: 房间完全是空的。

examples.en: He made empty promises that he never kept.
examples.zh: 他做出了从未兑现的空头承诺。

examples.en: It is not good to exercise on an empty stomach.
examples.zh: 空腹锻炼不好。

enclose.collocations: enclose with 随信附上, enclosed area 封闭区域, enclose a garden 围住花园

examples.en: Please enclose a copy of your ID with the application.
examples.zh: 请随申请附上身份证复印件。

examples.en: The garden is enclosed by a high wall.
examples.zh: 花园被高墙围住。

examples.en: I enclose a cheque for the full amount.
examples.zh: 我附上一张全额支票。

enclosure.collocations: enclosure movement 圈地运动, enclosure wall 围墙, enclosure for animals 动物围场

examples.en: The enclosure movement changed the landscape of rural England.
examples.zh: 圈地运动改变了英国乡村的面貌。

examples.en: Please find the document in the enclosure.
examples.zh: 请查收附件中的文件。

examples.en: The zoo has a large enclosure for the elephants.
examples.zh: 动物园有一个大象的大围场。

encyclopedia.collocations: online encyclopedia 在线百科全书, encyclopedia entry 百科全书条目, encyclopedia of science 科学百科全书

examples.en: Wikipedia is the most popular online encyclopedia.
examples.zh: 维基百科是最受欢迎的在线百科全书。

examples.en: He consulted an encyclopedia to find the answer.
examples.zh: 他查阅百科全书寻找答案。

examples.en: The encyclopedia contains thousands of articles.
examples.zh: 这本百科全书包含数千篇文章。

endorse.collocations: endorse a candidate 支持候选人, endorse a product 代言产品, endorse a policy 支持政策

examples.en: The committee endorsed the proposal unanimously.
examples.zh: 委员会一致赞同该提案。

examples.en: Many celebrities endorse beauty products on social media.
examples.zh: 许多名人在社交媒体上代言美容产品。

examples.en: The president endorsed the new trade agreement.
examples.zh: 总统支持新的贸易协定。

endow.collocations: endow with 赋予, endow a scholarship 捐赠奖学金, endow a university 资助大学

examples.en: She was endowed with great musical talent.
examples.zh: 她天生具有音乐天赋。

examples.en: The billionaire endowed a new research center at the university.
examples.zh: 这位亿万富翁在大学捐赠了一个新的研究中心。

examples.en: The foundation endows scholarships for underprivileged students.
examples.zh: 该基金会为贫困学生提供奖学金。

endurance.collocations: physical endurance 身体耐力, mental endurance 心理耐力, endurance test 耐力测试

examples.en: Marathon runners need incredible physical endurance to complete the race.
examples.zh: 马拉松运动员需要惊人的身体耐力才能完成比赛。

examples.en: The project was a test of mental endurance for the entire team.
examples.zh: 这个项目对整个团队来说是一次心理耐力的考验。

examples.en: The car's endurance is proven by its ability to run for thousands of miles without major repairs.
examples.zh: 这辆车的耐久性通过其能够行驶数千英里而无需大修得到证明。

enforce.collocations: enforce the law 执法, enforce rules 执行规则, enforce a policy 实施政策

examples.en: The police are responsible for enforcing the law in the city.
examples.zh: 警察负责在城市中执法。

examples.en: Schools must enforce strict rules to maintain discipline.
examples.zh: 学校必须执行严格的规则以维持纪律。

examples.en: The government decided to enforce a new policy on carbon emissions.
examples.zh: 政府决定实施一项关于碳排放的新政策。

engagement.collocations: engagement ring 订婚戒指, public engagement 公众参与, military engagement 军事交战

examples.en: She showed off her beautiful engagement ring to her friends.
examples.zh: 她向朋友们展示了她美丽的订婚戒指。

examples.en: The company focuses on customer engagement through social media.
examples.zh: 该公司通过社交媒体专注于客户参与。

examples.en: The two armies prepared for a major engagement at dawn.
examples.zh: 两支军队准备在黎明时分进行一场大规模交战。

engine.collocations: car engine 汽车发动机, search engine 搜索引擎, steam engine 蒸汽机

examples.en: The car's engine started making a strange noise.
examples.zh: 汽车的发动机开始发出奇怪的声音。

examples.en: Google is the most popular search engine in the world.
examples.zh: 谷歌是世界上最受欢迎的搜索引擎。

examples.en: The invention of the steam engine revolutionized transportation.
examples.zh: 蒸汽机的发明彻底改变了交通运输。

engineer.collocations: civil engineer 土木工程师, software engineer 软件工程师, mechanical engineer 机械工程师

examples.en: My brother works as a software engineer for a tech company.
examples.zh: 我哥哥在一家科技公司做软件工程师。

examples.en: The civil engineer designed the new bridge over the river.
examples.zh: 土木工程师设计了河上的新桥。

examples.en: Mechanical engineers often work on improving manufacturing processes.
examples.zh: 机械工程师通常致力于改进制造工艺。

engineering.collocations: civil engineering 土木工程, mechanical engineering 机械工程, electrical engineering 电气工程

examples.en: She decided to study civil engineering at university.
examples.zh: 她决定在大学学习土木工程。

examples.en: Mechanical engineering involves designing and manufacturing machines.
examples.zh: 机械工程涉及设计和制造机器。

examples.en: Advances in electrical engineering have led to better energy efficiency.
examples.zh: 电气工程的进步带来了更好的能源效率。

engrave.collocations: engrave a name 刻名字, engrave on metal 在金属上雕刻, engrave in memory 铭记在心

examples.en: The jeweler engraved the couple's names on the wedding rings.
examples.zh: 珠宝商将这对夫妇的名字刻在结婚戒指上。

examples.en: The artist engraved a beautiful landscape on the copper plate.
examples.zh: 艺术家在铜板上雕刻了一幅美丽的风景画。

examples.en: The tragic event was engraved in her memory forever.
examples.zh: 那场悲剧事件永远铭刻在她的记忆中。

enlighten.collocations: enlighten someone 启发某人, enlighten the public 启迪公众, enlighten about 使明白

examples.en: The teacher's words enlightened the students about the importance of critical thinking.
examples.zh: 老师的话启发了学生们批判性思维的重要性。

examples.en: The documentary aims to enlighten the public on environmental issues.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片旨在启迪公众对环境问题的认识。

examples.en: Reading great literature can enlighten the mind and broaden horizons.
examples.zh: 阅读伟大的文学作品可以启迪心智，开阔视野。

enrich.collocations: enrich one's life 丰富生活, enrich the soil 肥沃土壤, enrich uranium 浓缩铀

examples.en: Traveling to different countries can enrich your life experience.
examples.zh: 去不同的国家旅行可以丰富你的生活经历。

examples.en: Adding compost will enrich the soil for better plant growth.
examples.zh: 添加堆肥将使土壤肥沃，促进植物生长。

examples.en: The company specializes in enriching uranium for nuclear power plants.
examples.zh: 这家公司专门为核电站浓缩铀。

enrollment.collocations: school enrollment 学校入学, enrollment fee 注册费, enrollment rate 入学率

examples.en: The university saw a significant increase in enrollment this year.
examples.zh: 这所大学今年的入学人数显著增加。

examples.en: Students must pay an enrollment fee before the start of the semester.
examples.zh: 学生必须在学期开始前支付注册费。

examples.en: The government aims to raise the enrollment rate in rural areas.
examples.zh: 政府旨在提高农村地区的入学率。

ensemble.collocations: musical ensemble 音乐合奏团, ensemble cast 全体演员, ensemble piece 合奏曲

examples.en: The jazz ensemble performed at the concert hall last night.
examples.zh: 爵士合奏团昨晚在音乐厅演出。

examples.en: The film features an ensemble cast of famous actors.
examples.zh: 这部电影由一群著名演员组成全体演员阵容。

examples.en: The ensemble piece required perfect coordination among all musicians.
examples.zh: 这首合奏曲需要所有音乐家之间的完美配合。

ensue.collocations: ensue from 由...引起, chaos ensues 混乱随之而来, debate ensues 辩论接着发生

examples.en: After the announcement, a heated debate ensued among the audience.
examples.zh: 宣布之后，观众中展开了一场激烈的辩论。

examples.en: If the policy is implemented, economic growth will ensue.
examples.zh: 如果这项政策得以实施，经济增长将随之而来。

examples.en: The accident caused a traffic jam that ensued for hours.
examples.zh: 事故导致了持续数小时的交通堵塞。

entertainment.collocations: entertainment industry 娱乐业, live entertainment 现场娱乐, entertainment center 娱乐中心

examples.en: The city offers a wide range of entertainment options for tourists.
examples.zh: 这座城市为游客提供了各种各样的娱乐选择。

examples.en: The entertainment industry has been greatly affected by the pandemic.
examples.zh: 娱乐业受到了疫情的严重影响。

examples.en: They enjoyed live entertainment at the local theater.
examples.zh: 他们在当地剧院欣赏了现场娱乐表演。

enthusiastic.collocations: enthusiastic about 对...热情, enthusiastic support 热情支持, enthusiastic response 热烈反响

examples.en: She is very enthusiastic about learning new languages.
examples.zh: 她对学习新语言非常热情。

examples.en: The proposal received enthusiastic support from the community.
examples.zh: 该提案得到了社区的热情支持。

examples.en: The audience gave an enthusiastic response to the performance.
examples.zh: 观众对表演给予了热烈的反响。

entitle.collocations: entitle someone to 使某人有资格, be entitled to 有权, entitled to vote 有权投票

examples.en: This ticket entitles you to a free drink at the bar.
examples.zh: 这张票使你有权在酒吧免费喝一杯。

examples.en: All citizens are entitled to equal rights under the law.
examples.zh: 所有公民在法律下都有权享有平等权利。

examples.en: The book is entitled 'The Great Gatsby'.
examples.zh: 这本书名为《了不起的盖茨比》。

entity.collocations: business entity 商业实体, legal entity 法律实体, separate entity 独立实体

examples.en: The company is a separate legal entity from its owners.
examples.zh: 该公司是一个独立于其所有者的法律实体。

examples.en: Each department operates as a distinct entity within the organization.
examples.zh: 每个部门在组织内作为一个独特的实体运作。

examples.en: The government recognized the tribe as a sovereign entity.
examples.zh: 政府承认该部落为一个主权实体。

entrance.collocations: main entrance 主入口, entrance exam 入学考试, entrance fee 入场费

examples.en: The main entrance to the building is on the left.
examples.zh: 大楼的主入口在左边。

examples.en: She passed the entrance exam and was admitted to the university.
examples.zh: 她通过了入学考试并被大学录取。

examples.en: Visitors must pay an entrance fee to enter the museum.
examples.zh: 游客必须支付入场费才能进入博物馆。

entrepreneur.collocations: successful entrepreneur 成功企业家, young entrepreneur 年轻创业者, serial entrepreneur 连续创业者

examples.en: The entrepreneur started her own tech company at the age of 25.
examples.zh: 这位企业家在25岁时创办了自己的科技公司。

examples.en: Many young entrepreneurs are turning to social media for marketing.
examples.zh: 许多年轻创业者正在利用社交媒体进行营销。

examples.en: He is a serial entrepreneur who has founded several successful businesses.
examples.zh: 他是一位连续创业者，创立了多家成功的企业。

entry.definition: 进入，入口，条目，参赛作品
entry.collocations: entry into 进入, entry level 入门级, diary entry 日记条目

examples.en: The country restricted entry for foreign travelers during the pandemic.
examples.zh: 疫情期间，该国限制外国游客入境。

examples.en: She applied for an entry-level position at the company.
examples.zh: 她申请了该公司的入门级职位。

examples.en: He wrote a detailed entry in his diary about the day's events.
examples.zh: 他在日记中详细记录了当天的事件。

environmental.collocations: environmental protection 环境保护, environmental issues 环境问题, environmental impact 环境影响

examples.en: The government is taking steps to address environmental issues.
examples.zh: 政府正在采取措施解决环境问题。

examples.en: Environmental protection is a global concern.
examples.zh: 环境保护是一个全球性的关注点。

examples.en: The new factory will have a significant environmental impact on the area.
examples.zh: 新工厂将对当地产生重大的环境影响。

envisage.collocations: envisage a future 展望未来, envisage doing sth 设想做某事, envisage a scenario 设想一个场景

examples.en: The government envisages a significant increase in funding for education.
examples.zh: 政府设想大幅增加教育经费。

examples.en: It is difficult to envisage how the situation will improve.
examples.zh: 很难设想情况会如何改善。

examples.en: The project was envisaged as a long-term investment.
examples.zh: 该项目被设想为一项长期投资。

epidemic.collocations: an epidemic of flu 流感流行, a global epidemic 全球性流行病, an epidemic of crime 犯罪泛滥

examples.en: The outbreak of the epidemic caused widespread panic.
examples.zh: 流行病的爆发引起了广泛的恐慌。

examples.en: There is an epidemic of obesity in many developed countries.
examples.zh: 许多发达国家肥胖问题泛滥。

examples.en: The government took measures to contain the epidemic.
examples.zh: 政府采取措施控制疫情。

episode.collocations: a TV episode 电视剧的一集, a depressive episode 抑郁发作, an episode in history 历史事件

examples.en: The final episode of the series attracted millions of viewers.
examples.zh: 该系列的最后一集吸引了数百万观众。

examples.en: She suffered from a brief episode of anxiety.
examples.zh: 她经历了一段短暂的焦虑发作。

examples.en: This episode in his life shaped his future career.
examples.zh: 他生命中的这段经历塑造了他未来的职业生涯。

epoch.collocations: a new epoch 新时代, an epoch-making discovery 划时代的发现, the colonial epoch 殖民时代

examples.en: The invention of the internet marked a new epoch in communication.
examples.zh: 互联网的发明标志着通信的新纪元。

examples.en: The Renaissance was an epoch of great cultural achievement.
examples.zh: 文艺复兴是一个文化成就辉煌的时代。

examples.en: We are living in an epoch of rapid technological change.
examples.zh: 我们生活在一个技术快速变革的时代。

equal.collocations: equal rights 平等权利, equal opportunity 平等机会, equal to the task 胜任任务

examples.en: All citizens are equal under the law.
examples.zh: 法律面前所有公民一律平等。

examples.en: The two teams are equal in strength.
examples.zh: 两队实力相当。

examples.en: She proved equal to the challenge.
examples.zh: 她证明了自己能应对挑战。

equation.collocations: solve an equation 解方程, a mathematical equation 数学方程式, a chemical equation 化学方程式

examples.en: The students learned how to solve quadratic equations.
examples.zh: 学生们学会了如何解二次方程。

examples.en: The equation of supply and demand determines prices.
examples.zh: 供需平衡决定价格。

examples.en: This factor must be included in the equation.
examples.zh: 这个因素必须纳入考虑。

equator.collocations: the equator 赤道, near the equator 赤道附近, cross the equator 穿越赤道

examples.en: The equator divides the Earth into the Northern and Southern Hemispheres.
examples.zh: 赤道将地球分为北半球和南半球。

examples.en: Countries near the equator have a tropical climate.
examples.zh: 赤道附近的国家属于热带气候。

examples.en: The ship crossed the equator at midnight.
examples.zh: 船在午夜穿越了赤道。

equilibrium.collocations: reach equilibrium 达到平衡, in equilibrium 处于平衡, economic equilibrium 经济均衡

examples.en: The ecosystem maintains a delicate equilibrium.
examples.zh: 生态系统维持着微妙的平衡。

examples.en: The market is in equilibrium when supply equals demand.
examples.zh: 当供给等于需求时，市场处于均衡。

examples.en: He struggled to maintain his emotional equilibrium.
examples.zh: 他努力保持情绪稳定。

equitable.collocations: equitable distribution 公平分配, equitable treatment 公平对待, an equitable solution 公平的解决方案

examples.en: The government aims to achieve equitable access to healthcare.
examples.zh: 政府旨在实现医疗服务的公平获取。

examples.en: An equitable tax system is essential for social justice.
examples.zh: 公平的税收制度对社会正义至关重要。

examples.en: The judge made an equitable decision.
examples.zh: 法官做出了公正的判决。

equity.collocations: social equity 社会公平, gender equity 性别平等, equity capital 股本

examples.en: The company issued new equity to raise funds.
examples.zh: 公司发行新股以筹集资金。

examples.en: The principle of equity is fundamental to a just society.
examples.zh: 公平原则是公正社会的基础。

examples.en: Home equity loans are popular among homeowners.
examples.zh: 房屋净值贷款在房主中很受欢迎。

eradicate.collocations: eradicate poverty 消除贫困, eradicate disease 根除疾病, eradicate corruption 根除腐败

examples.en: The government is committed to eradicating illiteracy.
examples.zh: 政府致力于扫除文盲。

examples.en: Smallpox has been completely eradicated worldwide.
examples.zh: 天花已在全球范围内被彻底根除。

examples.en: Efforts to eradicate the virus have been successful.
examples.zh: 根除病毒的努力取得了成功。

erase.collocations: erase a memory 抹去记忆, erase data 删除数据, erase a mistake 消除错误

examples.en: He erased the whiteboard with a cloth.
examples.zh: 他用布擦掉了白板。

examples.en: The file was accidentally erased from the computer.
examples.zh: 文件意外地从电脑中被删除了。

examples.en: Time cannot erase the pain of losing a loved one.
examples.zh: 时间无法抹去失去亲人的痛苦。

erect.collocations: erect a building 建造大楼, erect a monument 竖立纪念碑, erect a fence 竖起篱笆

examples.en: The city plans to erect a new library in the park.
examples.zh: 该市计划在公园里建造一座新图书馆。

examples.en: They erected a tent for the camping trip.
examples.zh: 他们为露营旅行搭起了帐篷。

examples.en: A statue was erected in honor of the hero.
examples.zh: 为纪念英雄竖立了一座雕像。

erosion.collocations: soil erosion 土壤侵蚀, coastal erosion 海岸侵蚀, erosion of confidence 信心削弱

examples.en: Deforestation leads to severe soil erosion.
examples.zh: 森林砍伐导致严重的土壤侵蚀。

examples.en: The cliffs are subject to constant erosion by the sea.
examples.zh: 悬崖不断受到海水的侵蚀。

examples.en: There has been a gradual erosion of public trust in the media.
examples.zh: 公众对媒体的信任逐渐削弱。

erratic.definition: 不稳定的；反复无常的；飘忽不定的
erratic.collocations: erratic behavior 反复无常的行为, erratic weather 变化无常的天气, erratic performance 不稳定的表现

examples.en: The stock market has been erratic this month.
examples.zh: 本月股市一直不稳定。

examples.en: His erratic driving worried the passengers.
examples.zh: 他忽快忽慢的驾驶让乘客担心。

examples.en: The patient's heartbeat was erratic.
examples.zh: 病人的心跳不规律。

erupt.collocations: volcano erupts 火山喷发, erupt in anger 勃然大怒, conflict erupts 冲突爆发

examples.en: The volcano erupted after decades of dormancy.
examples.zh: 火山在沉寂了几十年后喷发了。

examples.en: Violence erupted during the protest.
examples.zh: 抗议期间爆发了暴力事件。

examples.en: The crowd erupted in cheers when the goal was scored.
examples.zh: 进球时人群爆发出欢呼声。

escalate.collocations: escalate a conflict 使冲突升级, escalate tensions 加剧紧张局势, escalate costs 成本上升

examples.en: The dispute escalated into a full-scale war.
examples.zh: 争端升级为全面战争。

examples.en: The company's losses escalated rapidly.
examples.zh: 公司的亏损迅速加剧。

examples.en: The government fears the protests may escalate.
examples.zh: 政府担心抗议活动可能升级。

escort.collocations: escort someone home 送某人回家, escort a convoy 护送车队, under escort 在护送下

examples.en: The police escorted the VIP to the airport.
examples.zh: 警察护送贵宾前往机场。

examples.en: She was escorted out of the building by security.
examples.zh: 她被保安护送出了大楼。

examples.en: The convoy was escorted by military vehicles.
examples.zh: 车队由军用车辆护送。

essay.collocations: write an essay 写文章, a critical essay 评论文章, a personal essay 个人随笔

examples.en: She wrote an essay on the effects of climate change.
examples.zh: 她写了一篇关于气候变化影响的文章。

examples.en: The essay was well-structured and persuasive.
examples.zh: 这篇文章结构清晰，有说服力。

examples.en: He submitted his essay for the competition.
examples.zh: 他提交了参赛论文。

essence.collocations: the essence of life 生命的本质, in essence 本质上, capture the essence 抓住精髓

examples.en: The essence of democracy is freedom of choice.
examples.zh: 民主的本质是选择自由。

examples.en: In essence, the argument is about fairness.
examples.zh: 本质上，争论是关于公平。

examples.en: The perfume captures the essence of roses.
examples.zh: 这款香水捕捉了玫瑰的精华。

estate.collocations: real estate 房地产, estate agent 房地产经纪人, estate tax 遗产税

examples.en: He inherited a large estate from his grandfather.
examples.zh: 他从祖父那里继承了一大笔遗产。

examples.en: The company invests heavily in real estate.
examples.zh: 这家公司大量投资于房地产。

examples.en: The estate includes a mansion and several acres of land.
examples.zh: 这个庄园包括一座豪宅和几英亩土地。

esteem.collocations: hold in high esteem 非常尊重, self-esteem 自尊, esteem highly 高度评价

examples.en: She is held in high esteem by her colleagues.
examples.zh: 她深受同事们的尊重。

examples.en: Low self-esteem can affect a person's mental health.
examples.zh: 低自尊会影响一个人的心理健康。

examples.en: We esteem him as a great leader.
examples.zh: 我们尊他为伟大的领袖。

estimate.collocations: rough estimate 粗略估计, estimate the cost 估算成本, estimate at 估计为

examples.en: The contractor gave us an estimate for the renovation.
examples.zh: 承包商给了我们一个翻新的估价。

examples.en: It is difficult to estimate the number of participants.
examples.zh: 很难估计参与者的数量。

examples.en: The damage was estimated at millions of dollars.
examples.zh: 损失估计达数百万美元。

eternal.collocations: eternal life 永生, eternal love 永恒的爱, eternal truth 永恒的真理

examples.en: Many religions promise eternal life after death.
examples.zh: 许多宗教承诺死后永生。

examples.en: Their love seemed eternal, but it ended in tragedy.
examples.zh: 他们的爱似乎是永恒的，但以悲剧告终。

examples.en: The search for eternal youth is a common theme in literature.
examples.zh: 对永恒青春的追求是文学中常见的主题。

ethnic.definition: 种族的；民族的；具有民族特色的
ethnic.collocations: ethnic group 族群, ethnic minority 少数民族, ethnic conflict 种族冲突

examples.en: The country is home to many different ethnic groups.
examples.zh: 这个国家有许多不同的族群。

examples.en: Ethnic minorities often face discrimination in the job market.
examples.zh: 少数民族在就业市场上经常面临歧视。

examples.en: The restaurant serves a variety of ethnic cuisines.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅提供各种民族特色菜肴。

etiquette.collocations: social etiquette 社交礼仪, business etiquette 商务礼仪, table etiquette 餐桌礼仪

examples.en: It is important to observe proper etiquette in formal settings.
examples.zh: 在正式场合遵守适当的礼仪很重要。

examples.en: Business etiquette varies from country to country.
examples.zh: 商务礼仪因国家而异。

examples.en: She was taught table etiquette from a young age.
examples.zh: 她从小就被教导餐桌礼仪。

evacuate.collocations: evacuate the building 疏散大楼, evacuate residents 疏散居民, evacuate the area 撤离该区域

examples.en: The entire building was evacuated due to a fire alarm.
examples.zh: 由于火警，整栋大楼被疏散。

examples.en: Residents were evacuated from the flood zone.
examples.zh: 居民从洪水区撤离。

examples.en: The army helped evacuate civilians from the war zone.
examples.zh: 军队帮助疏散了战区的平民。

evade.collocations: evade taxes 逃税, evade the question 回避问题, evade capture 逃避抓捕

examples.en: Some companies try to evade taxes through loopholes.
examples.zh: 一些公司试图通过漏洞逃税。

examples.en: The politician evaded the reporter's question skillfully.
examples.zh: 这位政治家巧妙地回避了记者的提问。

examples.en: The fugitive managed to evade the police for weeks.
examples.zh: 逃犯设法躲避了警察数周。

evaporate.collocations: evaporate quickly 迅速蒸发, evaporate into thin air 消失得无影无踪, evaporate water 蒸发水

examples.en: The water in the puddle evaporated under the hot sun.
examples.zh: 水坑里的水在烈日下蒸发了。

examples.en: His hopes of winning the lottery evaporated when he lost the ticket.
examples.zh: 当他丢了彩票时，他中奖的希望破灭了。

examples.en: The solvent evaporates, leaving a thin film on the surface.
examples.zh: 溶剂蒸发后，在表面留下一层薄膜。

even.definition: 甚至；即使；平坦的；相等的
even.collocations: even though 即使, even if 即使, even number 偶数, even surface 平坦的表面

examples.en: Even though it rained, we still went for a walk.
examples.zh: 即使下雨了，我们还是去散步了。

examples.en: The scores were even at halftime.
examples.zh: 半场时比分持平。

examples.en: She is even more talented than her sister.
examples.zh: 她甚至比她姐姐更有才华。

event.collocations: current events 时事, special event 特殊事件, sporting event 体育赛事

examples.en: The conference was a major event in the academic calendar.
examples.zh: 这次会议是学术日历中的一项重要活动。

examples.en: The Olympic Games include many different events.
examples.zh: 奥运会包括许多不同的比赛项目。

examples.en: The event attracted thousands of visitors from around the world.
examples.zh: 该活动吸引了来自世界各地的数千名游客。

eventually.collocations: eventually succeed 最终成功, eventually realize 最终意识到, eventually arrive 最终到达

examples.en: After years of hard work, he eventually achieved his goal.
examples.zh: 经过多年的努力，他终于实现了目标。

examples.en: The lost hikers were eventually found by the rescue team.
examples.zh: 迷路的徒步者最终被救援队找到。

examples.en: She eventually decided to pursue a career in medicine.
examples.zh: 她最终决定从事医学事业。

evidence.collocations: strong evidence 强有力的证据, evidence of 的证据, provide evidence 提供证据

examples.en: The police found evidence linking the suspect to the crime.
examples.zh: 警方发现了将嫌疑人与犯罪联系起来的证据。

examples.en: There is growing evidence that exercise improves mental health.
examples.zh: 越来越多的证据表明锻炼可以改善心理健康。

examples.en: The scientist presented evidence to support her theory.
examples.zh: 科学家提供了支持她理论的证据。

evoke.collocations: evoke memories 唤起回忆, evoke emotions 引发情感, evoke a response 引起反应

examples.en: The old photograph evoked memories of her childhood.
examples.zh: 这张老照片唤起了她童年的回忆。

examples.en: The music evoked a sense of nostalgia in the audience.
examples.zh: 音乐在观众中引发了一种怀旧感。

examples.en: His speech evoked a strong emotional response from the crowd.
examples.zh: 他的演讲引起了人群强烈的情感反应。

evolution.collocations: theory of evolution 进化论, evolution of technology 技术演变, gradual evolution 逐步演变

examples.en: Darwin's theory of evolution revolutionized biology.
examples.zh: 达尔文的进化论彻底改变了生物学。

examples.en: The evolution of smartphones has changed the way we communicate.
examples.zh: 智能手机的演变改变了我们的沟通方式。

examples.en: The company has undergone a significant evolution in its business model.
examples.zh: 该公司的商业模式经历了重大演变。

exaggerate.collocations: exaggerate the truth 夸大事实, exaggerate the importance 夸大重要性, exaggerate a story 夸大故事

examples.en: He tends to exaggerate his achievements to impress others.
examples.zh: 他倾向于夸大自己的成就以给人留下深刻印象。

examples.en: The media often exaggerates the risks of certain activities.
examples.zh: 媒体经常夸大某些活动的风险。

examples.en: Don't exaggerate; it's not that bad.
examples.zh: 别夸张了，没那么糟。

examination.collocations: final examination 期末考试, medical examination 体检, examination paper 试卷

examples.en: Students are preparing for the final examination.
examples.zh: 学生们正在准备期末考试。

examples.en: The doctor performed a thorough examination of the patient.
examples.zh: 医生对病人进行了彻底检查。

examples.en: The examination of the evidence took several hours.
examples.zh: 对证据的审查花了几个小时。

example.collocations: for example 例如, set an example 树立榜样, example of 的例子

examples.en: For example, regular exercise can improve your health.
examples.zh: 例如，定期锻炼可以改善你的健康。

examples.en: She set a good example for her younger siblings.
examples.zh: 她为弟弟妹妹树立了好榜样。

examples.en: This painting is a classic example of Renaissance art.
examples.zh: 这幅画是文艺复兴艺术的经典范例。

exceedingly.collocations: exceedingly difficult 极其困难, exceedingly rare 极其罕见, exceedingly important 极其重要

examples.en: The task was exceedingly difficult, but she managed to complete it.
examples.zh: 这项任务极其困难，但她设法完成了。

examples.en: This species is exceedingly rare in the wild.
examples.zh: 这个物种在野外极其罕见。

examples.en: It is exceedingly important to follow the safety instructions.
examples.zh: 遵循安全说明极其重要。

excel.collocations: excel at 擅长, excel in 在...方面出色, excel oneself 超越自己

examples.en: She excels at mathematics and science.
examples.zh: 她擅长数学和科学。

examples.en: He excelled in sports during his school years.
examples.zh: 他在学生时代在体育方面表现出色。

examples.en: The team excelled themselves in the championship game.
examples.zh: 这支队伍在冠军赛中超越了自我。

exceptional.definition: 杰出的，卓越的；例外的，异常的
exceptional.collocations: exceptional talent 卓越的才能, exceptional circumstances 特殊情况, exceptional performance 出色的表现

examples.en: She has an exceptional ability to solve complex problems.
examples.zh: 她具有解决复杂问题的卓越能力。

examples.en: The school provides support for students with exceptional needs.
examples.zh: 学校为有特殊需求的学生提供支持。

examples.en: His exceptional performance earned him a promotion.
examples.zh: 他出色的表现为他赢得了晋升。

excerpt.collocations: excerpt from a book 书中摘录, read an excerpt 阅读摘录, publish an excerpt 发表摘录

examples.en: The teacher read an excerpt from the novel to the class.
examples.zh: 老师给全班读了小说中的一个片段。

examples.en: The magazine published an excerpt of the interview.
examples.zh: 杂志刊登了采访的摘录。

examples.en: She chose an excerpt that best represented the author's style.
examples.zh: 她选择了最能代表作者风格的摘录。

exchange.collocations: exchange ideas 交流想法, exchange rate 汇率, exchange program 交换项目

examples.en: We exchanged contact information after the meeting.
examples.zh: 会议后我们交换了联系方式。

examples.en: The exchange rate between the dollar and the euro has fluctuated.
examples.zh: 美元和欧元之间的汇率波动了。

examples.en: She participated in a cultural exchange program in Japan.
examples.zh: 她参加了日本的文化交流项目。

excitement.definition: 兴奋，激动；令人兴奋的事物
excitement.collocations: great excitement 极大的兴奋, cause excitement 引起兴奋, with excitement 兴奋地

examples.en: The children were filled with excitement on Christmas morning.
examples.zh: 孩子们在圣诞节早晨充满了兴奋。

examples.en: The announcement caused great excitement among the employees.
examples.zh: 这个公告在员工中引起了极大的兴奋。

examples.en: She could hardly contain her excitement when she heard the news.
examples.zh: 听到这个消息时，她几乎无法抑制自己的兴奋。

exciting.definition: 令人兴奋的，激动人心的
exciting.collocations: exciting news 令人兴奋的消息, exciting opportunity 激动人心的机会, exciting experience 令人兴奋的经历

examples.en: It was an exciting match that kept the audience on the edge of their seats.
examples.zh: 这是一场激动人心的比赛，让观众紧张不已。

examples.en: She found the prospect of traveling abroad very exciting.
examples.zh: 她觉得出国旅行的前景非常令人兴奋。

examples.en: The company announced an exciting new product launch.
examples.zh: 公司宣布了一个激动人心的新产品发布。

exclaim.collocations: exclaim in surprise 惊讶地呼喊, exclaim with joy 高兴地呼喊, exclaim loudly 大声呼喊

examples.en: "What a beautiful view!" she exclaimed as she looked out the window.
examples.zh: “多美的景色啊！”她看着窗外喊道。

examples.en: He exclaimed in surprise when he saw the unexpected gift.
examples.zh: 看到意想不到的礼物时，他惊讶地叫了起来。

examples.en: The children exclaimed with joy when they saw the snow.
examples.zh: 孩子们看到雪时高兴地欢呼起来。

exclusive.definition: 独有的，排外的；高档的，专有的
exclusive.collocations: exclusive right 专有权, exclusive interview 独家采访, exclusive club 高级俱乐部

examples.en: The hotel offers exclusive access to a private beach.
examples.zh: 这家酒店提供私人海滩的独家使用权。

examples.en: She gave an exclusive interview to the magazine.
examples.zh: 她接受了该杂志的独家采访。

examples.en: The club is very exclusive and only accepts members by invitation.
examples.zh: 这个俱乐部非常排外，只接受邀请会员。

excursion.collocations: go on an excursion 去远足, school excursion 学校远足, excursion ticket 游览票

examples.en: We went on an excursion to the mountains last weekend.
examples.zh: 上周末我们去山里远足了。

examples.en: The school organized an excursion to the science museum.
examples.zh: 学校组织了一次去科学博物馆的远足。

examples.en: The excursion included a guided tour of the ancient ruins.
examples.zh: 这次短途旅行包括对古代遗址的导游参观。

excuse.collocations: make an excuse 找借口, excuse me 对不起, accept an excuse 接受道歉

examples.en: He made a weak excuse for being late.
examples.zh: 他为迟到找了一个牵强的借口。

examples.en: Excuse me, could you tell me the way to the station?
examples.zh: 对不起，你能告诉我去车站的路吗？

examples.en: She excused herself from the meeting due to a headache.
examples.zh: 她因头痛而请求离开会议。

execute.collocations: execute a plan 执行计划, execute a command 执行命令, execute a prisoner 处决囚犯

examples.en: The team executed the project flawlessly.
examples.zh: 团队完美地执行了项目。

examples.en: The computer executed the instructions quickly.
examples.zh: 计算机快速执行了指令。

examples.en: The king ordered the traitor to be executed.
examples.zh: 国王下令处决叛徒。

execution.definition: 执行，实施；处决；表演技巧
execution.collocations: plan execution 计划执行, execution of duties 职责履行, stay of execution 缓期执行

examples.en: The execution of the strategy was carried out efficiently.
examples.zh: 该战略的执行效率很高。

examples.en: The prisoner's execution was scheduled for dawn.
examples.zh: 囚犯的处决定在黎明时分。

examples.en: The musician's execution of the piece was flawless.
examples.zh: 这位音乐家对这首曲子的演奏完美无瑕。

executive.definition: 行政的，执行的；高管，经理
executive.collocations: executive director 执行董事, executive summary 执行摘要, chief executive officer 首席执行官

examples.en: She works as a senior executive in a multinational company.
examples.zh: 她在一家跨国公司担任高级主管。

examples.en: The executive committee made the final decision.
examples.zh: 执行委员会做出了最终决定。

examples.en: He has strong executive skills and leads the team effectively.
examples.zh: 他具有很强的执行能力，能有效领导团队。

exemplify.definition: 例证，举例说明；是……的典型
exemplify.collocations: exemplify a point 举例说明观点, exemplify a trend 体现趋势, exemplify excellence 体现卓越

examples.en: This case exemplifies the challenges faced by small businesses.
examples.zh: 这个案例说明了小企业面临的挑战。

examples.en: Her dedication exemplifies the spirit of volunteerism.
examples.zh: 她的奉献精神体现了志愿精神。

examples.en: The architect's work exemplifies modern design principles.
examples.zh: 这位建筑师的作品体现了现代设计原则。

exempt.collocations: exempt from tax 免税, exempt from duty 免职, exempt status 豁免身份

examples.en: Students from low-income families are exempt from tuition fees.
examples.zh: 来自低收入家庭的学生免交学费。

examples.en: The charity is exempt from paying taxes.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构免于纳税。

examples.en: He was exempted from military service due to a medical condition.
examples.zh: 他因健康原因被免除兵役。

exercise.collocations: do exercise 做运动, physical exercise 体育锻炼, exercise caution 谨慎行事

examples.en: Regular exercise is essential for good health.
examples.zh: 定期锻炼对健康至关重要。

examples.en: The teacher gave the students a grammar exercise to complete.
examples.zh: 老师给学生布置了语法练习。

examples.en: Citizens should exercise their right to vote.
examples.zh: 公民应行使投票权。

exert.collocations: exert pressure 施加压力, exert influence 施加影响, exert oneself 尽力

examples.en: Parents should not exert too much pressure on their children.
examples.zh: 父母不应给孩子施加过多压力。

examples.en: She exerted all her strength to lift the heavy box.
examples.zh: 她使出全身力气去搬那个重箱子。

examples.en: The organization exerts significant influence on government policy.
examples.zh: 该组织对政府政策施加了重大影响。

exhaust.definition: 耗尽，使精疲力尽；排气装置
exhaust.collocations: exhaust resources 耗尽资源, exhaust oneself 筋疲力尽, exhaust pipe 排气管

examples.en: The long journey exhausted the travelers.
examples.zh: 长途旅行使旅行者筋疲力尽。

examples.en: We have exhausted all possible options.
examples.zh: 我们已经用尽了所有可能的选择。

examples.en: The car's exhaust system needs to be replaced.
examples.zh: 汽车的排气系统需要更换。

exhibition.collocations: art exhibition 艺术展览, hold an exhibition 举办展览, exhibition hall 展览厅

examples.en: There is an exhibition of modern art at the gallery.
examples.zh: 画廊里有一个现代艺术展览。

examples.en: The exhibition attracted thousands of visitors.
examples.zh: 这次展览吸引了成千上万的参观者。

examples.en: His behavior was an exhibition of poor manners.
examples.zh: 他的行为是缺乏礼貌的表现。

exile.collocations: live in exile 流亡生活, go into exile 流亡, political exile 政治流亡者

examples.en: The dictator was forced into exile after the revolution.
examples.zh: 革命后，独裁者被迫流亡。

examples.en: He spent many years in exile in a foreign country.
examples.zh: 他在异国他乡流亡多年。

examples.en: The writer was exiled for his political views.
examples.zh: 这位作家因政治观点被流放。

existence.collocations: come into existence 产生, in existence 存在的, struggle for existence 生存斗争

examples.en: The company has been in existence for over a century.
examples.zh: 这家公司已经存在了一个多世纪。

examples.en: Many species are threatened with extinction and may cease to exist.
examples.zh: 许多物种面临灭绝威胁，可能不复存在。

examples.en: He led a simple existence in the countryside.
examples.zh: 他在乡下过着简朴的生活。

existent.collocations: existent problem 存在的问题, existent data 现有数据, currently existent 目前存在的

examples.en: The existent evidence supports the theory.
examples.zh: 现有的证据支持这个理论。

examples.en: We need to address the existent issues in the system.
examples.zh: 我们需要解决系统中存在的问题。

examples.en: The existent laws are insufficient to regulate new technologies.
examples.zh: 现有的法律不足以规范新技术。

exotic.collocations: exotic species 外来物种, exotic cuisine 异国美食, exotic destination 异国目的地

examples.en: The zoo has a collection of exotic animals from around the world.
examples.zh: 动物园里收藏了来自世界各地的奇异动物。

examples.en: She enjoys cooking exotic dishes from different cultures.
examples.zh: 她喜欢烹饪来自不同文化的异国菜肴。

examples.en: Exotic plants can sometimes become invasive in new environments.
examples.zh: 外来植物有时会在新环境中变得具有侵略性。

expansion.collocations: economic expansion 经济扩张, urban expansion 城市扩张, expansion plan 扩张计划

examples.en: The company's rapid expansion led to increased profits.
examples.zh: 公司的快速扩张带来了利润的增长。

examples.en: Urban expansion often results in loss of farmland.
examples.zh: 城市扩张常常导致农田的损失。

examples.en: The expansion of the universe is a key concept in cosmology.
examples.zh: 宇宙膨胀是宇宙学中的一个关键概念。

expectancy.collocations: life expectancy 预期寿命, expectancy of success 成功的期望, market expectancy 市场预期

examples.en: Life expectancy has increased significantly over the past century.
examples.zh: 过去一个世纪里，预期寿命显著增加。

examples.en: There is a general expectancy that the economy will improve.
examples.zh: 普遍预期经济将会改善。

examples.en: The team played with a sense of expectancy before the final match.
examples.zh: 球队在决赛前带着期待的心情比赛。

expedition.collocations: scientific expedition 科学考察, expedition team 探险队, mountaineering expedition 登山探险

examples.en: The expedition to the Arctic was fraught with danger.
examples.zh: 北极探险充满了危险。

examples.en: They organized a scientific expedition to study the rainforest.
examples.zh: 他们组织了一次科学考察来研究雨林。

examples.en: The mountaineering expedition successfully reached the summit.
examples.zh: 登山探险队成功登顶。

expel.collocations: expel a student 开除学生, expel air 排出空气, expel an invader 驱逐入侵者

examples.en: The school decided to expel the student for cheating.
examples.zh: 学校决定开除那个作弊的学生。

examples.en: The lungs expel carbon dioxide when we breathe out.
examples.zh: 当我们呼气时，肺部排出二氧化碳。

examples.en: The government expelled the foreign diplomat for spying.
examples.zh: 政府因间谍活动驱逐了外国外交官。

expend.collocations: expend energy 消耗能量, expend resources 消耗资源, expend effort 花费精力

examples.en: The project will expend a large amount of financial resources.
examples.zh: 这个项目将消耗大量的财政资源。

examples.en: Athletes expend a lot of energy during training.
examples.zh: 运动员在训练中消耗大量能量。

examples.en: We should not expend too much effort on trivial matters.
examples.zh: 我们不应该在琐事上花费太多精力。

expenditure.collocations: government expenditure 政府支出, household expenditure 家庭支出, capital expenditure 资本支出

examples.en: The government has reduced expenditure on defense.
examples.zh: 政府减少了国防支出。

examples.en: Household expenditure on food has decreased over the years.
examples.zh: 多年来家庭在食品上的支出有所减少。

examples.en: The company's capital expenditure on new equipment was substantial.
examples.zh: 公司在新设备上的资本支出相当大。

expensive.collocations: expensive car 昂贵的汽车, expensive taste 高品味, expensive mistake 代价高昂的错误

examples.en: Living in the city center is more expensive than in the suburbs.
examples.zh: 住在市中心比住在郊区更昂贵。

examples.en: She has expensive taste in clothing and accessories.
examples.zh: 她在服装和配饰方面品味很高。

examples.en: Making a wrong decision can be an expensive mistake for the company.
examples.zh: 做出错误决定对公司来说可能是一个代价高昂的错误。

expertise.definition: 专业知识；专门技能；专长
expertise.collocations: technical expertise 技术专长, professional expertise 专业能力, expertise in finance 金融专业知识

examples.en: The consultant brought a wealth of expertise to the project.
examples.zh: 顾问为项目带来了丰富的专业知识。

examples.en: Her expertise in marketing helped the company grow.
examples.zh: 她在市场营销方面的专长帮助公司成长。

examples.en: We need to hire someone with expertise in data analysis.
examples.zh: 我们需要雇佣一位在数据分析方面有专长的人。

expire.collocations: contract expires 合同到期, passport expires 护照过期, deadline expires 截止日期

examples.en: My passport will expire next year, so I need to renew it.
examples.zh: 我的护照明年到期，所以我需要续签。

examples.en: The offer expires at midnight tonight.
examples.zh: 优惠今晚午夜截止。

examples.en: The patient expired peacefully in his sleep.
examples.zh: 病人在睡梦中安详地去世了。

explode.collocations: bomb explodes 炸弹爆炸, population explodes 人口激增, explode with anger 勃然大怒

examples.en: The bomb exploded in the city center, causing widespread damage.
examples.zh: 炸弹在市中心爆炸，造成了广泛的破坏。

examples.en: The population of the city has exploded in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年来该市人口激增。

examples.en: He exploded with anger when he heard the news.
examples.zh: 他听到消息后勃然大怒。

explore.collocations: explore space 探索太空, explore options 探讨选项, explore a city 探索城市

examples.en: Scientists are exploring the possibility of life on Mars.
examples.zh: 科学家正在探索火星上存在生命的可能性。

examples.en: We need to explore all available options before making a decision.
examples.zh: 在做决定之前，我们需要探讨所有可用的选项。

examples.en: Tourists love to explore the historic streets of the old town.
examples.zh: 游客喜欢探索老城的历史街道。

explosion.collocations: gas explosion 瓦斯爆炸, population explosion 人口爆炸, explosion of data 数据激增

examples.en: The gas explosion destroyed several buildings in the area.
examples.zh: 瓦斯爆炸摧毁了该地区的几栋建筑。

examples.en: The population explosion in developing countries poses challenges.
examples.zh: 发展中国家的人口爆炸带来了挑战。

examples.en: There has been an explosion of data in the digital age.
examples.zh: 数字时代数据激增。

explosive.collocations: explosive device 爆炸装置, explosive growth 爆炸性增长, explosive temper 暴躁脾气

examples.en: The police found an explosive device in the abandoned car.
examples.zh: 警方在废弃的汽车里发现了一个爆炸装置。

examples.en: The company experienced explosive growth in its first year.
examples.zh: 该公司在第一年经历了爆炸性增长。

examples.en: He has an explosive temper and often loses his cool.
examples.zh: 他脾气暴躁，经常失去冷静。

export.collocations: export goods 出口货物, export market 出口市场, export revenue 出口收入

examples.en: The country exports a large amount of oil to other nations.
examples.zh: 该国向其他国家出口大量石油。

examples.en: Export revenue has declined due to global economic slowdown.
examples.zh: 由于全球经济放缓，出口收入下降。

examples.en: They are looking for new export markets for their products.
examples.zh: 他们正在为产品寻找新的出口市场。

exposition.collocations: world exposition 世界博览会, art exposition 艺术展, exposition of ideas 观点阐述

examples.en: The world exposition attracted millions of visitors from around the globe.
examples.zh: 世界博览会吸引了来自全球的数百万游客。

examples.en: The art exposition featured works by contemporary artists.
examples.zh: 艺术展展出了当代艺术家的作品。

examples.en: His exposition of the theory was clear and concise.
examples.zh: 他对理论的阐述清晰而简洁。

exposure.collocations: sun exposure 日晒, exposure to risk 风险暴露, media exposure 媒体曝光

examples.en: Prolonged sun exposure can cause skin damage.
examples.zh: 长时间日晒会导致皮肤损伤。

examples.en: The workers had high exposure to harmful chemicals.
examples.zh: 工人们大量接触有害化学物质。

examples.en: The scandal received widespread media exposure.
examples.zh: 丑闻受到了广泛的媒体曝光。

expulsion.collocations: expulsion from school 开除学籍, expulsion of air 空气排出, expulsion order 驱逐令

examples.en: The student faced expulsion for repeated violations of school rules.
examples.zh: 该学生因多次违反校规面临开除。

examples.en: The expulsion of waste gases is necessary for the engine to function.
examples.zh: 废气的排出是发动机运转所必需的。

examples.en: The government issued an expulsion order against the illegal immigrants.
examples.zh: 政府发布了针对非法移民的驱逐令。

exquisite.collocations: exquisite craftsmanship 精湛工艺, exquisite taste 高雅品味, exquisite beauty 精美绝伦

examples.en: The necklace was made with exquisite craftsmanship.
examples.zh: 这条项链制作工艺精湛。

examples.en: She has an exquisite sense of style and elegance.
examples.zh: 她有着高雅时尚的品味。

examples.en: The garden was filled with exquisite flowers of every color.
examples.zh: 花园里开满了各种颜色的精美花朵。

extension.definition: 延伸；扩展；延期；电话分机
extension.collocations: extension of time 时间延长, extension service 推广服务, extension cord 延长线

examples.en: The company applied for an extension of the deadline.
examples.zh: 公司申请了截止日期的延期。

examples.en: We built an extension to the house to create more space.
examples.zh: 我们扩建了房子以创造更多空间。

examples.en: You can reach me at my desk extension.
examples.zh: 你可以通过我的办公桌分机联系我。

extent.collocations: to some extent 在某种程度上, to a large extent 在很大程度上, extent of damage 损害程度

examples.en: To some extent, the decision was based on financial considerations.
examples.zh: 在某种程度上，这个决定是基于财务考虑。

examples.en: The extent of the forest fire was alarming.
examples.zh: 森林火灾的范围令人震惊。

examples.en: We need to assess the full extent of the problem.
examples.zh: 我们需要评估问题的全部程度。

exterior.definition: 外部；外表；外部的；外用的
exterior.collocations: exterior wall 外墙, exterior design 外观设计, exterior paint 外墙涂料

examples.en: The exterior of the building is made of glass.
examples.zh: 这座建筑的外部由玻璃制成。

examples.en: He maintained a calm exterior despite his anxiety.
examples.zh: 尽管焦虑，他仍保持冷静的外表。

examples.en: Exterior paint needs to be weather-resistant.
examples.zh: 外墙涂料需要耐候。

extinct.collocations: extinct species 灭绝物种, become extinct 灭绝, extinct volcano 死火山

examples.en: Many species have become extinct due to human activity.
examples.zh: 许多物种因人类活动而灭绝。

examples.en: The volcano is considered extinct.
examples.zh: 这座火山被认为是死火山。

examples.en: Efforts are being made to prevent the tiger from going extinct.
examples.zh: 正在努力防止老虎灭绝。

extinguish.collocations: extinguish a fire 灭火, extinguish hope 使希望破灭, extinguish a cigarette 熄灭香烟

examples.en: Firefighters quickly extinguished the blaze.
examples.zh: 消防员迅速扑灭了大火。

examples.en: The news extinguished any hope of recovery.
examples.zh: 这个消息使任何恢复的希望破灭。

examples.en: Please extinguish all cigarettes before entering.
examples.zh: 进入前请熄灭所有香烟。

extra.definition: 额外的；附加的；额外费用；特别地
extra.collocations: extra charge 额外费用, extra time 额外时间, extra work 额外工作

examples.en: There is an extra charge for checked baggage.
examples.zh: 托运行李需要额外收费。

examples.en: She works extra hours to earn more money.
examples.zh: 她加班工作以赚更多钱。

examples.en: The hotel offers extra services like laundry.
examples.zh: 酒店提供洗衣等额外服务。

extravagant.definition: 奢侈的；浪费的；过度的；放肆的
extravagant.collocations: extravagant lifestyle 奢侈的生活方式, extravagant spending 挥霍, extravagant claims 过分的说法

examples.en: She has an extravagant taste in clothes.
examples.zh: 她对衣服有奢侈的品味。

examples.en: The party was extravagant, with live music and gourmet food.
examples.zh: 派对很奢侈，有现场音乐和美食。

examples.en: His extravagant claims were met with skepticism.
examples.zh: 他过分的说法遭到了怀疑。

extreme.definition: 极端的；极度的；极端；极端的事物
extreme.collocations: extreme weather 极端天气, extreme sports 极限运动, extreme poverty 极度贫困

examples.en: The region is experiencing extreme drought.
examples.zh: 该地区正经历极端干旱。

examples.en: He enjoys extreme sports like bungee jumping.
examples.zh: 他喜欢蹦极等极限运动。

examples.en: The government must address extreme poverty.
examples.zh: 政府必须解决极度贫困问题。

exuberant.definition: 精力充沛的；热情洋溢的；茂盛的
exuberant.collocations: exuberant personality 充满活力的个性, exuberant growth 茂盛生长, exuberant celebration 热烈的庆祝

examples.en: The children were exuberant at the party.
examples.zh: 孩子们在派对上精力充沛。

examples.en: The garden is full of exuberant vegetation.
examples.zh: 花园里长满了茂盛的植物。

examples.en: Her exuberant laughter filled the room.
examples.zh: 她热情洋溢的笑声充满了房间。

fabric.collocations: cotton fabric 棉织物, fabric of society 社会结构, synthetic fabric 合成纤维

examples.en: This fabric is made of 100% cotton.
examples.zh: 这种布料是100%棉的。

examples.en: The fabric of the building was damaged by the earthquake.
examples.zh: 建筑的结构被地震损坏了。

examples.en: Social media has changed the fabric of communication.
examples.zh: 社交媒体改变了沟通的结构。

fabricate.collocations: fabricate evidence 伪造证据, fabricate a story 编造故事, fabricate parts 制造零件

examples.en: The company fabricates metal components for cars.
examples.zh: 这家公司制造汽车金属部件。

examples.en: He fabricated an excuse for being late.
examples.zh: 他为迟到编造了一个借口。

examples.en: The police accused him of fabricating evidence.
examples.zh: 警方指控他伪造证据。

fabulous.definition: 极好的；绝妙的；传说中的
fabulous.collocations: fabulous view 绝妙的景色, fabulous wealth 巨额财富, fabulous story 传说故事

examples.en: We had a fabulous time at the beach.
examples.zh: 我们在海滩上玩得很开心。

examples.en: The hotel offers a fabulous view of the ocean.
examples.zh: 酒店提供绝妙的海景。

examples.en: He told us a fabulous story about his travels.
examples.zh: 他给我们讲了一个关于他旅行的传说故事。

facility.collocations: sports facility 体育设施, public facility 公共设施, facility with languages 语言才能

examples.en: The school has excellent sports facilities.
examples.zh: 学校有极好的体育设施。

examples.en: The facility is open to the public.
examples.zh: 该设施对公众开放。

examples.en: She has a great facility for learning languages.
examples.zh: 她很有语言学习的天赋。

factory.collocations: factory worker 工厂工人, factory production 工厂生产, car factory 汽车工厂

examples.en: The factory produces thousands of cars each year.
examples.zh: 这家工厂每年生产数千辆汽车。

examples.en: He works in a textile factory.
examples.zh: 他在一家纺织厂工作。

examples.en: The factory was closed due to safety concerns.
examples.zh: 由于安全问题，工厂被关闭了。

faculty.definition: 全体教员；才能；天赋；系；学院
faculty.collocations: faculty member 教职员工, faculty of law 法学院, mental faculty 心智能力

examples.en: She is a member of the faculty at Harvard.
examples.zh: 她是哈佛大学的教员。

examples.en: He has a faculty for making friends easily.
examples.zh: 他有容易交朋友的天赋。

examples.en: The faculty of medicine is renowned for its research.
examples.zh: 医学院以其研究而闻名。

fade.definition: 褪色；凋谢；逐渐消失；变弱
fade.collocations: fade away 逐渐消失, fade out 淡出, colors fade 颜色褪去

examples.en: The colors of the painting have faded over time.
examples.zh: 画作的颜色随时间褪去了。

examples.en: Her voice faded as she walked away.
examples.zh: 她走开时声音逐渐消失。

examples.en: The flowers will fade if not watered.
examples.zh: 如果不浇水，花会凋谢。

failure.definition: 失败；失败的人或事；故障；未能
failure.collocations: failure rate 失败率, heart failure 心力衰竭, crop failure 作物歉收

examples.en: The project ended in failure due to lack of funding.
examples.zh: 由于缺乏资金，项目以失败告终。

examples.en: He was a failure as a businessman.
examples.zh: 作为一个商人，他是个失败者。

examples.en: The engine failure caused the plane to crash.
examples.zh: 发动机故障导致飞机坠毁。

faint.definition: 模糊的；微弱的；昏厥；晕倒
faint.collocations: faint sound 微弱的声音, faint hope 微弱的希望, faint from hunger 饿晕

examples.en: There was a faint smell of smoke in the air.
examples.zh: 空气中有一股微弱的烟味。

examples.en: She felt faint and had to sit down.
examples.zh: 她感到头晕，不得不坐下。

examples.en: He fainted from the heat.
examples.zh: 他因中暑而昏倒。

faith.collocations: have faith in 相信, religious faith 宗教信仰, keep faith 信守承诺

examples.en: She has faith in her ability to succeed.
examples.zh: 她相信自己有能力成功。

examples.en: People of different faiths live together peacefully.
examples.zh: 不同信仰的人和平共处。

examples.en: He kept faith with his promises.
examples.zh: 他信守了诺言。

fake.definition: 假的；伪造的；伪造；冒充；假货
fake.collocations: fake news 假新闻, fake ID 假身份证, fake smile 假笑

examples.en: He was arrested for using a fake passport.
examples.zh: 他因使用假护照被捕。

examples.en: She faked a smile to hide her disappointment.
examples.zh: 她假笑以掩饰失望。

examples.en: The painting was discovered to be a fake.
examples.zh: 这幅画被发现是赝品。

fame.collocations: win fame 赢得声誉, seek fame 追求名声, rise to fame 成名

examples.en: The young artist rose to fame after her first exhibition.
examples.zh: 这位年轻艺术家在首次展览后一举成名。

examples.en: He cared more about his work than personal fame.
examples.zh: 他更关心工作而非个人名声。

examples.en: Fame often brings both opportunities and challenges.
examples.zh: 名声往往带来机遇和挑战。

familiar.collocations: familiar with 熟悉, familiar sight 熟悉的景象, become familiar 变得熟悉

examples.en: I am not familiar with this neighborhood.
examples.zh: 我对这个社区不熟悉。

examples.en: The song has a familiar tune that everyone can hum.
examples.zh: 这首歌的旋律很熟悉，大家都能哼唱。

examples.en: She is familiar with several programming languages.
examples.zh: 她通晓几种编程语言。

famine.collocations: suffer famine 遭受饥荒, famine relief 饥荒救济, drought and famine 干旱与饥荒

examples.en: The region experienced a severe famine due to drought.
examples.zh: 该地区因干旱遭遇严重饥荒。

examples.en: International aid helped alleviate the famine.
examples.zh: 国际援助帮助缓解了饥荒。

examples.en: Famine can lead to mass migration and social unrest.
examples.zh: 饥荒可能导致大规模移民和社会动荡。

fancy.collocations: fancy oneself 自以为是, fancy doing 想要做, fancy that 想象

examples.en: Do you fancy going for a walk after dinner?
examples.zh: 你想饭后去散步吗？

examples.en: He fancies himself as a great writer.
examples.zh: 他自以为是伟大的作家。

examples.en: I can't fancy living in such a remote place.
examples.zh: 我无法想象住在如此偏远的地方。

fantastic.definition: 极好的，了不起的；奇异的，幻想的
fantastic.collocations: fantastic opportunity 绝佳机会, fantastic view 极好的景色, fantastic idea 绝妙的主意

examples.en: We had a fantastic time at the amusement park.
examples.zh: 我们在游乐园玩得非常开心。

examples.en: The view from the mountain top was fantastic.
examples.zh: 山顶的景色美极了。

examples.en: She came up with a fantastic solution to the problem.
examples.zh: 她想出了一个绝妙的解决方案。

fantasy.collocations: fantasy world 幻想世界, live in a fantasy 生活在幻想中, fantasy novel 奇幻小说

examples.en: Children often create a fantasy world in their play.
examples.zh: 孩子们在游戏中常创造幻想世界。

examples.en: He lives in a fantasy where he is a famous actor.
