examples.en: Some religions believe sinners go to hell after death.
examples.zh: 一些宗教认为罪人死后会下地狱。

helmet.collocations: wear a helmet 戴头盔, bicycle helmet 自行车头盔, safety helmet 安全帽

examples.en: Cyclists should always wear a helmet for safety.
examples.zh: 骑自行车的人应该始终戴头盔以确保安全。

examples.en: The construction worker put on his hard hat and helmet.
examples.zh: 建筑工人戴上了安全帽。

examples.en: The soldier's helmet protected him from shrapnel.
examples.zh: 士兵的头盔保护他免受弹片伤害。

hemisphere.collocations: northern hemisphere 北半球, southern hemisphere 南半球, left hemisphere 左半球

examples.en: Australia is located in the southern hemisphere.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚位于南半球。

examples.en: The brain's left hemisphere controls language.
examples.zh: 大脑的左半球控制语言。

examples.en: The northern hemisphere experiences summer in June.
examples.zh: 北半球在六月经历夏季。

herb.collocations: medicinal herb 药草, herb garden 草药园, fresh herbs 新鲜香草

examples.en: She grows various herbs in her garden.
examples.zh: 她在花园里种植各种香草。

examples.en: Traditional Chinese medicine uses many herbs.
examples.zh: 中医使用许多草药。

examples.en: The chef added fresh herbs to the sauce.
examples.zh: 厨师在酱汁中加入了新鲜香草。

herd.collocations: a herd of cattle 一群牛, herd instinct 从众心理, herd immunity 群体免疫

examples.en: A herd of elephants crossed the river.
examples.zh: 一群大象过河。

examples.en: The shepherd herded the sheep into the pen.
examples.zh: 牧羊人把羊群赶进围栏。

examples.en: People often follow the herd without thinking.
examples.zh: 人们常常不假思索地随大流。

hereditary.collocations: hereditary disease 遗传病, hereditary title 世袭头衔, hereditary monarchy 世袭君主制

examples.en: Some cancers are hereditary.
examples.zh: 有些癌症是遗传性的。

examples.en: The throne is hereditary in many countries.
examples.zh: 在许多国家，王位是世袭的。

examples.en: He inherited a hereditary estate from his grandfather.
examples.zh: 他从祖父那里继承了一处世袭地产。

heritage.collocations: cultural heritage 文化遗产, world heritage 世界遗产, natural heritage 自然遗产

examples.en: The Great Wall is a UNESCO World Heritage site.
examples.zh: 长城是联合国教科文组织世界遗产。

examples.en: We must preserve our cultural heritage for future generations.
examples.zh: 我们必须为后代保护我们的文化遗产。

examples.en: The country has a rich musical heritage.
examples.zh: 这个国家有丰富的音乐遗产。

hero.collocations: national hero 民族英雄, action hero 动作英雄, hero worship 英雄崇拜

examples.en: He was hailed as a hero for saving the child.
examples.zh: 他因救孩子而被誉为英雄。

examples.en: The movie's hero is a brave firefighter.
examples.zh: 电影的主角是一名勇敢的消防员。

examples.en: Many children look up to sports heroes.
examples.zh: 许多孩子崇拜体育英雄。

hike.definition: 远足；徒步旅行；提高；增加
hike.collocations: go for a hike 去远足, price hike 价格上涨, hike in wages 加薪

examples.en: We went for a hike in the mountains.
examples.zh: 我们去山里远足了。

examples.en: The government announced a tax hike.
examples.zh: 政府宣布增税。

examples.en: They hiked through the forest for hours.
examples.zh: 他们在森林里徒步了几个小时。

hinder.collocations: hinder progress 阻碍进步, hinder development 妨碍发展, hinder communication 妨碍沟通

examples.en: Bad weather hindered the rescue efforts.
examples.zh: 恶劣天气阻碍了救援工作。

examples.en: Lack of funding hindered the project's completion.
examples.zh: 缺乏资金阻碍了项目的完成。

examples.en: His shyness hindered his ability to make friends.
examples.zh: 他的害羞妨碍了他交朋友的能力。

hint.collocations: give a hint 给提示, take a hint 领会暗示, subtle hint 微妙的暗示

examples.en: She dropped a hint about her birthday gift.
examples.zh: 她暗示了一下她的生日礼物。

examples.en: The teacher gave a hint to help solve the problem.
examples.zh: 老师给了一个提示来帮助解决问题。

examples.en: He didn't take the hint and kept talking.
examples.zh: 他没有领会暗示，继续说话。

historian.collocations: professional historian 专业历史学家, military historian 军事历史学家, art historian 艺术史学家

examples.en: The historian published a new book on ancient Rome.
examples.zh: 这位历史学家出版了一本关于古罗马的新书。

examples.en: Historians debate the causes of the war.
examples.zh: 历史学家们争论战争的原因。

examples.en: She is a renowned historian of the Renaissance.
examples.zh: 她是一位著名的文艺复兴历史学家。

historic.definition: 有历史意义的；历史性的
historic.collocations: historic moment 历史性时刻, historic building 历史建筑, historic event 历史事件

examples.en: The signing of the treaty was a historic moment.
examples.zh: 条约的签署是一个历史性时刻。

examples.en: They visited many historic sites in Europe.
examples.zh: 他们参观了欧洲许多历史遗迹。

examples.en: The election resulted in a historic victory.
examples.zh: 选举取得了历史性的胜利。

historical.collocations: historical research 历史研究, historical novel 历史小说, historical context 历史背景

examples.en: The museum displays historical artifacts.
examples.zh: 博物馆展示历史文物。

examples.en: She enjoys reading historical novels.
examples.zh: 她喜欢读历史小说。

examples.en: We need to understand the historical context of the event.
examples.zh: 我们需要理解事件的历史背景。

history.collocations: world history 世界历史, family history 家族史, medical history 病史

examples.en: History repeats itself.
examples.zh: 历史重演。

examples.en: She studied history at university.
examples.zh: 她在大学学习历史。

examples.en: The patient has a history of heart disease.
examples.zh: 病人有心脏病史。

hit.definition: 打；击；碰撞；击中；成功；热门
hit.collocations: hit the target 击中目标, hit a record 创纪录, big hit 大热门

examples.en: The car hit a tree.
examples.zh: 汽车撞上了一棵树。

examples.en: The song became a big hit.
examples.zh: 这首歌成了大热门。

examples.en: He hit the ball out of the park.
examples.zh: 他把球打出了公园。

hitherto.collocations: hitherto unknown 迄今未知, hitherto unsolved 迄今未解决, hitherto neglected 迄今被忽视

examples.en: The problem has hitherto been ignored by the authorities.
examples.zh: 这个问题迄今为止一直被当局忽视。

examples.en: This is a hitherto undiscovered species of plant.
examples.zh: 这是一种迄今未被发现的植物物种。

examples.en: Hitherto, the research has focused on urban areas.
examples.zh: 迄今为止，研究主要集中在城市地区。

hobby.collocations: pursue a hobby 追求爱好, favourite hobby 最喜欢的爱好, turn a hobby into a career 把爱好变成职业

examples.en: Gardening is a popular hobby among retirees.
examples.zh: 园艺是退休人员中流行的爱好。

examples.en: She has a hobby of collecting vintage stamps.
examples.zh: 她有一个收集 vintage 邮票的爱好。

examples.en: Many people use their hobbies to relieve stress.
examples.zh: 许多人利用爱好来缓解压力。

hoist.collocations: hoist a flag 升旗, hoist a sail 升帆, hoist equipment 吊装设备

examples.en: The workers hoisted the heavy crate onto the truck.
examples.zh: 工人们把沉重的箱子吊到卡车上。

examples.en: They hoisted the national flag during the ceremony.
examples.zh: 他们在仪式上升起了国旗。

examples.en: The crane hoisted the steel beam into place.
examples.zh: 起重机将钢梁吊装到位。

homework.collocations: do homework 做作业, assign homework 布置作业, homework assignment 家庭作业任务

examples.en: Students should complete their homework before class.
examples.zh: 学生应该在课前完成家庭作业。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a lot of homework over the weekend.
examples.zh: 老师周末给我们布置了很多作业。

examples.en: He did his homework on the company before the interview.
examples.zh: 他在面试前对这家公司做了准备工作。

homogeneous.collocations: homogeneous group 同质群体, homogeneous mixture 均匀混合物, homogeneous society 同质社会

examples.en: The population of the small town is remarkably homogeneous.
examples.zh: 这个小镇的人口非常同质。

examples.en: A homogeneous mixture has the same composition throughout.
examples.zh: 均匀混合物各处的成分相同。

examples.en: The team was not homogeneous; it included people from diverse backgrounds.
examples.zh: 这个团队并非同质，成员背景多样。

horizon.collocations: broaden one's horizons 开阔眼界, on the horizon 在地平线上，即将出现, expand horizons 拓展视野

examples.en: The sun sank below the horizon.
examples.zh: 太阳沉到了地平线以下。

examples.en: Traveling abroad can broaden your horizons.
examples.zh: 出国旅行可以开阔你的眼界。

examples.en: New opportunities are on the horizon for graduates.
examples.zh: 毕业生即将迎来新的机会。

horrible.collocations: horrible experience 可怕的经历, horrible weather 糟糕的天气, horrible accident 可怕的事故

examples.en: The food at the restaurant was horrible.
examples.zh: 那家餐厅的食物糟透了。

examples.en: She had a horrible nightmare last night.
examples.zh: 她昨晚做了一个可怕的噩梦。

examples.en: The traffic was horrible during rush hour.
examples.zh: 高峰时段的交通糟透了。

hose.collocations: garden hose 花园水管, fire hose 消防水带, hose pipe 软管

examples.en: He used a hose to water the plants.
examples.zh: 他用软管给植物浇水。

examples.en: The firefighter aimed the hose at the burning building.
examples.zh: 消防员将水带对准燃烧的建筑。

examples.en: The hose sprang a leak and water sprayed everywhere.
examples.zh: 软管裂了个口子，水喷得到处都是。

hospital.collocations: in hospital 住院, go to hospital 去医院, hospital ward 医院病房

examples.en: He was taken to hospital after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故后他被送往医院。

examples.en: She works as a nurse in a local hospital.
examples.zh: 她在当地一家医院当护士。

examples.en: The hospital has state-of-the-art equipment.
examples.zh: 这家医院拥有最先进的设备。

hospitality.definition: 好客，款待， hospitality industry 酒店业
hospitality.collocations: hospitality industry 酒店业, warm hospitality 热情款待, extend hospitality 提供款待

examples.en: The locals are known for their warm hospitality.
examples.zh: 当地人以其热情好客而闻名。

examples.en: She works in the hospitality industry as a hotel manager.
examples.zh: 她在酒店业工作，担任酒店经理。

examples.en: We were overwhelmed by the hospitality of our hosts.
examples.zh: 主人的热情款待让我们受宠若惊。

host.collocations: host country 主办国, host a party 举办派对, host family 寄宿家庭

examples.en: The host welcomed the guests at the door.
examples.zh: 主人在门口欢迎客人。

examples.en: China will host the next Olympic Games.
examples.zh: 中国将主办下一届奥运会。

examples.en: She hosted a charity event last weekend.
examples.zh: 她上周末主持了一场慈善活动。

hostage.collocations: take hostage 劫持人质, hostage situation 人质事件, hostage crisis 人质危机

examples.en: The terrorists took several hostages.
examples.zh: 恐怖分子劫持了几名人质。

examples.en: The hostage was released unharmed after negotiations.
examples.zh: 经过谈判，人质被安全释放。

examples.en: The government refused to negotiate with hostage-takers.
examples.zh: 政府拒绝与劫持人质者谈判。

hostile.collocations: hostile attitude 敌对态度, hostile environment 恶劣环境, hostile takeover 恶意收购

examples.en: The audience was hostile to the speaker's views.
examples.zh: 听众对演讲者的观点持敌对态度。

examples.en: They had to survive in a hostile climate.
examples.zh: 他们不得不在恶劣的气候中生存。

examples.en: The company faced a hostile takeover bid.
examples.zh: 该公司面临恶意收购要约。

hotel.collocations: check into a hotel 入住酒店, hotel room 酒店房间, luxury hotel 豪华酒店

examples.en: We booked a hotel near the airport.
examples.zh: 我们预订了机场附近的一家酒店。

examples.en: The hotel offers a complimentary breakfast.
examples.zh: 这家酒店提供免费早餐。

examples.en: He works as a concierge in a five-star hotel.
examples.zh: 他在一家五星级酒店做门房。

housing.collocations: housing market 住房市场, affordable housing 经济适用房, housing shortage 住房短缺

examples.en: The government is trying to solve the housing crisis.
examples.zh: 政府正试图解决住房危机。

examples.en: There is a shortage of affordable housing in big cities.
examples.zh: 大城市缺乏经济适用房。

examples.en: The housing market has been booming in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年来住房市场一直繁荣。

hover.collocations: hover over 盘旋在...上方, hover around 徘徊在...附近, hover between 在...之间摇摆

examples.en: A helicopter hovered over the building.
examples.zh: 一架直升机在大楼上方盘旋。

examples.en: The temperature hovered around 30 degrees.
examples.zh: 温度在30度左右徘徊。

examples.en: She hovered between accepting and rejecting the offer.
examples.zh: 她在接受和拒绝提议之间摇摆不定。

huddle.collocations: huddle together 挤在一起, huddle up 蜷缩, in a huddle 聚在一起

examples.en: The children huddled together for warmth.
examples.zh: 孩子们挤在一起取暖。

examples.en: They huddled around the fire to keep warm.
examples.zh: 他们围在火边取暖。

examples.en: The team had a quick huddle before the game.
examples.zh: 比赛前球队快速聚在一起商量。

human.collocations: human being 人类, human rights 人权, human nature 人性

examples.en: Every human being deserves respect.
examples.zh: 每个人都值得尊重。

examples.en: The organization fights for human rights.
examples.zh: 该组织为人权而战。

examples.en: It is human nature to make mistakes.
examples.zh: 犯错是人的天性。

humanity.collocations: crimes against humanity 反人类罪, sense of humanity 人道精神, the whole of humanity 全人类

examples.en: The war was a crime against humanity.
examples.zh: 这场战争是反人类罪。

examples.en: We must treat animals with humanity.
examples.zh: 我们必须人道地对待动物。

examples.en: The disaster united people across humanity.
examples.zh: 这场灾难团结了全人类。

humble.collocations: humble opinion 拙见, humble beginnings 卑微的出身, humble oneself 谦卑

examples.en: He remained humble despite his success.
examples.zh: 尽管成功了，他仍然保持谦虚。

examples.en: She came from humble beginnings but achieved great things.
examples.zh: 她出身卑微但成就斐然。

examples.en: The experience humbled him and made him more compassionate.
examples.zh: 这次经历使他谦卑，也让他更有同情心。

humidity.collocations: high humidity 高湿度, low humidity 低湿度, relative humidity 相对湿度

examples.en: The high humidity made the weather feel even hotter.
examples.zh: 高湿度让天气感觉更热。

examples.en: Plants in the rainforest thrive in constant humidity.
examples.zh: 雨林中的植物在持续的湿度中茁壮成长。

examples.en: The humidity level dropped significantly after the rain stopped.
examples.zh: 雨停后湿度水平显著下降。

humiliate.collocations: humiliate someone 羞辱某人, feel humiliated 感到羞辱, publicly humiliate 公开羞辱

examples.en: The teacher's harsh criticism humiliated the student in front of the class.
examples.zh: 老师严厉的批评在全班同学面前羞辱了那个学生。

examples.en: He felt humiliated when he failed the simple test.
examples.zh: 当他没通过简单的测试时，他感到羞辱。

examples.en: No one should be humiliated because of their background.
examples.zh: 任何人都不应因背景而受到羞辱。

hunt.collocations: hunt for 寻找, go hunting 去打猎, job hunt 找工作

examples.en: They went hunting in the forest early in the morning.
examples.zh: 他们一大早就去森林里打猎。

examples.en: The police are hunting for the escaped prisoner.
examples.zh: 警方正在搜寻逃犯。

examples.en: After graduation, he started a job hunt that lasted several months.
examples.zh: 毕业后，他开始了持续数月的求职。

hunting.collocations: hunting season 狩猎季节, hunting ground 猎场, job hunting 求职

examples.en: Hunting is strictly regulated in many countries to protect wildlife.
examples.zh: 许多国家严格管制打猎以保护野生动物。

examples.en: He spends his weekends hunting in the mountains.
examples.zh: 他周末在山上打猎。

examples.en: Online job hunting has become increasingly popular.
examples.zh: 在线求职变得越来越流行。

hurricane.collocations: hurricane force 飓风强度, hurricane season 飓风季节, devastating hurricane 破坏性飓风

examples.en: The hurricane caused widespread damage to coastal areas.
examples.zh: 飓风对沿海地区造成了广泛的破坏。

examples.en: Residents were evacuated before the hurricane hit.
examples.zh: 居民在飓风来袭前被疏散。

examples.en: Scientists are studying how climate change affects hurricane intensity.
examples.zh: 科学家正在研究气候变化如何影响飓风强度。

hygiene.collocations: personal hygiene 个人卫生, food hygiene 食品卫生, dental hygiene 口腔卫生

examples.en: Good personal hygiene helps prevent the spread of diseases.
examples.zh: 良好的个人卫生有助于预防疾病传播。

examples.en: The restaurant was closed due to poor food hygiene standards.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅因食品卫生标准差而被关闭。

examples.en: Children should be taught about hygiene from an early age.
examples.zh: 应该从小教育孩子卫生知识。

hysterical.definition: 歇斯底里的，情绪异常激动的
hysterical.collocations: hysterical laughter 狂笑, hysterical crying 嚎啕大哭, become hysterical 变得歇斯底里

examples.en: The crowd became hysterical when their team won the championship.
examples.zh: 当他们的球队赢得冠军时，人群变得歇斯底里。

examples.en: She burst into hysterical laughter at the joke.
examples.zh: 她听到笑话后爆发出狂笑。

examples.en: The mother was hysterical when she couldn't find her child.
examples.zh: 母亲找不到孩子时变得歇斯底里。

ice.collocations: ice cube 冰块, ice cream 冰淇淋, break the ice 打破僵局

examples.en: The lake was covered with a thick layer of ice.
examples.zh: 湖面上覆盖着一层厚厚的冰。

examples.en: She added some ice cubes to her drink.
examples.zh: 她在饮料里加了些冰块。

examples.en: A simple joke can help break the ice in a conversation.
examples.zh: 一个简单的笑话有助于打破谈话的僵局。

idea.collocations: have an idea 有个主意, good idea 好主意, no idea 不知道

examples.en: She came up with a brilliant idea for the project.
examples.zh: 她为这个项目想出了一个绝妙的主意。

examples.en: I have no idea what he is talking about.
examples.zh: 我不知道他在说什么。

examples.en: The idea of renewable energy is gaining popularity.
examples.zh: 可再生能源的概念越来越受欢迎。

ideal.collocations: ideal candidate 理想候选人, ideal solution 理想解决方案, ideal world 理想世界

examples.en: This house is ideal for a large family.
examples.zh: 这栋房子非常适合大家庭。

examples.en: He is the ideal candidate for the job.
examples.zh: 他是这份工作的理想候选人。

examples.en: In an ideal world, everyone would have access to education.
examples.zh: 在理想世界中，每个人都应有受教育的机会。

identification.collocations: identification card 身份证, identification number 识别号码, identification process 识别过程

examples.en: You need to show identification to enter the building.
examples.zh: 你需要出示身份证明才能进入大楼。

examples.en: The identification of the victim took several days.
examples.zh: 受害者的身份鉴定花了几天时间。

examples.en: Fingerprint identification is used in criminal investigations.
examples.zh: 指纹识别用于刑事调查。

identity.collocations: identity theft 身份盗窃, cultural identity 文化认同, sense of identity 身份感

examples.en: He had his identity stolen and lost a lot of money.
examples.zh: 他的身份被盗，损失了很多钱。

examples.en: Many immigrants struggle to maintain their cultural identity.
examples.zh: 许多移民努力保持自己的文化认同。

examples.en: Adolescence is a time when people develop their sense of identity.
examples.zh: 青春期是人们发展身份感的时期。

ideology.collocations: political ideology 政治意识形态, dominant ideology 主流意识形态, ideological differences 意识形态差异

examples.en: The two parties have very different political ideologies.
examples.zh: 这两个政党有非常不同的政治意识形态。

examples.en: His ideology influenced many young people.
examples.zh: 他的意识形态影响了许多年轻人。

examples.en: Ideological conflicts can lead to social unrest.
examples.zh: 意识形态冲突可能导致社会动荡。

idiom.collocations: English idiom 英语习语, idiomatic expression 习惯表达, learn idioms 学习习语

examples.en: The idiom 'break a leg' means good luck.
examples.zh: 习语'break a leg'意思是祝好运。

examples.en: Learning idioms is important for mastering a language.
examples.zh: 学习习语对于掌握一门语言很重要。

examples.en: This idiom is commonly used in everyday conversation.
examples.zh: 这个习语在日常对话中常用。

idiot.collocations: complete idiot 十足的傻瓜, act like an idiot 像白痴一样行事, call someone an idiot 叫某人白痴

examples.en: Only an idiot would drive without a seatbelt.
examples.zh: 只有白痴才会不系安全带开车。

examples.en: He felt like an idiot after making that mistake.
examples.zh: 犯了那个错误后，他觉得自己像个白痴。

examples.en: Don't call him an idiot; it's not nice.
examples.zh: 别叫他白痴，这样不好。

idle.definition: 闲置的；无所事事的；虚度
idle.collocations: idle time 空闲时间, idle away 虚度, idle chatter 闲聊

examples.en: The factory has been idle for months due to the strike.
examples.zh: 由于罢工，工厂已经闲置数月。

examples.en: He idled away the afternoon watching TV.
examples.zh: 他看电视虚度了一个下午。

examples.en: Idle gossip can damage people's reputations.
examples.zh: 无聊的闲话会损害人们的声誉。

ignite.collocations: ignite a fire 点火, ignite a debate 引发辩论, ignite passion 激发热情

examples.en: A spark can ignite a forest fire.
examples.zh: 一个火花就能引发森林火灾。

examples.en: His speech ignited a heated debate among the audience.
examples.zh: 他的演讲在观众中引发了激烈的辩论。

examples.en: The teacher's encouragement ignited a passion for learning in the students.
examples.zh: 老师的鼓励激发了学生们的学习热情。

illegal.collocations: illegal activity 非法活动, illegal immigration 非法移民, illegal drugs 非法毒品

examples.en: It is illegal to park here.
examples.zh: 在这里停车是违法的。

examples.en: The government is cracking down on illegal logging.
examples.zh: 政府正在打击非法伐木。

examples.en: He was arrested for carrying illegal weapons.
examples.zh: 他因携带非法武器被捕。

illness.collocations: serious illness 重病, mental illness 精神疾病, suffer from an illness 患病

examples.en: She missed work due to a sudden illness.
examples.zh: 她因突发疾病而缺勤。

examples.en: Mental illness is often misunderstood by society.
examples.zh: 精神疾病常常被社会误解。

examples.en: Regular exercise can help prevent many illnesses.
examples.zh: 定期锻炼有助于预防许多疾病。

illuminate.collocations: illuminate the room 照亮房间, illuminate a point 阐明观点, illuminate the way 照亮道路

examples.en: The candles illuminated the dark room.
examples.zh: 蜡烛照亮了黑暗的房间。

examples.en: The professor's explanation illuminated the complex theory.
examples.zh: 教授的解释阐明了这个复杂的理论。

examples.en: Streetlights illuminate the way for pedestrians at night.
examples.zh: 路灯在夜晚为行人照亮道路。

illusion.collocations: optical illusion 视错觉, have no illusion about 对…不抱幻想, create an illusion 制造幻觉

examples.en: The mirror creates an optical illusion that makes the room look larger.
examples.zh: 镜子制造了一种视错觉，让房间看起来更大。

examples.en: He has no illusion about his chances of winning the election.
examples.zh: 他对赢得选举的机会不抱幻想。

examples.en: The idea of a perfect society is just an illusion.
examples.zh: 完美社会的想法只是一种幻觉。

imaginative.definition: 富有想象力的；创新的；虚构的
imaginative.collocations: imaginative thinking 富有想象力的思维, imaginative solution 创新的解决方案, imaginative writing 虚构写作

examples.en: The architect proposed an imaginative design for the new museum.
examples.zh: 建筑师为新博物馆提出了一个富有想象力的设计。

examples.en: Children are often more imaginative than adults.
examples.zh: 孩子通常比成年人更有想象力。

examples.en: The novel is praised for its imaginative plot.
examples.zh: 这部小说因其虚构的情节而受到赞扬。

imitate.collocations: imitate someone's behavior 模仿某人的行为, imitate a sound 模仿声音, imitate a style 模仿风格

examples.en: Young children often imitate their parents' gestures.
examples.zh: 小孩子经常模仿父母的手势。

examples.en: The software can imitate human speech patterns.
examples.zh: 这个软件可以模拟人类的语言模式。

examples.en: He tried to imitate the artist's painting technique.
examples.zh: 他试图模仿那位艺术家的绘画技巧。

imitation.collocations: in imitation of 模仿, imitation leather 仿皮, imitation jewelry 仿制珠宝

examples.en: The painting is a poor imitation of the original.
examples.zh: 这幅画是对原作的拙劣模仿。

examples.en: She wore a necklace made of imitation pearls.
examples.zh: 她戴了一条仿珍珠项链。

examples.en: Children learn by imitation.
examples.zh: 孩子通过模仿学习。

immerse.collocations: immerse oneself in 沉浸于, immerse in water 浸入水中, be immersed in thought 陷入沉思

examples.en: She immersed herself in her studies to prepare for the exam.
examples.zh: 她埋头学习，为考试做准备。

examples.en: The fabric should be immersed in dye for at least an hour.
examples.zh: 布料应在染料中浸泡至少一小时。

examples.en: He was completely immersed in the virtual reality game.
examples.zh: 他完全沉浸在虚拟现实游戏中。

imminent.definition: 即将发生的；迫近的；危急的
imminent.collocations: imminent danger 迫在眉睫的危险, imminent threat 即将到来的威胁, imminent arrival 即将到来

examples.en: The storm is imminent, so we should seek shelter.
examples.zh: 暴风雨即将来临，我们应该找地方躲避。

examples.en: The company faced imminent bankruptcy due to poor management.
examples.zh: 由于管理不善，公司面临即将破产的危机。

examples.en: The scientist warned of an imminent environmental disaster.
examples.zh: 科学家警告一场迫在眉睫的环境灾难。

immune.definition: 免疫的；不受影响的；免除的
immune.collocations: immune system 免疫系统, immune to criticism 不受批评影响, immune from prosecution 免于起诉

examples.en: A healthy diet can boost your immune system.
examples.zh: 健康的饮食可以增强你的免疫系统。

examples.en: He seems immune to the stress of his job.
examples.zh: 他似乎不受工作压力的影响。

examples.en: Diplomats are immune from prosecution in some countries.
examples.zh: 在某些国家，外交官免于起诉。

impair.collocations: impair vision 损害视力, impair judgment 削弱判断力, impair performance 影响表现

examples.en: Lack of sleep can impair your ability to concentrate.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足会损害你的注意力。

examples.en: The accident impaired his hearing permanently.
examples.zh: 那次事故永久性地损害了他的听力。

examples.en: Excessive alcohol consumption impairs liver function.
examples.zh: 过量饮酒会损害肝功能。

impart.collocations: impart knowledge 传授知识, impart wisdom 传授智慧, impart information 告知信息

examples.en: Teachers impart knowledge to their students.
examples.zh: 老师向学生传授知识。

examples.en: The spice imparts a unique flavor to the dish.
examples.zh: 这种香料赋予菜肴独特的风味。

examples.en: She imparted the news to her family with great care.
examples.zh: 她小心翼翼地告知家人这个消息。

impede.collocations: impede progress 阻碍进步, impede development 妨碍发展, impede traffic 阻碍交通

examples.en: The heavy snow impeded the rescue efforts.
examples.zh: 大雪阻碍了救援工作。

examples.en: Lack of funding impeded the research project.
examples.zh: 资金不足妨碍了研究项目。

examples.en: The construction work impeded the flow of traffic.
examples.zh: 施工阻碍了交通流量。

imperative.definition: 必要的；紧急的；命令式的
imperative.collocations: imperative need 迫切需求, imperative duty 不可推卸的责任, imperative mood 祈使语气

examples.en: It is imperative that we address climate change now.
examples.zh: 我们现在必须应对气候变化。

examples.en: The doctor gave imperative instructions to the patient.
examples.zh: 医生给病人下了必须遵守的指示。

examples.en: In grammar, the imperative mood is used for commands.
examples.zh: 在语法中，祈使语气用于命令。

imperial.collocations: imperial power 帝国权力, imperial palace 皇宫, imperial system 英制单位

examples.en: The imperial palace is a major tourist attraction.
examples.zh: 皇宫是一个主要的旅游景点。

examples.en: Britain's imperial past is still evident in many former colonies.
examples.zh: 英国的帝国历史在许多前殖民地仍然显而易见。

examples.en: The imperial system of measurement is used in the United States.
examples.zh: 美国使用英制测量系统。

impetus.collocations: provide impetus 提供动力, gain impetus 获得动力, main impetus 主要推动力

examples.en: The new policy gave impetus to economic growth.
examples.zh: 新政策为经济增长提供了动力。

examples.en: The discovery of oil provided the impetus for industrial development.
examples.zh: 石油的发现为工业发展提供了推动力。

examples.en: The project gained impetus after receiving government funding.
examples.zh: 该项目在获得政府资助后获得了动力。

implicit.collocations: implicit trust 绝对信任, implicit meaning 隐含意义, implicit bias 隐性偏见

examples.en: There was an implicit agreement between the two parties.
examples.zh: 双方之间有一个默契。

examples.en: Her silence gave implicit consent to the plan.
examples.zh: 她的沉默表示默许了这个计划。

examples.en: The study examined implicit racial biases in hiring.
examples.zh: 这项研究考察了招聘中的隐性种族偏见。

important.definition: 重要的；有重大影响的；有地位的
important.collocations: important role 重要作用, important factor 重要因素, important decision 重要决定

examples.en: Education plays an important role in personal development.
examples.zh: 教育在个人发展中起着重要作用。

examples.en: It is important to maintain a healthy lifestyle.
examples.zh: 保持健康的生活方式很重要。

examples.en: She is an important figure in the field of medicine.
examples.zh: 她是医学领域的重要人物。

impossible.definition: 不可能的；难以忍受的；荒谬的
impossible.collocations: impossible task 不可能完成的任务, impossible dream 不可能实现的梦想, make it impossible 使不可能

examples.en: It is impossible to please everyone.
examples.zh: 取悦所有人是不可能的。

examples.en: The traffic made it impossible to arrive on time.
examples.zh: 交通堵塞使我们不可能准时到达。

examples.en: He faced an impossible choice between his career and his family.
examples.zh: 他在事业和家庭之间面临一个不可能的选择。

improvement.collocations: continuous improvement 持续改进, significant improvement 显著改善, room for improvement 改进空间

examples.en: There has been a significant improvement in her health.
examples.zh: 她的健康状况有了显著改善。

examples.en: The company is committed to continuous improvement.
examples.zh: 公司致力于持续改进。

examples.en: There is still room for improvement in the education system.
examples.zh: 教育体系仍有改进空间。

impulse.collocations: impulse buy 冲动购买, on impulse 一时冲动, nerve impulse 神经冲动

examples.en: She bought the dress on impulse without thinking.
examples.zh: 她一时冲动买了那条裙子，没多想。

examples.en: The nerve impulse travels along the neuron.
examples.zh: 神经冲动沿着神经元传递。

examples.en: He felt an impulse to laugh at the serious moment.
examples.zh: 他有一种在严肃时刻想笑的冲动。

inability.collocations: inability to do something 无法做某事, physical inability 身体上的无能, financial inability 经济上的无力

examples.en: His inability to speak English hindered his job search.
examples.zh: 他不会说英语妨碍了他找工作。

examples.en: The patient's inability to walk required a wheelchair.
examples.zh: 病人无法行走，需要轮椅。

examples.en: The company's inability to adapt led to its downfall.
examples.zh: 公司无法适应导致了它的倒闭。

inaccurate.definition: 不准确的；错误的；不精确的
inaccurate.collocations: inaccurate information 不准确的信息, inaccurate measurement 不精确的测量, inaccurate report 错误的报告

examples.en: The weather forecast proved to be inaccurate.
examples.zh: 天气预报被证明是不准确的。

examples.en: Inaccurate data can lead to wrong conclusions.
examples.zh: 不准确的数据可能导致错误的结论。

examples.en: The witness gave an inaccurate account of the accident.
examples.zh: 目击者对事故的描述不准确。

inadequate.definition: 不充分的；不足的；不够格的
inadequate.collocations: inadequate funding 资金不足, inadequate preparation 准备不充分, inadequate response 回应不足

examples.en: The government's response to the crisis was inadequate.
examples.zh: 政府对危机的回应不足。

examples.en: Her inadequate preparation led to a poor performance in the exam.
examples.zh: 她准备不充分导致考试成绩不佳。

examples.en: The report highlighted the inadequate funding for public schools.
examples.zh: 报告强调了公立学校资金不足的问题。

inaugurate.definition: 开始；开创；为…举行就职典礼；为…举行开幕式
inaugurate.collocations: inaugurate a new policy 推行新政策, inaugurate a president 为总统举行就职典礼, inaugurate a festival 为节日举行开幕式

examples.en: The new president will be inaugurated in January.
examples.zh: 新总统将于一月就职。

examples.en: The company inaugurated a new training program for employees.
examples.zh: 公司启动了新的员工培训计划。

examples.en: The museum was inaugurated with a grand ceremony.
examples.zh: 博物馆在盛大的仪式中开幕。

incidence.collocations: high incidence of disease 疾病高发率, incidence of crime 犯罪发生率, incidence of poverty 贫困发生率

examples.en: There is a high incidence of heart disease in this region.
examples.zh: 这个地区心脏病发病率很高。

examples.en: The incidence of crime has decreased due to better policing.
examples.zh: 由于治安改善，犯罪率下降了。

examples.en: The study examined the incidence of poverty among single mothers.
examples.zh: 该研究调查了单身母亲中的贫困发生率。

incidentally.definition: 顺便提一句；偶然地；附带地
incidentally.collocations: incidentally mentioned 顺便提到, incidentally related 偶然相关, incidentally discovered 偶然发现

examples.en: Incidentally, I saw your brother at the mall yesterday.
examples.zh: 顺便提一句，我昨天在商场看到你哥哥了。

examples.en: The two events are only incidentally connected.
examples.zh: 这两个事件只是偶然相关。

examples.en: He incidentally discovered the solution while working on another problem.
examples.zh: 他在处理另一个问题时偶然发现了解决方案。

inclination.collocations: natural inclination 自然倾向, strong inclination 强烈意愿, inclination to do sth 做某事的倾向

examples.en: She has a natural inclination towards music.
examples.zh: 她天生对音乐有倾向。

examples.en: He showed no inclination to change his mind.
examples.zh: 他没有改变主意的意愿。

examples.en: The road has a steep inclination.
examples.zh: 这条路有一个陡坡。

incline.collocations: incline to believe 倾向于相信, incline towards 倾向于, incline one's head 点头

examples.en: I incline to believe that he is telling the truth.
examples.zh: 我倾向于相信他说的是实话。

examples.en: The roof inclines at a steep angle.
examples.zh: 屋顶倾斜角度很大。

examples.en: His arguments incline me to change my opinion.
examples.zh: 他的论点使我倾向于改变看法。

inclusive.definition: 包括的；包容的；包含的；范围广的
inclusive.collocations: inclusive education 包容性教育, inclusive of tax 含税, all-inclusive package 全包套餐

examples.en: The price is inclusive of all taxes and fees.
examples.zh: 价格包含所有税费。

examples.en: The school promotes an inclusive environment for all students.
examples.zh: 学校为所有学生营造包容的环境。

examples.en: We offer an all-inclusive holiday package.
examples.zh: 我们提供全包度假套餐。

incoming.definition: 即将到来的；新来的；正到达的
incoming.collocations: incoming call 来电, incoming mail 来信, incoming president 新任总统

examples.en: The incoming president will face many challenges.
examples.zh: 新任总统将面临许多挑战。

examples.en: Please check your incoming emails regularly.
examples.zh: 请定期查看你的收件箱。

examples.en: The airport handles all incoming flights.
examples.zh: 机场处理所有进港航班。

incongruous.definition: 不协调的；不一致的；不合适的
incongruous.collocations: incongruous with 与…不协调, incongruous sight 不协调的景象, incongruous elements 不协调的元素

examples.en: The modern building looked incongruous in the historic town.
examples.zh: 这座现代建筑在历史古镇中显得不协调。

examples.en: His casual clothes were incongruous with the formal occasion.
examples.zh: 他的休闲服装与正式场合不协调。

examples.en: The painting contained incongruous elements from different styles.
examples.zh: 这幅画包含了不同风格的不协调元素。

incredible.definition: 难以置信的；极好的；极大的
incredible.collocations: incredible story 难以置信的故事, incredible achievement 了不起的成就, incredible speed 极快的速度

examples.en: She told an incredible story about her travels.
examples.zh: 她讲了一个关于她旅行的难以置信的故事。

examples.en: The athlete achieved an incredible world record.
examples.zh: 这位运动员取得了了不起的世界纪录。

examples.en: The car was traveling at an incredible speed.
examples.zh: 那辆车以极快的速度行驶。

increment.collocations: annual increment 年度增长, salary increment 加薪, incremental increase 逐步增加

examples.en: Employees receive an annual increment based on performance.
examples.zh: 员工根据绩效获得年度加薪。

examples.en: The software updates are released in small increments.
examples.zh: 软件更新以小增量发布。

examples.en: The company reported a steady increment in profits.
examples.zh: 公司报告利润稳步增长。

incur.collocations: incur debt 负债, incur expenses 产生费用, incur wrath 招致愤怒

examples.en: He incurred a lot of debt to start his business.
examples.zh: 他为了创业欠了很多债。

examples.en: The project incurred unexpected expenses.
examples.zh: 这个项目产生了意外费用。

examples.en: His careless remarks incurred the manager's wrath.
examples.zh: 他粗心的言论招致了经理的愤怒。

indefinite.definition: 不确定的；无限的；模糊的
indefinite.collocations: indefinite period 不确定的时期, indefinite article 不定冠词, indefinite delay 无限期延迟

examples.en: The meeting has been postponed for an indefinite period.
examples.zh: 会议被无限期推迟。

examples.en: She gave an indefinite answer to my question.
examples.zh: 她对我的问题给出了模糊的回答。

examples.en: The indefinite article 'a' is used before consonant sounds.
examples.zh: 不定冠词'a'用于辅音音素前。

independence.collocations: gain independence 获得独立, financial independence 经济独立, independence from 从…独立

examples.en: The country gained independence in 1960.
examples.zh: 这个国家于1960年获得独立。

examples.en: She values her financial independence.
examples.zh: 她重视经济独立。

examples.en: Teenagers often strive for independence from their parents.
examples.zh: 青少年常常争取脱离父母独立。

index.collocations: stock market index 股票市场指数, index finger 食指, index of economic growth 经济增长指标

examples.en: The book has a comprehensive index at the back.
examples.zh: 这本书后面有全面的索引。

examples.en: The Dow Jones index fell sharply yesterday.
examples.zh: 道琼斯指数昨天大幅下跌。

examples.en: The consumer price index is a measure of inflation.
examples.zh: 消费者价格指数是衡量通货膨胀的指标。

indicative.collocations: be indicative of 表明, indicative mood 陈述语气, indicative sign 指示标志

examples.en: His silence is indicative of his disapproval.
examples.zh: 他的沉默表明他不赞成。

examples.en: The results are indicative of a larger trend.
examples.zh: 这些结果表明了一个更大的趋势。

examples.en: In English, the indicative mood is used for facts.
examples.zh: 英语中，陈述语气用于陈述事实。

indicator.collocations: economic indicator 经济指标, performance indicator 绩效指标, indicator light 指示灯

examples.en: GDP is a key economic indicator.
examples.zh: GDP是一个关键的经济指标。

examples.en: The indicator light shows when the machine is running.
examples.zh: 指示灯显示机器何时运行。

examples.en: Student test scores are an indicator of school quality.
examples.zh: 学生考试成绩是学校质量的指标。

indifferent.definition: 冷漠的；不关心的；中等的
indifferent.collocations: indifferent to 对…冷漠, indifferent attitude 冷漠的态度, indifferent quality 质量一般

examples.en: He was indifferent to the suffering of others.
examples.zh: 他对别人的痛苦漠不关心。

examples.en: She gave an indifferent shrug when asked about the issue.
examples.zh: 当被问及这个问题时，她冷漠地耸了耸肩。

examples.en: The food was of indifferent quality.
examples.zh: 食物质量一般。

indigenous.collocations: indigenous people 土著人民, indigenous species 本地物种, indigenous culture 本土文化

examples.en: The indigenous people have lived here for centuries.
examples.zh: 土著人民在这里生活了几个世纪。

examples.en: Many indigenous species are threatened by habitat loss.
examples.zh: 许多本地物种因栖息地丧失而受到威胁。

examples.en: The government is working to preserve indigenous cultures.
examples.zh: 政府正在努力保护本土文化。

indignant.collocations: indignant at 对…愤慨, indignant response 愤怒的反应, feel indignant 感到愤慨

examples.en: She was indignant at the unfair treatment.
examples.zh: 她对不公正的待遇感到愤慨。

examples.en: The public was indignant about the corruption scandal.
examples.zh: 公众对腐败丑闻感到愤怒。

examples.en: He gave an indignant reply to the accusation.
examples.zh: 他对指控做出了愤怒的回应。

indispensable.definition: 不可或缺的，必不可少的
indispensable.collocations: indispensable to/for 对…必不可少, indispensable part 不可或缺的部分, play an indispensable role 发挥不可或缺的作用

examples.en: A good dictionary is indispensable for learning a foreign language.
examples.zh: 一本好词典对于学习外语是必不可少的。

examples.en: The Internet has become an indispensable part of modern life.
examples.zh: 互联网已成为现代生活中不可或缺的一部分。

examples.en: Teamwork plays an indispensable role in achieving success.
examples.zh: 团队合作在取得成功中发挥着不可或缺的作用。

induce.collocations: induce sleep 诱导睡眠, induce labor 引产, induce sb to do sth 诱导某人做某事

examples.en: The medication may induce drowsiness, so avoid driving.
examples.zh: 这种药物可能引起嗜睡，所以避免开车。

examples.en: Advertising often induces people to buy products they don't need.
examples.zh: 广告常常诱导人们购买他们不需要的产品。

examples.en: Stress can induce a variety of health problems.
examples.zh: 压力可以引起各种健康问题。

indulge.collocations: indulge in 沉溺于, indulge oneself 放纵自己, indulge a hobby 沉迷于爱好

examples.en: He tends to indulge in excessive eating when stressed.
examples.zh: 他压力大时往往会暴饮暴食。

examples.en: Parents should not indulge their children too much.
examples.zh: 父母不应过分纵容孩子。

examples.en: On weekends, I like to indulge in reading novels.
examples.zh: 周末我喜欢沉浸于读小说。

industrial.collocations: industrial revolution 工业革命, industrial area 工业区, industrial production 工业生产

examples.en: The Industrial Revolution transformed society in the 18th century.
examples.zh: 工业革命在18世纪改变了社会。

examples.en: Many industrial areas have been converted into residential zones.
examples.zh: 许多工业区已被改造成住宅区。

examples.en: Industrial production has increased significantly this year.
examples.zh: 今年工业生产显著增长。

industry.collocations: heavy industry 重工业, service industry 服务业, manufacturing industry 制造业

examples.en: The country's economy relies heavily on the manufacturing industry.
examples.zh: 该国经济严重依赖制造业。

examples.en: The tourism industry has been booming in recent years.
examples.zh: 旅游业近年来蓬勃发展。

examples.en: His success is due to hard work and industry.
examples.zh: 他的成功归功于勤奋努力。

inertia.collocations: inertia force 惯性力, inertia of motion 运动惯性, overcome inertia 克服惰性

examples.en: The car continued moving due to inertia after the engine stopped.
examples.zh: 发动机停止后，汽车由于惯性继续前进。

examples.en: Many people suffer from inertia and fail to exercise regularly.
examples.zh: 许多人因惰性而无法定期锻炼。

examples.en: The government must overcome bureaucratic inertia to implement reforms.
examples.zh: 政府必须克服官僚惰性来实施改革。

infant.collocations: infant mortality 婴儿死亡率, infant formula 婴儿配方奶粉, infant care 婴儿护理

examples.en: Infant mortality has declined dramatically due to better healthcare.
examples.zh: 由于医疗保健改善，婴儿死亡率大幅下降。

examples.en: The mother carefully prepared the infant formula.
examples.zh: 母亲仔细准备了婴儿配方奶粉。

examples.en: Proper infant care is crucial for healthy development.
examples.zh: 适当的婴儿护理对健康成长至关重要。

infect.collocations: infect with 感染…, become infected 被感染, infect others 传染他人

examples.en: The virus can infect people through respiratory droplets.
examples.zh: 病毒可通过呼吸道飞沫感染人。

examples.en: He became infected after touching a contaminated surface.
examples.zh: 他接触受污染表面后被感染。

examples.en: Infected individuals should isolate to avoid infecting others.
examples.zh: 感染者应隔离以避免传染他人。

infection.collocations: bacterial infection 细菌感染, viral infection 病毒感染, prevent infection 预防感染

examples.en: The patient developed a severe bacterial infection after surgery.
examples.zh: 患者术后出现严重细菌感染。

examples.en: Viral infections often cause fever and fatigue.
examples.zh: 病毒感染常引起发烧和疲劳。

examples.en: Washing hands regularly helps prevent infection.
examples.zh: 经常洗手有助于预防感染。

infectious.collocations: infectious disease 传染病, infectious laughter 有感染力的笑声, infectious enthusiasm 有感染力的热情

examples.en: Measles is a highly infectious disease.
examples.zh: 麻疹是一种高度传染性疾病。

examples.en: Her infectious laughter filled the room.
examples.zh: 她富有感染力的笑声充满了房间。

examples.en: The speaker's infectious enthusiasm motivated the audience.
examples.zh: 演讲者富有感染力的热情激励了观众。

inference.collocations: draw an inference 做出推断, logical inference 逻辑推理, by inference 通过推理

examples.en: We can draw an inference from the data that sales will increase.
examples.zh: 我们可以从数据推断出销售额将增长。

examples.en: Logical inference is a key skill in critical thinking.
examples.zh: 逻辑推理是批判性思维的关键技能。

examples.en: By inference, he must have known about the plan.
examples.zh: 通过推断，他一定知道这个计划。

inferior.collocations: inferior to 次于, inferior quality 劣质, inferior goods 劣质商品

examples.en: This product is inferior to the one we bought last time.
examples.zh: 这个产品比我们上次买的差。

examples.en: The company was criticized for selling inferior quality goods.
examples.zh: 该公司因销售劣质商品而受到批评。

examples.en: He felt inferior to his more successful colleagues.
examples.zh: 他觉得自己不如更成功的同事。

infinite.collocations: infinite number 无限数量, infinite space 无限空间, infinite patience 无限耐心

examples.en: The universe is believed to be infinite in size.
examples.zh: 宇宙被认为是无限大的。

examples.en: She has infinite patience with her students.
examples.zh: 她对她的学生有无限的耐心。

examples.en: There are an infinite number of possibilities.
examples.zh: 有无限的可能性。

inflation.collocations: high inflation 高通胀, inflation rate 通胀率, control inflation 控制通胀

examples.en: High inflation erodes the purchasing power of money.
examples.zh: 高通胀侵蚀了货币的购买力。

examples.en: The central bank raised interest rates to control inflation.
examples.zh: 中央银行提高利率以控制通胀。

examples.en: Inflation rate has been stable for the past year.
examples.zh: 过去一年通胀率一直稳定。

inflict.definition: 施加（痛苦、损失等），使遭受
inflict.collocations: inflict pain 施加痛苦, inflict damage 造成损害, inflict on/upon 使…遭受

examples.en: The storm inflicted severe damage on the coastal areas.
examples.zh: 风暴给沿海地区造成了严重破坏。

examples.en: He inflicted a heavy defeat on his opponent.
examples.zh: 他使对手遭受惨败。

examples.en: The dictator inflicted great suffering upon the people.
examples.zh: 独裁者给人民带来了巨大痛苦。

influx.collocations: influx of tourists 游客涌入, influx of capital 资本流入, massive influx 大量涌入

examples.en: The city experienced a massive influx of tourists during the holiday.
examples.zh: 节日期间该市经历了大量游客涌入。

examples.en: The influx of foreign capital boosted the local economy.
examples.zh: 外国资本的流入促进了当地经济。

examples.en: The sudden influx of refugees strained the resources.
examples.zh: 难民的突然涌入使资源紧张。

information.collocations: information technology 信息技术, gather information 收集信息, provide information 提供信息

examples.en: Information technology has revolutionized the way we work.
examples.zh: 信息技术彻底改变了我们的工作方式。

examples.en: We need to gather more information before making a decision.
examples.zh: 在做决定之前我们需要收集更多信息。

examples.en: The website provides useful information for travelers.
examples.zh: 该网站为旅行者提供有用的信息。

informative.definition: 提供信息的，有教育意义的
informative.collocations: informative speech 信息丰富的演讲, highly informative 信息量大的, informative article 有教育意义的文章

examples.en: The lecture was highly informative and well-organized.
examples.zh: 这次讲座信息量很大且组织得很好。

examples.en: I found the documentary very informative about climate change.
examples.zh: 我发现这部纪录片关于气候变化的信息非常丰富。

examples.en: The book is both entertaining and informative.
examples.zh: 这本书既有趣又有教育意义。

infringe.collocations: infringe on/upon 侵犯, infringe copyright 侵犯版权, infringe rights 侵犯权利

examples.en: Using the image without permission may infringe copyright.
examples.zh: 未经许可使用该图片可能侵犯版权。

examples.en: The new law infringes on citizens' privacy rights.
examples.zh: 新法律侵犯了公民的隐私权。

examples.en: The company was sued for infringing a patent.
examples.zh: 该公司因侵犯专利而被起诉。

ingenious.definition: 巧妙的，有独创性的，机灵的
ingenious.collocations: ingenious idea 巧妙的想法, ingenious solution 巧妙的解决方案, ingenious device 精巧的装置

examples.en: She came up with an ingenious idea to solve the problem.
examples.zh: 她想出了一个巧妙的主意来解决这个问题。

examples.en: The engineer designed an ingenious device for saving energy.
examples.zh: 工程师设计了一种节能的精巧装置。

examples.en: His ingenious solution impressed the entire team.
examples.zh: 他巧妙的解决方案给整个团队留下了深刻印象。

inhabitant.collocations: local inhabitant 当地居民, original inhabitant 原始居民, inhabitant of a city 城市居民

examples.en: The island's inhabitants rely on fishing for their livelihood.
examples.zh: 岛上的居民以捕鱼为生。

examples.en: The census showed a decline in the number of urban inhabitants.
examples.zh: 人口普查显示城市居民数量有所下降。

examples.en: The cave was once home to prehistoric inhabitants.
examples.zh: 这个洞穴曾是史前居民的住所。

inherent.definition: 固有的；内在的；与生俱来的
inherent.collocations: inherent risk 固有风险, inherent characteristic 固有特征, inherent in 存在于…中

examples.en: There are inherent risks in any investment.
examples.zh: 任何投资都有固有的风险。

examples.en: The inherent beauty of the landscape attracted many tourists.
examples.zh: 风景的内在美吸引了许多游客。

examples.en: These problems are inherent in the system itself.
examples.zh: 这些问题源于系统本身。

inherit.collocations: inherit property 继承财产, inherit a trait 遗传特征, inherit from 从…继承

examples.en: She inherited a large fortune from her grandfather.
examples.zh: 她从祖父那里继承了一大笔财产。

examples.en: Children inherit certain genes from their parents.
examples.zh: 孩子从父母那里遗传某些基因。

examples.en: He inherited the responsibility of running the family business.
examples.zh: 他继承了经营家族企业的责任。

inhibit.collocations: inhibit growth 抑制生长, inhibit progress 阻碍进步, inhibit from 阻止做

examples.en: The drug inhibits the spread of cancer cells.
examples.zh: 这种药物抑制癌细胞的扩散。

examples.en: Lack of funding may inhibit the development of new technologies.
examples.zh: 资金不足可能阻碍新技术的发展。

examples.en: His shyness inhibited him from speaking in public.
examples.zh: 他的害羞使他在公共场合不敢发言。

initiative.collocations: take the initiative 采取主动, launch an initiative 发起倡议, individual initiative 个人主动性

examples.en: The government launched a new initiative to reduce pollution.
examples.zh: 政府发起了一项减少污染的新倡议。

examples.en: She showed great initiative in solving the problem.
examples.zh: 她在解决问题时表现出极大的主动性。

examples.en: The team lost the initiative after the opponent scored.
examples.zh: 对手得分后，该队失去了主动权。

inject.collocations: inject a drug 注射药物, inject money into 注入资金, inject enthusiasm 注入热情

examples.en: The doctor injected the vaccine into his arm.
examples.zh: 医生将疫苗注射进他的手臂。

examples.en: The government plans to inject more funds into the healthcare system.
examples.zh: 政府计划向医疗系统注入更多资金。

examples.en: Her speech injected new life into the campaign.
examples.zh: 她的演讲为竞选注入了新的活力。

injection.collocations: give an injection 打针, injection of capital 资本注入, fuel injection 燃油喷射

examples.en: The patient received an injection of insulin.
examples.zh: 病人接受了一针胰岛素注射。

examples.en: The company needed an injection of cash to survive.
examples.zh: 公司需要现金注入才能生存。

examples.en: The car's engine uses direct fuel injection.
examples.zh: 这辆车的发动机使用直接燃油喷射。

injury.collocations: serious injury 重伤, personal injury 人身伤害, injury to 对…的伤害

examples.en: He suffered a serious injury in the car accident.
examples.zh: 他在车祸中受了重伤。

examples.en: The athlete missed the game due to a knee injury.
examples.zh: 这名运动员因膝盖受伤错过了比赛。

examples.en: Excessive exercise can cause injury to your muscles.
examples.zh: 过度运动可能对你的肌肉造成伤害。

innocent.collocations: innocent victim 无辜受害者, innocent of 无罪的, innocent child 天真的孩子

examples.en: The court found him innocent of all charges.
examples.zh: 法庭认定他所有罪名不成立。

examples.en: Many innocent civilians were killed in the conflict.
examples.zh: 许多无辜平民在冲突中丧生。

examples.en: She gave an innocent smile that charmed everyone.
examples.zh: 她露出了天真的微笑，迷住了所有人。

innumerable.collocations: innumerable times 无数次, innumerable stars 无数星星, innumerable benefits 无数好处

examples.en: There are innumerable stars in the night sky.
examples.zh: 夜空中有无数的星星。

examples.en: He has made innumerable contributions to the field.
examples.zh: 他对该领域做出了无数贡献。

examples.en: The project faced innumerable challenges from the start.
examples.zh: 这个项目从一开始就面临无数挑战。

insane.definition: 疯狂的；精神错乱的；极其愚蠢的
insane.collocations: insane behavior 疯狂行为, drive someone insane 逼疯某人, insane idea 疯狂的想法

examples.en: The noise from the construction site is driving me insane.
examples.zh: 建筑工地的噪音快把我逼疯了。

examples.en: It would be insane to attempt the climb in this weather.
examples.zh: 在这种天气尝试攀登简直是疯了。

examples.en: He was declared insane and sent to a mental hospital.
examples.zh: 他被宣布精神错乱，送进了精神病院。

insect.collocations: insect species 昆虫种类, insect bite 昆虫叮咬, insect repellent 驱虫剂

examples.en: Bees are social insects that live in colonies.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂是群居昆虫，生活在蜂群中。

examples.en: The insect population has declined due to pesticide use.
examples.zh: 由于使用杀虫剂，昆虫数量减少了。

examples.en: She screamed when she saw a large insect crawling on the wall.
examples.zh: 她看到一只大昆虫在墙上爬时尖叫起来。

insert.collocations: insert a coin 投币, insert into 插入到, insert a comment 添加评论

examples.en: Please insert your card into the slot.
examples.zh: 请将您的卡插入插槽。

examples.en: The editor inserted a new paragraph into the article.
examples.zh: 编辑在文章中插入了一个新段落。

examples.en: You need to insert the key to start the car.
examples.zh: 你需要插入钥匙才能启动汽车。

insight.collocations: gain insight 获得洞察, provide insight 提供见解, valuable insight 宝贵见解

examples.en: The book provides valuable insights into human behavior.
examples.zh: 这本书对人类行为提供了宝贵的见解。

examples.en: She has a great insight into the problems of the poor.
examples.zh: 她对穷人的问题有深刻的洞察力。

examples.en: His speech gave us an insight into his political views.
examples.zh: 他的演讲让我们了解了他的政治观点。

inspection.collocations: carry out an inspection 进行检查, pass inspection 通过检查, inspection report 检查报告

examples.en: The building failed the fire safety inspection.
examples.zh: 该建筑未通过消防安全检查。

examples.en: Regular inspection of equipment is essential for safety.
examples.zh: 定期检查设备对安全至关重要。

examples.en: The inspector made a thorough inspection of the factory.
examples.zh: 检查员对工厂进行了彻底检查。

inspire.collocations: inspire someone to do 激励某人做, inspire confidence 激发信心, inspire by 受…启发

examples.en: The teacher's words inspired the students to work harder.
examples.zh: 老师的话激励学生们更加努力。

examples.en: His courage inspired admiration in everyone.
examples.zh: 他的勇气赢得了大家的钦佩。

examples.en: The beautiful scenery inspired her to write a poem.
examples.zh: 美丽的景色启发她写了一首诗。

inspiring.definition: 鼓舞人心的；启发灵感的
inspiring.collocations: inspiring story 鼓舞人心的故事, inspiring leader 鼓舞人心的领袖, inspiring speech 鼓舞人心的演讲

examples.en: Her inspiring speech moved the audience to tears.
examples.zh: 她那鼓舞人心的演讲让观众感动落泪。

examples.en: The documentary tells an inspiring story of survival.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片讲述了一个鼓舞人心的生存故事。

examples.en: He is an inspiring teacher who motivates his students.
examples.zh: 他是一位鼓舞人心的老师，能激励学生。

install.collocations: install software 安装软件, install equipment 安装设备, install a system 安装系统

examples.en: We need to install a new air conditioning unit.
examples.zh: 我们需要安装一台新的空调。

examples.en: The technician installed the software on my computer.
examples.zh: 技术员在我的电脑上安装了软件。

examples.en: The new president was installed in office last week.
examples.zh: 新总统上周就职。

instantaneous.collocations: instantaneous response 即时响应, instantaneous reaction 瞬间反应, almost instantaneous 几乎瞬间的

examples.en: The internet provides instantaneous access to information.
examples.zh: 互联网提供即时的信息访问。

examples.en: The explosion was followed by an instantaneous flash of light.
examples.zh: 爆炸之后是一道瞬间的闪光。

examples.en: Modern communication allows for instantaneous contact across the globe.
examples.zh: 现代通信使得全球即时联系成为可能。

instinct.collocations: natural instinct 自然本能, maternal instinct 母性本能, by instinct 凭本能

examples.en: Birds have an instinct to build nests.
examples.zh: 鸟类有筑巢的本能。

examples.en: Her first instinct was to run away from danger.
examples.zh: 她的第一本能是逃离危险。

examples.en: He followed his instinct and made the right decision.
examples.zh: 他凭直觉做出了正确的决定。

instruction.definition: 指令；指示；教学；用法说明
instruction.collocations: follow instructions 遵循指示, give instructions 给出指示, instruction manual 使用手册

examples.en: The teacher gave clear instructions for the assignment.
examples.zh: 老师对作业给出了明确的指示。

examples.en: Please read the instruction manual before using the device.
examples.zh: 使用设备前请阅读说明书。

examples.en: The soldiers followed the instructions without question.
examples.zh: 士兵们毫无质疑地执行指令。

instrumental.definition: 起重要作用的；乐器的；仪器的
instrumental.collocations: instrumental in 在…中起重要作用, instrumental music 器乐, instrumental variable 工具变量

examples.en: Her research was instrumental in developing the new vaccine.
examples.zh: 她的研究对新疫苗的开发起到了重要作用。

examples.en: The band played an instrumental piece during the intermission.
examples.zh: 乐队在幕间演奏了一首器乐曲。

examples.en: He was instrumental in organizing the charity event.
examples.zh: 他在组织慈善活动中起了关键作用。

insulate.definition: 使绝缘；使隔热；使隔离；使免受（不良影响）
insulate.collocations: insulate from 使免受…影响, insulate against 防止, insulate with 用…绝缘

examples.en: The walls are insulated with foam to keep the house warm.
examples.zh: 墙壁用泡沫隔热以保持房屋温暖。

examples.en: They tried to insulate the children from the violent news.
examples.zh: 他们试图让孩子们远离暴力新闻。

examples.en: The government took measures to insulate the economy from external shocks.
examples.zh: 政府采取措施使经济免受外部冲击。

insult.collocations: insult someone 侮辱某人, take it as an insult 视为侮辱, add insult to injury 雪上加霜

examples.en: He insulted her by calling her a liar.
examples.zh: 他骂她是骗子，侮辱了她。

examples.en: She felt that his comment was a personal insult.
examples.zh: 她觉得他的评论是对她个人的侮辱。

examples.en: To add insult to injury, he lost his wallet after being fired.
examples.zh: 雪上加霜的是，他被解雇后还丢了钱包。

insurance.collocations: health insurance 健康保险, life insurance 人寿保险, insurance policy 保险单

examples.en: It is wise to have health insurance in case of emergencies.
examples.zh: 购买健康保险以防紧急情况是明智的。

examples.en: The insurance company refused to pay for the damage.
examples.zh: 保险公司拒绝赔偿损失。

examples.en: He took out a life insurance policy to protect his family.
examples.zh: 他购买了一份人寿保险单来保护家人。

insure.collocations: insure against 投保以防, insure one's life 投保人寿, insure for 投保金额

examples.en: You should insure your car against theft.
examples.zh: 你应该为你的汽车投保防盗险。

examples.en: The company insured its building for $10 million.
examples.zh: 公司为其大楼投保了1000万美元。

examples.en: Please insure that all doors are locked before leaving.
examples.zh: 请确保离开前所有门都锁好。

intact.definition: 完整无缺的；未受损伤的；原封不动的
intact.collocations: remain intact 保持完整, keep intact 保持完好, leave intact 使保持原样

examples.en: The ancient vase was found intact after the earthquake.
examples.zh: 地震后发现那个古代花瓶完好无损。

examples.en: Despite the storm, the roof remained intact.
examples.zh: 尽管有暴风雨，屋顶仍然完好无损。

examples.en: He managed to keep his reputation intact throughout the scandal.
examples.zh: 他在丑闻中设法保住了自己的声誉。

integral.definition: 必需的；不可或缺的；完整的；积分的
integral.collocations: integral part 组成部分, integral to 对…不可或缺, integral calculus 积分学

examples.en: Teamwork is an integral part of the project's success.
examples.zh: 团队合作是项目成功不可或缺的一部分。

examples.en: The new system is integral to the company's expansion plan.
examples.zh: 新系统对公司扩张计划至关重要。

examples.en: She played an integral role in the negotiations.
examples.zh: 她在谈判中发挥了不可或缺的作用。

integrity.collocations: moral integrity 道德正直, academic integrity 学术诚信, structural integrity 结构完整性

examples.en: He is a man of great integrity and honesty.
examples.zh: 他是一个非常正直诚实的人。

examples.en: The integrity of the data must be maintained throughout the experiment.
examples.zh: 实验过程中必须保持数据的完整性。

examples.en: The scandal damaged the politician's integrity.
examples.zh: 丑闻损害了那位政治家的正直形象。

intelligence.definition: 智力；智慧；情报；情报机构
intelligence.collocations: artificial intelligence 人工智能, intelligence test 智力测试, intelligence agency 情报机构

examples.en: Her intelligence and hard work led to her success.
examples.zh: 她的智慧和勤奋带来了成功。

examples.en: The government relies on intelligence to prevent terrorist attacks.
examples.zh: 政府依靠情报来防止恐怖袭击。

examples.en: Artificial intelligence is transforming many industries.
examples.zh: 人工智能正在改变许多行业。

intelligible.definition: 可理解的；明白易懂的；清晰的
intelligible.collocations: intelligible speech 清晰的讲话, barely intelligible 几乎无法理解, make intelligible 使易懂

examples.en: The professor's explanation was clear and intelligible.
examples.zh: 教授的解释清晰易懂。

examples.en: His accent made his English barely intelligible.
examples.zh: 他的口音使他的英语几乎无法理解。

examples.en: The report was written in an intelligible manner for the general public.
examples.zh: 报告以公众易懂的方式撰写。

intensify.definition: 加剧；增强；强化；使更强烈
intensify.collocations: intensify efforts 加大努力, intensify competition 加剧竞争, intensify the conflict 激化冲突

examples.en: The storm intensified as it approached the coast.
examples.zh: 风暴在接近海岸时加剧了。

examples.en: The government intensified its efforts to combat corruption.
examples.zh: 政府加大了打击腐败的力度。

examples.en: The debate intensified after the new evidence was presented.
examples.zh: 新证据提出后，辩论更加激烈。

intensive.definition: 密集的；加强的；深入的；集约的
intensive.collocations: intensive care 重症监护, intensive training 强化训练, labor-intensive 劳动密集型的

examples.en: The patient was moved to the intensive care unit.
examples.zh: 病人被转移到重症监护室。

examples.en: She took an intensive language course before moving abroad.
examples.zh: 她在出国前参加了强化语言课程。

examples.en: Agriculture in this region is highly intensive.
examples.zh: 这个地区的农业高度集约化。

intent.definition: 意图；目的；专心的；坚决的
intent.collocations: with intent 故意地, intent on 专心于, original intent 初衷

examples.en: He entered the building with intent to steal.
examples.zh: 他进入大楼意图偷窃。

examples.en: She was intent on finishing the project on time.
examples.zh: 她一心要按时完成项目。

examples.en: The law punishes those who act with criminal intent.
examples.zh: 法律惩罚那些有犯罪意图行事的人。

interest.definition: 兴趣；利息；利益；使感兴趣
interest.collocations: interest rate 利率, take interest in 对…感兴趣, conflict of interest 利益冲突

examples.en: She has a keen interest in environmental issues.
examples.zh: 她对环境问题有浓厚的兴趣。

examples.en: The bank offers a high interest rate on savings accounts.
examples.zh: 这家银行提供高储蓄利率。

examples.en: The politician was accused of a conflict of interest.
examples.zh: 那位政治家被指控有利益冲突。

interim.definition: 临时的；过渡的；间歇；中间时期
interim.collocations: interim government 临时政府, interim report 中期报告, in the interim 在此期间

examples.en: An interim manager was appointed until a permanent one is found.
examples.zh: 在找到正式经理之前，任命了一位临时经理。

examples.en: The company released its interim financial results.
examples.zh: 公司发布了中期财务业绩。

examples.en: In the interim, we will continue with the current plan.
examples.zh: 在此期间，我们将继续执行当前计划。

interior.definition: 内部；内陆；内部的；室内的
interior.collocations: interior design 室内设计, interior of a building 建筑内部, interior ministry 内政部

examples.en: The interior of the house was beautifully decorated.
examples.zh: 房子内部装饰得很漂亮。

examples.en: She studied interior design at university.
examples.zh: 她在大学学习室内设计。

examples.en: The interior minister announced new security measures.
examples.zh: 内政部长宣布了新的安全措施。

intermittent.definition: 间歇的；断断续续的；时断时续的
intermittent.collocations: intermittent rain 间歇雨, intermittent fasting 间歇性禁食, intermittent signal 间歇信号

examples.en: The weather forecast predicts intermittent showers throughout the day.
examples.zh: 天气预报预测全天有间歇性阵雨。

examples.en: He suffers from intermittent back pain.
examples.zh: 他患有间歇性背痛。

examples.en: The internet connection has been intermittent all morning.
examples.zh: 整个上午网络连接时断时续。

international.definition: 国际的；国际性的；国际组织；国际比赛
international.collocations: international trade 国际贸易, international relations 国际关系, international student 国际学生

examples.en: The company expanded its international operations.
examples.zh: 公司扩大了国际业务。

examples.en: She works for an international organization.
examples.zh: 她在一家国际组织工作。

examples.en: International cooperation is essential to solve global problems.
examples.zh: 国际合作对解决全球问题至关重要。

interrogate.collocations: interrogate a suspect 审问嫌疑人, interrogate a witness 询问证人, interrogate data 查询数据

examples.en: The police interrogated the suspect for hours.
examples.zh: 警方审问了嫌疑人几个小时。

examples.en: The lawyer interrogated the witness about the events.
examples.zh: 律师就事件询问了证人。

examples.en: The system can interrogate the database to find relevant information.
examples.zh: 该系统可以查询数据库以找到相关信息。

intersection.collocations: traffic intersection 交通十字路口, intersection of cultures 文化交汇, at the intersection 在交叉点

examples.en: The accident occurred at a busy intersection.
examples.zh: 事故发生在繁忙的十字路口。

examples.en: The intersection of art and technology creates new possibilities.
examples.zh: 艺术与技术的交汇创造了新的可能性。

examples.en: We need to find the intersection of these two sets of data.
examples.zh: 我们需要找到这两组数据的交集。

intervention.collocations: government intervention 政府干预, early intervention 早期干预, military intervention 军事干预

examples.en: The teacher's intervention helped resolve the conflict.
examples.zh: 老师的干预帮助解决了冲突。

examples.en: Early intervention can prevent the disease from worsening.
examples.zh: 早期干预可以防止疾病恶化。

examples.en: The UN called for intervention in the humanitarian crisis.
examples.zh: 联合国呼吁对人道主义危机进行干预。

interview.collocations: job interview 求职面试, conduct an interview 进行采访, interview skills 面试技巧

examples.en: She prepared thoroughly for the job interview.
examples.zh: 她为求职面试做了充分准备。

examples.en: The journalist interviewed the prime minister.
examples.zh: 记者采访了首相。

examples.en: The interview lasted for about an hour.
examples.zh: 采访持续了大约一个小时。

interviewee.collocations: interviewee response 受访者回答, nervous interviewee 紧张的面试者, potential interviewee 潜在受访者

examples.en: The interviewee answered all questions confidently.
examples.zh: 被面试者自信地回答了所有问题。

examples.en: Each interviewee was given ten minutes to speak.
examples.zh: 每位受访者有十分钟发言时间。

examples.en: The interviewee's background was impressive.
examples.zh: 被采访者的背景令人印象深刻。

interviewer.collocations: experienced interviewer 经验丰富的面试官, interviewer bias 面试官偏见, interviewer's question 面试官的问题

examples.en: The interviewer asked about her previous work experience.
examples.zh: 面试官询问了她之前的工作经历。

examples.en: A good interviewer listens carefully to the answers.
examples.zh: 好的采访者会仔细倾听回答。

examples.en: The interviewer made a note of the key points.
examples.zh: 面试官记下了关键点。

intimate.collocations: intimate relationship 亲密关系, intimate knowledge 深入了解, intimate atmosphere 私密氛围

examples.en: They shared an intimate conversation by the fireplace.
examples.zh: 他们在壁炉旁进行了一次亲密的谈话。

examples.en: She has an intimate knowledge of the local culture.
examples.zh: 她对当地文化有深入了解。

examples.en: The restaurant has an intimate atmosphere.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅氛围私密。

intimidate.collocations: intimidate someone 恐吓某人, feel intimidated 感到害怕, intimidate into doing 胁迫做某事

examples.en: The bully tried to intimidate the younger students.
examples.zh: 那个恶霸试图恐吓低年级学生。

examples.en: She felt intimidated by the large audience.
examples.zh: 她被众多观众吓到了。

examples.en: They were intimidated into signing the contract.
examples.zh: 他们被胁迫签署了合同。

intricate.definition: 复杂的；精细的；错综复杂的
intricate.collocations: intricate design 复杂的设计, intricate pattern 精细的图案, intricate relationship 错综复杂的关系

examples.en: The watch has an intricate mechanism.
examples.zh: 这块手表有复杂的机械装置。

examples.en: The artist created an intricate pattern on the vase.
examples.zh: 艺术家在花瓶上创作了精细的图案。

examples.en: The novel has an intricate plot.
examples.zh: 这部小说情节错综复杂。

intrigue.collocations: political intrigue 政治阴谋, intrigue someone 引起某人兴趣, be intrigued by 被…吸引

examples.en: The story is full of political intrigue.
examples.zh: 这个故事充满了政治阴谋。

examples.en: The mystery novel intrigued me from the first page.
examples.zh: 这本悬疑小说从第一页就吸引了我。

examples.en: She was intrigued by his unusual proposal.
examples.zh: 她对他不寻常的提议感到好奇。

introduction.collocations: introduction to 介绍, brief introduction 简要介绍, product introduction 产品介绍

examples.en: The book begins with an introduction to the topic.
examples.zh: 这本书以主题介绍开头。

examples.en: She made the introductions at the meeting.
examples.zh: 她在会议上做了介绍。

examples.en: The introduction of new technology improved efficiency.
examples.zh: 新技术的引入提高了效率。

intuition.collocations: trust one's intuition 相信直觉, gut intuition 直觉, intuition tells 直觉告诉

examples.en: She followed her intuition and made the right decision.
examples.zh: 她凭直觉做出了正确的决定。

examples.en: Intuition often plays a role in scientific discovery.
examples.zh: 直觉在科学发现中常常起作用。

examples.en: His intuition told him something was wrong.
examples.zh: 他的直觉告诉他出问题了。

invade.collocations: invade a country 入侵一个国家, invade privacy 侵犯隐私, invade the market 涌入市场

examples.en: The army invaded the neighboring country.
examples.zh: 军队入侵了邻国。

examples.en: The paparazzi invaded her privacy.
examples.zh: 狗仔队侵犯了她的隐私。

examples.en: New companies are invading the market.
examples.zh: 新公司正涌入市场。

inventory.collocations: inventory management 库存管理, take inventory 盘点, inventory list 库存清单

examples.en: The store conducts an inventory check every month.
examples.zh: 这家商店每月进行一次库存盘点。

examples.en: We need to update the inventory list.
examples.zh: 我们需要更新库存清单。

examples.en: Inventory management is crucial for retail businesses.
examples.zh: 库存管理对零售企业至关重要。

invert.collocations: invert the order 颠倒顺序, invert the image 反转图像, invert the colors 反转颜色

examples.en: If you invert the triangle, it looks different.
examples.zh: 如果你把三角形倒过来，它看起来就不一样了。

examples.en: The experiment requires you to invert the test tube.
examples.zh: 实验要求你把试管倒置。

examples.en: The graph inverts the relationship between the variables.
examples.zh: 这个图表颠倒了变量之间的关系。

invest.collocations: invest in 投资于, invest money 投资金钱, invest time 投入时间

examples.en: Many people invest in the stock market.
examples.zh: 许多人投资股票市场。

examples.en: She invested a lot of time in learning English.
examples.zh: 她投入了大量时间学习英语。

examples.en: The company plans to invest in new technology.
examples.zh: 公司计划投资新技术。

investigation.collocations: criminal investigation 刑事调查, under investigation 正在调查中, conduct an investigation 进行调查

examples.en: The police launched an investigation into the crime.
examples.zh: 警方对犯罪展开了调查。

examples.en: The matter is still under investigation.
examples.zh: 此事仍在调查中。

examples.en: The investigation revealed new evidence.
examples.zh: 调查揭示了新证据。

invisible.collocations: invisible to the naked eye 肉眼看不见, invisible hand 无形之手, invisible barrier 无形障碍

examples.en: Germs are invisible to the naked eye.
examples.zh: 细菌是肉眼看不见的。

examples.en: The invisible hand of the market influences prices.
examples.zh: 市场的无形之手影响价格。

examples.en: She felt an invisible barrier between them.
examples.zh: 她感到他们之间有一道无形的障碍。

invoice.collocations: invoice number 发票号码, pay an invoice 支付账单, issue an invoice 开具发票

examples.en: Please send the invoice by email.
examples.zh: 请通过电子邮件发送发票。

examples.en: The company invoices its clients monthly.
examples.zh: 公司每月给客户开具发票。

examples.en: The invoice amount is due within 30 days.
examples.zh: 发票金额应在30天内支付。

involve.collocations: involve in 参与, involve with 与…有关, involve doing 涉及做某事

examples.en: The project involves a lot of teamwork.
examples.zh: 这个项目涉及大量的团队合作。

examples.en: She was involved in the decision-making process.
examples.zh: 她参与了决策过程。

examples.en: The job involves traveling frequently.
examples.zh: 这份工作需要经常出差。

irony.definition: 讽刺；反讽；具有讽刺意味的事
irony.collocations: dramatic irony 戏剧性讽刺, sense of irony 讽刺感, ironic twist 讽刺的转折

examples.en: The irony is that he became rich by losing his job.
examples.zh: 讽刺的是，他因为失业而变得富有。

examples.en: She spoke with a hint of irony in her voice.
examples.zh: 她说话时带着一丝讽刺。

examples.en: The play is full of dramatic irony.
examples.zh: 这部戏剧充满了戏剧性讽刺。

irregular.definition: 不规则的；不规律的；不合常规的
irregular.collocations: irregular heartbeat 心律不齐, irregular verbs 不规则动词, irregular pattern 不规则图案

examples.en: The patient was diagnosed with an irregular heartbeat.
examples.zh: 病人被诊断出心律不齐。

examples.en: English has many irregular verbs that do not follow standard conjugation rules.
examples.zh: 英语中有许多不规则动词，它们不遵循标准的变位规则。

examples.en: The irregular pattern on the fabric made it unique.
examples.zh: 布料上的不规则图案使其独一无二。

irrespective.collocations: irrespective of age 不论年龄, irrespective of gender 不论性别, irrespective of cost 不计成本

examples.en: The scholarship is awarded to students irrespective of their financial background.
examples.zh: 该奖学金颁发给学生，不论其经济背景如何。

examples.en: Everyone is entitled to a fair trial, irrespective of their social status.
examples.zh: 每个人都有权获得公平审判，不论其社会地位如何。

examples.en: The company offers equal opportunities irrespective of race or religion.
examples.zh: 公司提供平等机会，不论种族或宗教。

irrigation.collocations: irrigation system 灌溉系统, drip irrigation 滴灌, irrigation canal 灌溉渠

examples.en: Modern irrigation techniques have significantly increased crop yields.
examples.zh: 现代灌溉技术显著提高了作物产量。

examples.en: The government invested in a new irrigation project to support agriculture.
examples.zh: 政府投资了一个新的灌溉项目以支持农业。

examples.en: Drip irrigation is an efficient method that conserves water.
examples.zh: 滴灌是一种节约用水的有效方法。

irritate.definition: 激怒；使烦躁；刺激（皮肤等）
irritate.collocations: irritate someone 激怒某人, irritate the skin 刺激皮肤, easily irritated 易怒的

examples.en: His constant complaining began to irritate his colleagues.
examples.zh: 他不断的抱怨开始激怒他的同事。

examples.en: Some chemicals can irritate the skin if not handled properly.
examples.zh: 某些化学品如果处理不当会刺激皮肤。

examples.en: She is easily irritated by loud noises.
examples.zh: 她很容易被噪音激怒。

isolated.collocations: isolated incident 孤立事件, isolated area 偏远地区, feel isolated 感到孤立

examples.en: The village is located in an isolated area with no access to public transport.
examples.zh: 这个村庄位于一个偏远地区，没有公共交通。

examples.en: This was not an isolated incident; similar cases have been reported before.
examples.zh: 这不是孤立事件，之前也有类似案例报道。

examples.en: Living abroad can make some people feel isolated from their culture.
examples.zh: 生活在国外可能会让一些人感到与自己的文化隔绝。

isolation.collocations: social isolation 社交孤立, isolation ward 隔离病房, in isolation 孤立地

examples.en: Prolonged social isolation can have negative effects on mental health.
examples.zh: 长期的社交孤立可能对心理健康产生负面影响。

examples.en: The patient was placed in an isolation ward to prevent the spread of infection.
examples.zh: 病人被安置在隔离病房以防止感染传播。

examples.en: The problem cannot be viewed in isolation from its context.
examples.zh: 这个问题不能脱离其背景孤立地看待。

item.collocations: item on the agenda 议程项目, luxury item 奢侈品, news item 新闻条目

examples.en: The first item on the agenda is the budget proposal.
examples.zh: 议程上的第一项是预算提案。

examples.en: She bought several luxury items during her trip abroad.
examples.zh: 她在国外旅行时购买了几件奢侈品。

examples.en: This news item has attracted widespread attention.
examples.zh: 这条新闻条目引起了广泛关注。

itinerary.collocations: travel itinerary 旅行行程, detailed itinerary 详细行程, plan an itinerary 制定行程

examples.en: We need to finalize our travel itinerary before booking flights.
examples.zh: 在预订机票前，我们需要确定旅行行程。

examples.en: The tour guide provided a detailed itinerary of the trip.
examples.zh: 导游提供了详细的行程安排。

examples.en: She spent hours planning the itinerary for her European vacation.
examples.zh: 她花了几个小时规划欧洲假期的行程。

jealous.collocations: jealous of someone 嫉妒某人, jealous husband 吃醋的丈夫, make someone jealous 让某人嫉妒

examples.en: She was jealous of her friend's success.
examples.zh: 她嫉妒朋友的成功。

examples.en: He became jealous when he saw his girlfriend talking to another man.
examples.zh: 他看到女友和另一个男人说话时变得吃醋。

examples.en: Don't let jealousy ruin your relationship.
examples.zh: 不要让嫉妒毁了你们的关系。

jeans.collocations: pair of jeans 一条牛仔裤, blue jeans 蓝色牛仔裤, designer jeans 名牌牛仔裤

examples.en: She wore a pair of blue jeans and a white T-shirt.
examples.zh: 她穿着一条蓝色牛仔裤和一件白色T恤。

examples.en: Jeans are a versatile item of clothing suitable for many occasions.
examples.zh: 牛仔裤是一种适合多种场合的多功能服装。

examples.en: He bought a new pair of designer jeans on sale.
examples.zh: 他打折时买了一条新的名牌牛仔裤。

jerk.definition: 急拉； jerk（人）；蠢人；猛地一动
jerk.collocations: jerk reaction 突然反应, jerk chicken 烤鸡（加勒比风味）, jerk someone around 耍弄某人

examples.en: He gave the rope a sudden jerk and it came loose.
examples.zh: 他突然猛拉绳子，绳子松了。

examples.en: Don't be such a jerk; apologize to her.
examples.zh: 别那么混蛋，向她道歉。

examples.en: The car jerked forward when the driver stepped on the accelerator.
examples.zh: 司机踩下油门时，汽车猛地向前一冲。

jewelry.collocations: piece of jewelry 一件珠宝, fine jewelry 精美珠宝, costume jewelry 人造珠宝

examples.en: She inherited a valuable piece of jewelry from her grandmother.
examples.zh: 她从祖母那里继承了一件珍贵的珠宝。

examples.en: The store sells both fine jewelry and costume jewelry.
examples.zh: 这家店既卖精美珠宝也卖人造珠宝。

examples.en: She wore a stunning diamond necklace, her favorite piece of jewelry.
examples.zh: 她戴着一条令人惊艳的钻石项链，那是她最喜欢的首饰。

job.collocations: apply for a job 申请工作, job interview 工作面试, job market 就业市场

examples.en: She applied for a job at a multinational company.
examples.zh: 她申请了一家跨国公司的工作。

examples.en: He has a job interview tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 他明天上午有一个工作面试。

examples.en: The job market is becoming increasingly competitive.
examples.zh: 就业市场变得越来越有竞争力。

jog.collocations: go for a jog 去慢跑, jog someone's memory 唤起某人的记忆, jog along 缓慢前进

examples.en: I go for a jog in the park every morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早上在公园慢跑。

examples.en: Seeing that photo jogged my memory of our vacation.
examples.zh: 看到那张照片唤起了我对假期的记忆。

examples.en: The old car jogged along the bumpy road.
examples.zh: 那辆旧车在崎岖的路上缓慢前行。

journalist.collocations: investigative journalist 调查记者, freelance journalist 自由记者, journalist covering politics 报道政治的记者

examples.en: The journalist wrote an article about climate change.
examples.zh: 这位记者写了一篇关于气候变化的文章。

examples.en: She works as a freelance journalist for several magazines.
examples.zh: 她为几家杂志社做自由记者。

examples.en: Investigative journalists often risk their safety to uncover the truth.
examples.zh: 调查记者常常冒着生命危险揭露真相。

judicial.collocations: judicial system 司法系统, judicial review 司法审查, judicial decision 司法判决

examples.en: The judicial system is independent of the executive branch.
examples.zh: 司法系统独立于行政部门。

examples.en: The Supreme Court has the power of judicial review.
examples.zh: 最高法院拥有司法审查权。

examples.en: The judicial decision was based on the evidence presented.
examples.zh: 司法判决基于所呈证据。

juice.collocations: orange juice 橙汁, fruit juice 果汁, juice extractor 榨汁机

examples.en: I would like a glass of orange juice, please.
examples.zh: 请给我一杯橙汁。

examples.en: Fresh fruit juice is rich in vitamins.
examples.zh: 新鲜果汁富含维生素。

examples.en: She used a juice extractor to make carrot juice.
examples.zh: 她用榨汁机做了胡萝卜汁。

junction.collocations: road junction 道路交叉口, railway junction 铁路枢纽, junction box 接线盒

examples.en: The accident happened at a busy road junction.
examples.zh: 事故发生在繁忙的道路交叉口。

examples.en: The city is an important railway junction connecting several major lines.
examples.zh: 这个城市是连接几条主要线路的重要铁路枢纽。

examples.en: The electrician checked the junction box for any loose wires.
examples.zh: 电工检查了接线盒是否有松动的电线。

jungle.collocations: dense jungle 茂密的丛林, jungle trek 丛林徒步, law of the jungle 丛林法则

examples.en: They trekked through the dense jungle for days.
examples.zh: 他们在茂密的丛林中徒步走了好几天。

examples.en: Many exotic animals live in the jungle.
examples.zh: 许多珍奇动物生活在丛林中。

examples.en: In the business world, it's often the law of the jungle.
examples.zh: 在商界，常常是弱肉强食的丛林法则。

junior.definition: 初级的；年少的；晚辈；大三学生
junior.collocations: junior high school 初中, junior employee 初级员工, junior year 大三

examples.en: He is a junior employee in the company.
examples.zh: 他是公司的一名初级员工。

examples.en: She is in her junior year at university.
examples.zh: 她正在上大学三年级。

examples.en: The junior high school students went on a field trip.
examples.zh: 初中生们去实地考察了。

junk.definition: 垃圾，废旧杂物；无价值的东西
junk.collocations: junk food 垃圾食品, junk mail 垃圾邮件, junk shop 旧货店

examples.en: Eating too much junk food can lead to health problems.
examples.zh: 吃太多垃圾食品会导致健康问题。

examples.en: I need to clear out all the junk from my garage.
examples.zh: 我需要清理车库里的所有废旧杂物。

examples.en: My email inbox is full of junk mail.
examples.zh: 我的电子邮箱里塞满了垃圾邮件。

jury.collocations: trial by jury 陪审团审判, jury duty 陪审义务, jury system 陪审制度

examples.en: The jury found the defendant guilty of theft.
examples.zh: 陪审团判定被告犯有盗窃罪。

examples.en: She was selected for jury duty last month.
examples.zh: 她上个月被选为陪审员。

examples.en: The jury is still out on whether the policy is effective.
examples.zh: 关于这项政策是否有效，尚无定论。

justification.collocations: provide justification 提供理由, without justification 毫无理由, justification for 为…辩护

examples.en: There is no justification for such rude behavior.
examples.zh: 这种行为粗鲁无礼，毫无理由可言。

examples.en: He tried to find a justification for his actions.
examples.zh: 他试图为自己的行为找借口。

examples.en: The text alignment includes left, right, center, and full justification.
examples.zh: 文本对齐方式包括左对齐、右对齐、居中对齐和两端对齐。

juvenile.collocations: juvenile delinquency 青少年犯罪, juvenile court 少年法庭, juvenile behavior 幼稚行为

examples.en: The government has launched a program to reduce juvenile delinquency.
examples.zh: 政府启动了一项减少青少年犯罪的计划。

examples.en: His juvenile behavior embarrassed his parents.
examples.zh: 他幼稚的行为让父母感到难堪。

examples.en: Juvenile offenders are often tried in special courts.
examples.zh: 少年犯通常在专门的法庭受审。

keen.definition: 渴望的，热衷的；敏锐的；锋利的
keen.collocations: keen on 热衷于, keen interest 浓厚的兴趣, keen eyesight 敏锐的视力

examples.en: She is keen on learning new languages.
examples.zh: 她热衷于学习新语言。

examples.en: Dogs have a keen sense of smell.
examples.zh: 狗有敏锐的嗅觉。

examples.en: He is a keen observer of human behavior.
examples.zh: 他是一个敏锐的人类行为观察者。

kernel.collocations: kernel of truth 事实的核心, kernel of an idea 想法的核心, operating system kernel 操作系统内核

examples.en: There is a kernel of truth in his argument.
examples.zh: 他的论点中有一点是真实的。

examples.en: The kernel of the problem is lack of funding.
examples.zh: 问题的核心是缺乏资金。

examples.en: The Linux kernel is open-source software.
examples.zh: Linux内核是开源软件。

key.collocations: key to success 成功的关键, key point 关键点, key role 关键角色

examples.en: Hard work is the key to success.
examples.zh: 努力工作是成功的关键。

examples.en: Please press the space key to continue.
examples.zh: 请按空格键继续。

examples.en: The key to solving the puzzle is hidden in the text.
examples.zh: 解开谜题的关键隐藏在文本中。

kidnap.collocations: kidnap victim 绑架受害者, kidnap for ransom 绑架勒索, attempted kidnap 绑架未遂

examples.en: The wealthy businessman was kidnapped by a gang.
examples.zh: 那位富商被一个团伙绑架了。

examples.en: Police rescued the kidnapped child unharmed.
examples.zh: 警方救出了被绑架的孩子，孩子安然无恙。

examples.en: They planned to kidnap the diplomat for ransom.
examples.zh: 他们计划绑架外交官以勒索赎金。

kidney.collocations: kidney disease 肾病, kidney transplant 肾移植, kidney stone 肾结石

examples.en: He donated one of his kidneys to his brother.
examples.zh: 他把一个肾捐给了他的兄弟。

examples.en: Drinking plenty of water helps prevent kidney stones.
examples.zh: 多喝水有助于预防肾结石。

examples.en: The patient is waiting for a kidney transplant.
examples.zh: 病人正在等待肾移植。

killer.definition: 杀手，杀人犯；致命的事物
killer.collocations: serial killer 连环杀手, killer disease 致命疾病, killer instinct 杀手本能

examples.en: The police are hunting for the serial killer.
examples.zh: 警方正在追捕连环杀手。

examples.en: Heart disease is a silent killer.
examples.zh: 心脏病是一种无声的杀手。

examples.en: He has a killer instinct in business.
examples.zh: 他在生意上有一种杀手本能。

kindergarten.collocations: kindergarten teacher 幼儿园老师, kindergarten class 幼儿园班级, kindergarten education 幼儿教育

examples.en: My daughter started kindergarten this year.
examples.zh: 我女儿今年开始上幼儿园了。

examples.en: Kindergarten teachers play a vital role in early childhood development.
examples.zh: 幼儿园老师在儿童早期发展中起着至关重要的作用。

examples.en: The kindergarten curriculum includes basic literacy and numeracy.
examples.zh: 幼儿园课程包括基本的读写和算术。

kit.definition: 成套工具，配套元件；装备
kit.collocations: first aid kit 急救箱, tool kit 工具箱, survival kit 救生包

examples.en: Every car should have a first aid kit.
examples.zh: 每辆车都应该备有急救箱。

examples.en: He bought a model airplane kit for his son.
examples.zh: 他给儿子买了一套飞机模型组件。

examples.en: The soldiers were issued with a new kit.
examples.zh: 士兵们领到了新装备。

kitchen.collocations: kitchen knife 菜刀, kitchen counter 厨房台面, kitchen appliance 厨房电器

examples.en: She spends a lot of time in the kitchen cooking.
examples.zh: 她花很多时间在厨房做饭。

examples.en: The kitchen is equipped with modern appliances.
examples.zh: 厨房配备了现代电器。

examples.en: He installed a new kitchen counter last weekend.
examples.zh: 他上周末安装了一个新的厨房台面。

knot.collocations: tie a knot 打结, knot in wood 木节, Gordian knot 难解之结

examples.en: He tied a tight knot in the rope.
examples.zh: 他在绳子上打了一个紧结。

examples.en: The ship was sailing at 20 knots.
examples.zh: 船以20节的速度航行。
